Title: Senior Data Scientist
HTML:
At Cesar S.p.A., the company managing the Acqua & Sapone and La Saponeria brands, we are building a new Data Science team to support a data-driven transformation journey across the organization.

Cesar S.p.A. has been a leader for more than 30 years in the beauty, home care and personal care sectors. Through the Acqua & Sapone and La Saponeria store brands, we operate more than 850 points of sale and are expanding across Italy and Spain.

The launch of our new loyalty programme, the implementation of the new MS Dynamics 365 ERP system and the growing availability of high-quality data are opening a particularly exciting phase: we want to turn insights, models and analytical solutions into concrete, measurable decisions that are closely connected to the business.

Posizione:

The role:

As Senior Data Scientist, you will work on high-impact strategic initiatives, contributing to the design and development of custom solutions across areas such as supply chain, demand forecasting, assortment, promotions, loyalty, pricing, geomarketing and store network expansion.

This is a true greenfield opportunity: many solutions will be built from scratch, with the goal of helping the business move beyond manual processes by bringing structure, automation and predictive capabilities into decision-making.

What you will do:

  • Work closely with business teams to understand problems, processes, available data and operational objectives;
  • Translate business needs into well-structured analytics and data science problems;
  • Develop models, analyses and data-driven tools that generate measurable business value;
  • Lead the iterative development of solutions, from experimentation through to user adoption;
  • Support business teams during testing, validation and integration of solutions into operational processes.

Requisiti:

What we are looking for:

  • At least 3 years of experience in data science;
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL; experience with cloud computing will be considered a plus;
  • Solid foundations in machine learning, statistics and key developments in AI;
  • Experience developing lightweight web applications with open-source frameworks such as Streamlit or Flask;
  • Familiarity with data visualisation tools;
  • Ability to communicate clearly with technical, managerial and operational stakeholders;
  • Good professional command of English.

Experience with retail and transactional data will be considered particularly relevant.

Alternatively, a background in consulting or complex business environments will be valued, especially where you have developed the ability to understand business needs and turn them into concrete analytical solutions.

Altre informazioni:

Location and working model:

The role involves periodic travel to our Pescara office, indicatively at least one week per month, with frequency varying depending on the project pipeline and collaboration needs with business teams.

Contract and compensation:

We offer a permanent employment contract under the Italian CCNL DMO collective agreement.

Compensation Will Be Aligned With Experience And Skills.

Why join us:

  • You will join a Data Science team in its early stages, with the opportunity to contribute directly to methods, tools and priorities;
  • You will work on business-focused use cases with direct impact on a large and growing retail network;
  • You will have the opportunity to build solutions from scratch, combining technical expertise, analytical thinking and stakeholder engagement.

If you are interested in applying data science to real business problems, working closely with business teams and contributing to the data-driven transformation of a fast-evolving retail group, this could be the right opportunity for you.

Apply or share this opportunity with someone who may be interested.

Cesar S.p.A. promotes an inclusive working environment and values applications from people with different backgrounds, experiences and career paths.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
doValue, per la sua controllata doData, è alla ricerca di un/una Data Scientist di talento da inserire nel nostro team, che contribuisca allo sviluppo di nuovi data product destinati al mercato.

Nel ruolo, la risorsa opererà lungo l’intero ciclo di vita del data product: dall’esplorazione del concept e dalla modellazione dei prototipi fino all’operativizzazione di soluzioni analitiche scalabili. Il lavoro svolto supporterà direttamente il lancio di asset informativi innovativi, rafforzando il portafoglio dell’azienda e generando valore per i nostri clienti.




RESPONSABILITÀ PRINCIPALI

• Applicare tecniche analitiche, statistiche e di machine learning per progettare modelli e insight che evolvano in prodotti di dati pronti per il mercato.

• Analizzare dataset interni ed esterni per individuare opportunità di nuove funzionalità, indicatori, modelli di scoring o analisi monetizzabili.

• Collaborare con i team di Data Engineering e Business per definire i requisiti e contribuire alla definizione delle specifiche di prodotto.

• Costruire pipeline riproducibili e workflow analitici utilizzando Databricks, Delta Lake e Spark.

• Supportare la trasformazione dei prototipi in componenti di data product scalabili, affidabili e manutenibili.

• Condurre analisi esplorative dei dati (EDA) per valutare la qualità dei dati, identificare trend e generare ipotesi di valore del prodotto.

• Produrre documentazione chiara, visualizzazioni e presentazioni per comunicare la logica, la metodologia e il valore delle funzionalità proposte dei data product.

• Contribuire al miglioramento continuo delle metodologie di data science e del processo di innovazione dei prodotti data-driven.




COMPETENZE E SKILL RICHIESTI PER IL RUOLO

Esperienza professionale come Data Scientist o in un ruolo analitico simile.
Solide competenze di programmazione in Python, incluse le principali librerie analitiche (Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PySpark).
Esperienza pratica nell’utilizzo di Databricks per il data processing, feature engineering, modellazione e sperimentazione.
Solida conoscenza dei concetti di machine learning, statistica e delle best practice analitiche.
Capacità di progettare logiche analitiche spiegabili, riproducibili e industrializzabili come prodotto.
Ottime capacità comunicative, con attitudine a tradurre risultati analitici in insight rilevanti per il business.
Comprovata capacità di collaborazione in contesti cross-funzionali.




Requisiti preferenziali

8. Esperienza nell’utilizzo di dati geospaziali.

9. Esperienza in credit risk analytics, scoring di portafoglio, forecasting dei recuperi o modellazione finanziaria.

10. Familiarità con open data, dataset immobiliari o API spaziali, in particolare relativi ai mercati UE.

11. Esperienza nel processamento di big data tramite Spark e Delta Lake.

12. Conoscenza di pratiche MLOps (MLflow, model registry, workflow di deployment).




REQUISITI DI FORMAZIONE

Titolo di studio richiesto: Laurea triennale in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistica, Matematica, Ingegneria o discipline affini.

Formazione specifica richiesta: Certificazione Databricks o Azure.




ESPERIENZA PROFESSIONALE RICHIESTA

• Minimo 3 anni di esperienza in ambito data science.




Sede: Milano

Title: Lead Data Scientist
Description:
Enabling What’s Next




Who We Are😎

Born in 2004 as Techedge, we have more than 20 years of expertise that enabled us to become what we are today: Avvale!

This path led us to be able to count on over 3500 employees, present in 12 countries around the world.




What We Do🌱

We help public and private companies to re-design their business models through the development of innovative and sustainable solutions, which have a positive impact not only on our customers but also on the world we live in!




How we do💡

Through circular economy models, made possible thanks to technological innovation.




What you will find 🔍

In Avvale we value our talents and your path with us will be full of:

Flexibility, thanks to our policy you can work remotely in Italy, up to 5 days a week, and in SEE and Switzerland up to 5 months a year;

Training & development as you can participate to training on the job, certifications, foreign languages classes and you will have a yearly budget to buy training courses;

Gender equality & inclusion, the obtaining of Pdr 125 is a proof of Avvale commitment to an inclusive and fair work environment;

Compensation & Benefits: In line with our commitment to transparency and people development, the gross annual salary (RAL) for this position ranges between €44,000 and €50,000, commensurate with experience and skills. The position is covered by the 'CCNL Commercio e Terziario' (National Collective Labor Agreement for Commerce and Service Sector), alongside a benefits package that includes meal vouchers, wellbeing initiatives (including Wellhub), and growth opportunities.




Role and responsibilities:




You will be part of an area that takes care of Artificial Intelligence.




As a Lead Data Scientist, you will work for customers and internal research departments on complex and innovative projects about genAI, NLP, demand forecasting, predictive maintenance, computer vision, and lots more, in various fields and sectors.

You will focus on solving complex problems: translating requirements into actionable rules and

deliverables.




You will be responsible for:

Analyzing business needs and proposing the most effective technical approach, choosing between classical AI, GenAI, or hybrid solutions.
Designing the end-to-end AI solution, translating business requirements into technical specifications.
Designing and implementing solutions based on Machine Learning and advanced statistical methods, as well as GenAI architectures (RAG, agents, LLM orchestration, prompt engineering, fine-tuning when needed).
Assessing when to rely on an LLM/GenAI solution versus a classical ML approach, based on robustness, accuracy, and cost-effectiveness.
Validating developed models with a focus on explainability, generalization, robustness, and production behavior (including GenAI-specific risks such as hallucinations, bias, and inference costs).
Preparing and presenting technical and non-technical reports, adapting the storytelling to the audience's level.
Staying up to date on developments in Data Science, ML, and GenAI, proposing new ideas and participating in pre-sales activities.




Required Skills🛹

At least 4 years of relevant experience designing and implementing AI/ML solutions.
Hands-on experience applying advanced analytics/ML techniques to real business cases, with a proven ability to synthesize complex data and present results.
Practical experience with advanced analytics/ML techniques and GenAI solutions applied to real business cases .
Strong proficiency in Python and core AI frameworks/libraries.




Come with us💪

You will have the opportunity to work and get in touch with international players who will allow you to increase your know-how in view of future challenges!




We do not consider applications without CV.

Avvale promotes equal opportunity. We enhance diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment in compliance with applicable non-discrimination and data protection laws.

Title: Data Scientist - QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey
Description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

You will work in multi-disciplinary teams to harness the power of data and deliver real-world impact for organizations globally. Your work will directly influence the recommendations our clients need to drive meaningful change and enhance their performance.

You will tackle complex and diverse data challenges, working with some of the world’s largest organizations. You will develop high-quality data science solutions and products, focusing on advanced modeling and analytics.

While collaborating with client teams and internal experts, you will present findings, provide actionable recommendations, and consult with stakeholders to ensure the successful implementation of data-driven strategies.

You will gain exposure to a variety of industries and sectors, building large-scale data and analytics solutions to address complex business problems. Along the way, you will learn and apply best practices in data science, including responsible AI usage, secure and sustainable development, and scalable solutions.

Working in a collaborative and multicultural environment, you will partner with data scientists, ML engineers, project managers, and business experts to deliver impactful solutions. You will also stay up to date with the latest advancements in data science tools and technologies, while participating in world-class learning programs to continuously enhance your skills.

You will solve real-world problems by analyzing and modeling complex datasets, transforming raw data into actionable insights. By developing and delivering data science solutions, you will ensure they are scalable, secure, and aligned with industry best practices. Collaborating closely with client teams and internal experts, you will design and implement data-driven strategies that address critical business challenges. Your ability to present findings and actionable recommendations to stakeholders will ensure clarity, impact, and alignment with their goals.

Staying informed about the latest trends in data science, you will contribute to the development of proprietary tools and methodologies, driving innovation and excellence. Working across various industries, you will gain valuable insights into diverse business challenges and uncover new applications for data science, broadening your expertise and delivering meaningful results.

We use a diverse range of tools and technologies, selecting the best fit for each task while considering client preferences. Commonly used tools include:


Programming and Machine Learning: Python (primary), SQL, R, TensorFlow, PyTorch and Spark
Data Engineering and Deployment: Docker, Kubernetes
Cloud Platforms: AWS, GCP, Azure
Proprietary Tools: Kedro, CausalNex, MLRun


Your Qualifications and Skills


Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in computer science, machine learning, applied statistics, mathematics, engineering, or a related field
Up to 2 years of experience in programming or data science
Statistical Knowledge: Strong foundation in statistics and data analysis is required. Familiarity with GenAI core concepts is a nice-to-have (e.g., LLMs, RAG architecture, embeddings, and prompt engineering techniques)
Proficiency in Python is a must. Experience with R, SQL, or Spark is highly valued. Familiarity with other tools such as, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hadoop is a plus. Familiarity with LLM tech-stack (e.g., Langchain, llamaindex) is also a plus
Proven ability to work effectively in team environments and with stakeholders at all levels
Familiarity with AWS, GCP, or Azure is a nice-to-have
Strong verbal and written communication skills in Italian. Fluent level language skills in English are required; knowledge of additional languages (e.g., Portuguese, German, French, Spanish) are a plus

Title: Senior Data Scientist GenAI
Description:
Are you looking for a new challenge?

Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance?

Prima could be the place for you.

Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our AI team focused on bringing ML & Generative AI into the heart of our operations (e.g. claims, underwriting, customer support).

In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to redefine the core operative processes, leveraging ML & GenAI techniques to enhance not only efficiency but, most importantly, the overall effectiveness and quality of outcomes.

You’ll collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and business leaders to design and deliver AI-driven products that create tangible business value and redefine the future of ops at Prima.

Excited to make an impact? Here are the details

What You’ll Do


Lead the end-to-end development of ML & GenAI solutions to transform the operations journey, from problem framing and data exploration to production deployment, tackling business challenges with autonomy and scientific rigor;
Set and uphold high technical standards across multiple AI initiatives, ensuring quality, scalability, and consistency;
Mentor fellow DSs and accelerate team learning, providing structure in the way of working, and driving a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement.


What We’re Looking For


Extensive experience (3+ years) in data science or applied machine learning, leading end-to-end initiatives in complex technical domains and delivering measurable business impact through ML and GenAI solutions;
Strong analytical and quantitative mindset able to translate data into insights, assess model performance, and guide decision-making with evidence and clarity;Structured problem solver skilled at framing ambiguous challenges, defining success metrics, and communicating results to both technical and non-technical audiences;Practical technical experience in coding (strong proficiency in Python and knowledge of coding best practices) and in ML/GenAI (experience with building ML models using frameworks such as scikit-learn and XGBoost, and familiarity with leveraging GenAI LLMs via APIs like OpenAI GPT or Gemini);
Curious and adaptive leader, proactive in exploring new methods, improving processes, and driving innovation in a fast-evolving environment.


Nice-to-Have


Global mindset: Experience working across countries or multi-market products;
Language skills: usiness proficiency in Italian or Spanish, in addition to English.


€55,000 - €75,000 a year

Why you’ll love it here

We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks.

💵 Competitive compensation: We offer a performance-based bonus of up to 7,5% of the fixed salary for this position.

🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year.

🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.

🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.

Think you’re a match? Apply now.

At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.

Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

· Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese

· Propensione all’innovazione

· Attitudine al teamworking

· Ottima conoscenza di Python

· Ottima conoscenza di Databricks e PowerBI

· Ottima conoscenza di SQL

· Capacità di costruzione di strutture dati per le analisi




Sede di lavoro: Milano

Esperienza: 2/3 anni

Area: Data & AI

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Are you looking for a new challenge?

Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance?

Prima could be the place for you.

Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain.

To help fuel that growth, we’re looking for Data Scientists to join our Pricing & Underwriting Department, the strategic engine behind Prima's growth.

As part of this global team, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping our strategy and strengthening our competitive edge. Using data, analytical thinking, machine learning and business acumen, you’ll help predict the future and set the right prices, keeping our offering both attractive and sustainable. You’ll work with your data science tools and skills to bring real-world impact, collaborating with cross-functional teams to turn insights into action and fuel innovation across the company and its different branches.

Excited to make an impact? Here are the details.

What You’ll Do


Leverage data to identify risks, opportunities and key pricing drivers, turning complex information into actionable insights that influence strategic decision making;
Leverage Machine Learning and advanced analytics to develop risk and pricing models that power real-time insurance pricing for millions of customers;
Contribute directly to the company’s growth and long-term success through innovative modelling, experimentation and commercially impactful insights.


What We’re Looking For


Strong academic background in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering (Maths, Physics and Computer Science specialisations), Data Science, Computer Science or Statistics;
Strong quantitative, logical and analytical abilities, a solid foundation in statistics, probability and advanced analytics, and a curious, proactive and innovative mindset focused on solving complex problems;
Fluency in English, both spoken and written.


Nice-to-Have


Strong communication skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions, and drive new ideas;
Possess a solid foundation in code development and machine learning, ideally in Python;
Know how to create, manipulate and analyse large datasets.


€45,000 - €75,000 a year

Why you'll love it here

We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks.

💵Competitive compensation: Benefit from competitive salaries, starting from €45k up to €75k, with clear opportunities to grow as you do.

🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year.

🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.

🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.

Think you’re a match? Apply now.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
About us

Sky is the technology and media company that makes entertainment and connectivity a personal, simple, and seamless experience.

Our motto is We Believe in Better: we believe people deserve the very best, and we innovate every day to create value and make our customers’ lives easier.

As part of Sky Group and the wider Comcast family, we operate within an international environment driven by continuous innovation and powered by outstanding technology, enabling us to reach millions of people every day.

With an IP-first approach, we design cutting-edge technology platforms—Sky Stream, Sky Q, Sky Glass, and NOW—that seamlessly bring together premium content, trusted 24/7 news coverage, and world-class sporting events within a simple and intuitive ecosystem.

We connect with audiences across the entire country through our free-to-air channels—TV8, Cielo, and Sky TG24—and go beyond entertainment with Sky Wifi and Sky Mobile, delivering ultra-fast connectivity both at home and on the move.

This is how we bring the joy of a better experience, guided by our values:

Creative – We are ambitious and innovative, embracing new technologies and leveraging insights to stay one step ahead, continuously raising the bar for our customers.
Welcoming – We are inclusive, collaborative, and respectful, fostering a strong sense of belonging.
Simplifying – We focus on what truly matters, set clear priorities, bring clarity, and remove complexity.
Do the Right Thing – We build a culture rooted in clarity, fairness, and trust through transparent processes and decisions that people can rely on.




Position: Data Scientist

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Senior Data Scientist to contribute to data science initiatives focused on customer analytics, personalization, recommendation systems, next-best-action strategies, and NLP/text analytics.




In this role, you will work with large-scale customer, product, content, and interaction data to develop machine learning and advanced analytics solutions that improve customer experience, support business decision-making, increase operational efficiency.

You will collaborate with data scientists, machine learning engineers, data engineers, and business stakeholders across the full lifecycle of data science projects, from problem framing and exploration to model development, deployment support, monitoring, and impact assessment.

What you will do:

Work with business stakeholders to understand requirements, clarify objectives, and translate business questions into analytical approaches.
Contribute to end-to-end data science projects, from business problem framing to model development, validation, deployment support, impact assessment, and performance evaluation.
Develop machine learning and advanced analytics solutions for customer analytics, personalization, recommendation systems, next-best-action, and next-best-offer use cases.
Apply NLP and generative AI techniques on unstructured data to generate actionable insights
Collaborate with machine learning engineers, data engineers, and platform teams to support model deployment.
Support the prioritization and delivery of multiple data science initiatives, ensuring alignment with business needs.
Mentor junior data scientists when needed and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team.
Stay up to date with relevant developments in machine learning, generative AI, NLP, recommendation systems, and applied analytics.




Your profile:

Advanced degree in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Physics, Economics, or a related discipline.
Solid experience with machine learning, statistical modeling, predictive analytics, and data-driven decisioning.
Ability to structure analytical problems and deliver practical solutions in a dynamic environment.
Proficiency in Python and common data science libraries for analysis, modeling, and experimentation.
Proficiency in SQL for data extraction, manipulation, and analysis.
Proficiency with Git for version control, code collaboration, and reproducible analytical workflows.
Good business acumen and ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience with customer analytics, personalization, recommendation systems, next-best-action or next-best-offer models is highly desirable.
Experience with topic modeling, generative AI applications and Agentic Frameworks is a strong plus.
Experience with cloud platforms (GCP), scalable data environments, production-grade analytics solutions is a plus.
Proficiency in both Italian and English is mandatory.




What we offer:

Under the Private Radio and Television Collective Bargaining Agreement (CCNL), the salary starts from €40.000.

Contract Type: Permanent

The final compensation package will be based on the candidate’s experience and specific skills.

This position is also eligible for the annual incentive scheme.

At Sky, we are committed to providing a healthy, inspiring, and supportive working environment that values individual needs, both personally and professionally.

That is why we created Sky4You, our wellbeing programme designed to support employees through every stage of life. Some of the benefits available to you include:

Complimentary access to Sky TV through Sky Q or Sky Stream
Sky Wifi and Sky Mobile at exclusive employee rates
Private health insurance, extendable to family members and cohabiting partners
Life and accident insurance coverage
Free access to the company gym (Milan office only)
Financial support for new parents and caregivers
Free tax return assistance
Meal vouchers

In addition, you will have access to a range of initiatives focused on physical, mental, and financial wellbeing, as well as summer camps and language courses for children, plus exclusive discounts and partner offers.

Hybrid Working

Hybrid working that truly works. Depending on your role, you can benefit from up to 12 days of remote working per month, giving you the flexibility to focus without distractions. When you're in the office, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate, co-create, and make decisions together in unique spaces designed to help you perform at your best.

Our Milan hub is located in Rogoredo, in the Santa Giulia district, just a few minutes’ walk from Milano Rogoredo Station (M3 Rogoredo FS, regional and high-speed trains, and the suburban rail network), and is also well served by bus connections. The campus is easily accessible by car and motorbike, thanks to its convenient links to the city's main transport routes.

At the Sky Campus, you'll find two cafés, a company restaurant, the Sky Cinema, and a variety of collaborative spaces dedicated to innovation and the sharing of ideas. The surrounding area also offers a wide range of amenities, including cafés, restaurants, supermarkets, and other services

Learning and Development:

At Sky, we invest in your growth. We believe that internal mobility is a powerful driver of professional development, offering you opportunities to explore new roles and career paths across the business. Through Sky Learn, our learning platform, you will have access to continuous learning opportunities, digital content, and tailored upskilling and reskilling programmes designed to help you grow, evolve, and shape your future career.




Social Impact & Inclusion

At Sky, we believe in people. We are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone feels empowered to be themselves and reach their full potential. We actively support employee wellbeing and are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, including individuals with disabilities and protected-category status under Italian Law 68/99.

As part of this commitment, Sky hosts several employee networks, including Body & Mind, LGBTQ+, Women@Sky, and Parents & Carers. These voluntary communities bring colleagues together to share experiences and promote initiatives focused on wellbeing, inclusion, and female empowerment.

We work every day to create a positive and lasting impact on the communities around us through Sky Cares volunteering initiatives, the digital education programmes delivered by Sky Up, and the immersive company-visit experiences offered through the Academy Studios.




Why wait?

Apply now to build an extraordinary career and become part of a brilliant team. We can't wait to meet you! At Sky, ideas become experiences for millions of people.




Sky is committed to attracting and developing talent in all its forms. All applications, including those from individuals belonging to protected categories under Italian Law 68/99, will be considered in accordance with the principles of equal opportunity and inclusion, without discrimination of any kind. Sky Italia is committed to ensuring a fair, inclusive, and non-discriminatory recruitment process.

In line with this commitment and with Legislative Decree No. 96/2026, Sky Italia neither requests nor collects information regarding candidates’ previous salary, compensation, or employment classification, either during interviews or through direct contacts and/or third parties involved in the recruitment process.

Title: Data Scientist Forecasting
Description:
WHO IS ENGIE?

ENGIE puts sustainable development at the center of its activities (electricity, natural gas, energy efficiency, and services) to meet the challenges of the energy transition to a low-carbon economy: access to a sustainable economy, climate change mitigation and adaptation, and resource optimization.

ENGIE, a global leader in low-carbon energy and services, relies on its Global Business Unit Supply & Energy Management (GBU S&EM) to provide reliable, sustainable, and affordable energy to all its customers. This strategic unit optimizes the Group’s and clients’ production assets and designs tailored energy solutions for our 200,000 professional clients and 15 million consumers. The Global Business Unit Supply & Energy Management leverages ENGIE’s assets to deliver secure and sustainable energy to its B2B and B2C customers. It uses its expertise in energy management to provide decarbonized electricity 24/7.

Joining Supply & Energy Management means becoming part of a team of over 10,000 passionate experts spread across 20 countries, all united by a shared mission: shaping a greener and more efficient energy future. Together, we push the boundaries of innovation to deliver decarbonized energy 24/7. Join us and be part of those shaping the energy of tomorrow!

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

We are looking for a Forecasting Data Scientist Senior in Supply & Energy Management Italy, based in Milan.

The ideal candidate is a data-driven professional with a strong quantitative background and hands-on experience in data science and machine learning, particularly in time series forecasting. The role combines solid programming skills (Python and R) with a practical, business-oriented mindset and the ability to transform complex data into actionable insights.

He/she has curiosity for energy markets and the energy transition, along with the willingness to deepen knowledge of market design and regulatory frameworks. He/she has experience with energy supply processes, modern data platforms (e.g. Databricks, Spark), and cloud-based analytics environments. Strong communication skills and the ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-experts complete the profile.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?

As a Forecasting Data Scientist Senior, you will contribute to the development and delivery of forecasting processes and models that support the energy supply business. Under the guidance of the Digital & Portfolio Modelling Manager, you will collaborate closely with forecasting, portfolio managers, pricers, and other business stakeholders to ensure forecasting models are accurate, timely, and aligned with operational needs. Your work will be based on rigorous data collection and analysis, and will directly contribute to optimizing costing, forecasting, sourcing, and hedging strategies within a defined business mandate.

You will be actively involved in the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of forecasting tools and methodologies, ensuring alignment with global standards and contributing to their evolution. Your role will also include cross-functional collaboration within the SPM community and with data and forecasting teams in other countries to promote knowledge sharing and consistency.

You will be responsible not only for the technical development of forecasting models but also for ensuring their operational reliability and relevance to business needs. You will provide scientific expertise for bespoke analyses and contribute to the continuous improvement of forecasting practices.

Key Responsibilities


Model and Process Development: Contribute to the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of forecasting tools, models, and processes used to support the energy supply business.
Commercial Offer Support: Participate in the development of forecasting components for new commercial offers, ensuring alignment with business needs and market dynamics.
Customer Insights: Analyze customer behavior using diverse data sources to enhance forecasting accuracy and business relevance.
Data Utilization: Leverage a wide range of internal and external data sources to ensure robust and accurate portfolio and consumption representation.
Best Practices Promotion: Advocate for good practices in data handling, model development, and coding standards across the team and broader community.
Code Quality Assurance: Ensure high-quality, maintainable code by adhering to established development standards and guidelines.
Cross-Team Collaboration: Actively engage with other quantitative analysts and data scientists across teams to exchange ideas, models, data, and technical insights, fostering a collaborative and innovative environment.


About You

Personal Attributes


Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to tackle complex forecasting challenges and translate data into actionable insights.
Clear and effective communication skills, especially in explaining technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Collaborative and inclusive team player, contributing to a positive and high-performing work environment.
Creative and innovation-driven, with a passion for developing state-of-the-art forecasting models and solutions that push boundaries and anticipate future business needs.
Agile and adaptive mindset, embracing continuous improvement, iterative development, and responsiveness to changing business priorities.
Cultural intelligence, with the ability to work effectively in a multicultural and international environment, respecting diverse perspectives.


Education and professional background


Master’s degree or PhD in applied mathematics, engineering, data science, physics, economics, or a related quantitative field.
5+ years of experience in forecasting, data science, or quantitative analysis, preferably in the energy sector.
Proficient programming skills, in Python and R, with familiarity in software development best practices including version control (e.g., Git).
Knowledge of modern data science platforms and engines, such as Databricks and Spark, is a strong asset.
Experience with cloud-based analytics environments and digital tools used in forecasting and portfolio management.
Fluency in English is a must, other languages are welcome.


At ENGIE, every talent has a role to play in accelerating the energy transition. Make a difference and enjoy a fulfilling professional experience. Take on exciting challenges and build a career path that reflects who you are. Join us and be part of the adventure of the century!

Salary: The gross annual salary for the role ranges between €58.000 and €64.000, depending on experience and level of seniority.

About Engie

Working at ENGIE, a multinational group, means having a wide variety of career opportunities in more than 30 countries. Whilst putting the community at the center of your professional life and contributing to real change during a challenging career. Our commitment is clear: We support a social model that balances economic performance with positive impact on people and the planet. We bet on the power of community and act as part of a community committed to disrupting and reinventing the future. Diversity and inclusion are at the core of our corporate culture. ENGIE is committed to combating all forms of discrimination in employment, access to training and promotion. Therefore, the integration and support of youth, adults, and people with disabilities, regardless of gender, ethnicity, or religion, are key priorities of human resources policy. Recognized for 2025 by Sole24Ore as a leading company in diversity & inclusion, the ISO 30415:2021 and UNI PDR 125:2022 certifications are further proof of our commitment.

Description:
Descrizione azienda




Vuoi un mini spoiler su CPM?

Ci prendiamo cura dei maggiori brand mondiali da oltre 80 anni attraverso diverse attività, dal merchandising alle vendite, dalla consumer activation al supporto clienti fino alla formazione sul prodotto.

Questa è CPM, una realtà internazionale forte e dinamica, come le persone che ne fanno parte.

Per te, rappresenta la grande opportunità di entrare a far parte di una solida multinazionale dove formarti e sviluppare la tua carriera in un settore in crescita e in un ambiente giovane, innovativo e super stimolante.

Un’esperienza che ti metterà a contatto con i brand e le aziende più importanti in Italia.




Candidati e… magari ci vediamo a bordo!




Posizione




Ti offriamo di diventare il guru dei nostri dati.

Per te abbiamo una posizione come Data Scientist in un settore, il Field Marketing, dove la tua competenza può davvero fare la differenza.

Potrai mettere in luce le tue capacità di analisi e interpretazione del dato al servizio di tanti brand diversi. Annoiarsi? Impossibile. Lavorerai nella nostra sede di Milano in spazi di nuova generazione e potrai operare anche da casa e ovunque grazie alle nuove politiche di smart working. Perché in CPM Italy siamo convinti che i tuoi risultati passino anche attraverso la qualità della tua vita.




Ok, ma cosa farai di preciso?

Il tuo ruolo riguarderà il supporto ai progetti di vendita attraverso l’analisi dei dati, la realizzazione di report e modelli analitici, e la produzione di insight utili a supportare le decisioni di business.




Come?

realizzando report, dashboard e modelli analitici;
sviluppando e affinando modelli di analisi predittiva per supportare i progetti;
traducendo i dati in insight utili a supporto delle decisioni di business;
utilizzando tool e sistemi di Business Intelligence;
supportando l'identificazione di trend, pattern e opportunità attraverso tecniche di analisi quantitativa.




Requisiti




Sei tu la persona giusta?

Per entrare nel nostro reparto di Data Scientist è richiesta un’esperienza di almeno 1 anno in questo ruolo, oltre a un solido background in discipline quantitative come Statistica, Matematica e Data Science. Essere positivi, proattivi e precisi è un ottimo requisito ma i veri must sono la passione per i numeri e la voglia di partecipare sempre a nuove sfide.




In più è fantastico se…

ti piace trasformare dati in informazioni;
possiedi competenze di programmazione in Python e/o R;
hai esperienza nella costruzione e validazione di modelli predittivi o di machine learning;
conosci metodologie statistiche per l'analisi e l'interpretazione dei dati;
Excel è il tuo pane quotidiano;
hai una conoscenza base di PowerBI ed SQL;
ti entusiasma lavorare in team.




Altre informazioni

RAL 25.000€ - 30.000€.




Ai sensi della legge 12 Marzo 1999 n.68, Inventa CPM promuove l'inserimento e l'integrazione delle persone disabili nel mondo del lavoro, per questo motivo verranno tenute in particolare considerazione le candidature di tutti i soggetti indicati al comma 1 art.1 della succitata legge.

Title: Data Scientist – Senior Consultant
Description:
We are currently looking for an experienced Data Scientist to join our Data & Analytics team.

This position is a unique opportunity to unlock insights contained in the data universe working in a dynamic and innovative environment.

We are looking for candidates with an international background that have experience and strong knowledge in Data Analytics applications in multi-disciplinary environments that provide real-world impact for organizations.

You will be based in our office in Milan (preferably) or in Turin.

Background & Experience


Master's Degree in Statistics, Finance, Business Analytics, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science or related area
4–5 years of experience in Data & Analytics, with proven ability to design and deliver data-driven solutions in business contexts


Technical Skills


Experience in developing and applying analytical models and machine learning techniques to solve real business problems (including both predictive and exploratory approaches)
Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with modern data science libraries and frameworks
Experience working with data across the full lifecycle, from data preparation and exploration to model development and deployment
Familiarity with working in cloud-based data and AI environments (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP), leveraging advanced analytics and scalable processing capabilities (e.g. Databricks or similar platforms)
Exposure to Generative AI and LLMs, including use cases such as text analysis, content generation, or process automation
Understanding of prompt engineering principles and ability to integrate LLM-based solutions into data and analytics workflows
Awareness of best practices in model lifecycle management, reproducibility and collaboration within data teams
Ability to understand business requirements and identify the best solution to achieve the expected outcome
Ability to handle an analytical project end-to-end, from business need understanding till results presentation
Ability to communicate both in Italian and English at all levels of the Organization (other European languages will be considered as a plus)
Experience in planning and coordination of project team activities maintaining challenging and collaborative environment
Ability to contribute to the management of a team-oriented environment
Experience in guiding or coaching junior team members within project delivery contexts
Willingness to continuously learn and research on new approach and technologies related to data management and analytics
Highly self-motivated, proactive
A collaborative mindset
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills


Personal Attributes


Highly self-motivated, proactive
A collaborative mindset
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills


You will have an advantage if, additionally, you have:


Previous Consulting and/or professional services experience
Proficiency in R and/or SQL
Experience with Hadoop, Apache Spark
Experience with NLP and text mining
Data Visualization skills on some of leading BI solutions (e.g. PowerBI, Tableau, Qlik)
Ability to bridge business needs and technical implementation in data and analytics projects
Experience in identifying new business opportunities
Experience in answering to RFIs or RFPs concerning analytics topics or software selection


We want to offer you a unique experience!


You will work in an organization where no two days are the same
You will have the opportunity to work on stand-alone change management projects, or as part of a multi-disciplined team delivering a large-scale technology or organization transformation program
You will work in an international organization that is large enough to offer a wide variety of challenging opportunities, but in a local community where everyone knows your name and are always willing to offer support
You will be supported in continuously growing your career and will have the opportunity to guide and mentor junior team members, contributing to both their technical development and broader professional growth
You will work with other like-minded and creative individuals to develop new ideas that have the potential to make a real difference to the businesses we work with
You will have the opportunity to support the development of new business and service offerings
You will have the opportunity to build strong relationships with BearingPoint top management and companies you will be working with


Are you interested in discovering more about our culture? Let's take a look at our Instagramprofile

About BearingPoint

BearingPoint is an independent management and technology consultancy with European roots and a global reach. We operate in four units: Consulting, Solutions, Business Services, and Ventures. Consulting covers the advisory business; Solutions provides the tools for successful digital transformation, advanced analytics and regulatory requirements; Business Services provides managed services beyond SaaS; Ventures drives the financing and development of start-ups.

Our clients include many of the world’s leading companies and organizations. We have a global consulting network with more than 10,000 people and support clients in over 75 countries, engaging with them to achieve measurable and sustainable success.

We are guided by our purpose – Together, we are more than business.

It revolves around three key areas of focus – More innovation, more for our planet and more for our people. Our people promises – Purpose in Practice, Deeper Connections, New Flexibility, Personal and Professional Growth, and Holistic Wellbeing and Rewards, brings together our values, aspirations, and responsibilities towards our people. It helps our people achieve and accomplish more than you can imagine possible.

We can’t do this alone. We can do this together. Join us!

Interested?

If this sounds like the ideal environment for you to work, innovate and achieve our shared purpose, join our high-performing team, apply now!

Equality & Inclusion

BearingPoint is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workforce where each individual feels they belong. Fostering a work environment with a strong sense of community and where everyone can thrive is a core pillar of our business.

We are focused on attracting and retaining the best people with the right skills and the desire to deliver excellent results, regardless of background. In return, we will provide a working environment in which everyone feels valued and has the opportunity to fulfill their potential, where their talents are fully utilized, and company goals are met. We celebrate the strength that comes from our similarities and our differences through local initiatives which promote inclusion, outreach, and respect.

Interested?

Title: Customer Data Scientist | Senior Associate - Milano [ADV]
HTML:
Vuoi essere al centro di prospettive di crescita uniche?

Entra all’interno del team di Customer di PwC e diventa:

Customer Data Scientist | Senior Associate

Your Perspectives 

Ti unirai al gruppo di Customer di PwC su sfidanti progetti di Customer Advance Analytics, Data Science e Generative AI in ambito Consumer Markets, Financial Services, Energy&Utilities e Telco&Media, per supportare le organizzazioni nel valorizzare il patrimonio informativo sui propri Clienti e Consumatori finali, utilizzando i dati a disposizione per sviluppare soluzioni innovative basate su AI. 

 

Grazie all’accesso alle vaste competenze del nostro network internazionale, potrai dare spazio alle tue idee e applicare su progettualità concrete le tue conoscenze analitiche fornendo il tuo contributo innovativo. 

 

Sarai coinvolto con crescenti responsabilità nelle seguenti attività: 

  • Disegno, sviluppo, test e misurazione delle performance di modelli di Machine Learning e di modelli statistici in ambito Marketing e Sales: segmentazioni, Customer scoring, modelli di classificazione, modelli predittivi, modelli di propensione/raccomandazione; 

  • Sviluppo e implementazione di tecniche di Generative AI per la creazione di soluzioni conversazionali innovative, utilizzando tecnologie basate su Large Language Model (LLM) e framework quali il Retrieval Augmented Generator (RAG). 

  • Analisi dati avanzate sul comportamento dei Clienti sia su canali fisici che digitali attraverso esplorazione di dati strutturati e non strutturati, al fine di ottenere insight di business;  

  • Sviluppo di analisi quantitative e modelli di Machine Learning a supporto di progettualità di data-driven Strategy & Decision Making, 

  • Raccolta dei requisiti progettuali a diretto contatto con il cliente per il disegno e l’implementazione di soluzioni data-driven ed AI-driven; 

 

Your unique strengths 

  • Possiedi una laurea magistrale preferibilmente ad indirizzo ingegneristico o scientifico (es. Data Science, Ingegneria Informatica, Ingegneria Matematica, Informatica, Statistica, Matematica, Fisica); 

  • Hai maturato esperienza di 3-4 anni in Aziende Leader nel proprio mercato di riferimento o in primarie Società di consulenza all’interno di progetti di Advance Analytics e Data Science in ambito Marketing; 

  • Hai un’ottima conoscenza del linguaggio Python; 

  • Possiedi una buona conoscenza dei database relazionali e del linguaggio SQL; 

  • Sei esperto nell’utilizzo di piattaforme Cloud come AWS, Azure e GCP; 

  • Conosci tecnologie basate su Large Language Model (LLM) e tecniche di Generative AI (RAG o PEFT) per lo sviluppo di applicazioni; nonché sperimentazione di framework agentici più avanzati (LangChain, AutoGen); 

  • Hai forti competenze analitiche e ti interessa usare i dati per trovare soluzioni funzionali, creative ed innovative a problemi complessi; 

  • Parli e scrivi in inglese fluentemente; 

  • Le tue ottime capacità relazionali e comunicative ti permettono di instaurare rapporti di fiducia con i clienti; 

  • Ti interessa lavorare in team, coordinare gruppi di lavoro, crescere professionalmente in un ambiente dinamico, stimolante e positivo; 

Per questa opportunità è previsto un inserimento con contratto al 1° livello CCNL Commercio con una retribuzione indicativa tra 36.000€-50.000€, la cui determinazione finale sarà definita anche in base alla valutazione delle tue competenze ed esperienze pregresse. In aggiunta, è prevista una componente variabile legata alla performance fino a un massimo del 10% della retribuzione.

Entrare in PwC significa anche poter contare su un ecosistema di iniziative e benefit pensati per supportare benessere, crescita e work-life integration, tra cui:

• Buoni pasto del valore di 8€
• Assicurazione sanitaria integrativa, estendibile ai familiari
• Piano welfare dedicato
• Programmi e iniziative di wellbeing
• Convenzioni

JAKALA è un'azienda che lavora su dati, intelligenza artificiale e sviluppo di esperienze per generare un impatto significativo e duraturo a livello globale.

Presenti in oltre 30 città in 21 paesi, i nostri team uniscono competenze su strategia, tecnologia, creatività e operations per offrire esperienze personalizzate e soluzioni trasformative ai nostri clienti, grazie al supporto di dati e intelligenza artificiale. I Jakalers sono un gruppo eterogeneo di oltre 3.000 persone, animate da passione, ambizione e idee brillanti. Proprio questa combinazione unica di talenti è il fattore distintivo che ha ispirato il nostro purpose: Together to get there.

Creare un mondo migliore è il nostro obiettivo ultimo: la nostra ambizione è generare valore per tutti i nostri stakeholder in modo sostenibile, con particolare attenzione a etica, clima e qualità. Nel 2021, abbiamo scelto di diventare una Società Benefit, dimostrando il nostro impegno di lungo periodo e la volontà di proteggere i principi e i valori che ogni giorno guidano le nostre azioni.

Crediamo che la diversità sia la chiave del nostro successo e, per questo, siamo impegnati a creare un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, dove ciascuno possa sentirsi valorizzato per la propria unicità. Tutte le nostre opportunità di lavoro sono aperte ai candidati appartenenti alle categorie protette L.68/99.




Scopri il team J-Science

Ti appassionano i dati, l’intelligenza artificiale e il linguaggio naturale? Nel team J-Science di JAKALA lavoriamo ogni giorno per trasformare queste tecnologie in soluzioni concrete e ad alto impatto per le aziende.

Siamo un centro di eccellenza con sedi a Milano, Torino, Rende e Roma, e ci occupiamo di Data Science, Location Intelligence, Large Natural Language Models e sviluppo di piattaforme, progettando software avanzati con tecnologia all'avanguardia.

Dall’AI applicata a testo e voce alla semantic search, passando per speech technology e predictive analytics: innoviamo per creare valore reale e accessibile, in contesti complessi e sfidanti.




🎯 Le tue responsabilità:

Sviluppo di soluzioni innovative di AI ad alto impatto strategico per grandi imprese di diversi settori, anche a livello internazionale
Sviluppo e realizzazione di soluzioni enterprise in ambito Advanced Analytics con particolare riferimento alla integrazione di componenti e\o servizi di intelligenza artificiale, prevalentemente generativa.
Partecipazione a team di progetti composti da un mix di talenti con esperienza in data science, machine learning e AI




🙌 Se ti riconosci in queste caratteristiche, potremmo essere il perfetto match:

Laurea preferibilmente in materie scientifiche (Data Science, Ingegneria, Statistica, Big
Data Analytics, Matematica o affini)
Conoscenza di python e di alcune delle principali librerie per la manipolazione dei dati e lo sviluppo di modelli di machine learning
Interesse per le tematiche di NLP e AI Generativa
Conoscenza basica e interesse verso i principali cloud provider (Azure, AWS, GCP)
Buona conoscenza della Suite Microsoft Office
Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese
Passione per i dati e ottime capacità analitiche
Buona capacità di problem setting e problem solving
Buone capacità relazionali e comunicative
Attitudine al team working




💜 Scopri nel video le ragioni per cui scegliere JAKALA come prossimo step di carriera

In JAKALA crediamo che il tempo e il benessere delle persone vadano rispettati, sempre: incoraggiamo una presenza in ufficio di 10 giorni al mese.
Il nostro sistema di Total Reward include convenzioni esclusive per viaggi, ristoranti, shopping, palestra e tempo libero, oltre a servizi gratuiti di telemedicina e supporto psicologico, pensati per te e per chi ami.
Investire nel nostro processo di selezione significa ricevere supporto autentico: un Recruiter dedicato ti accompagnerà con feedback personalizzati, consigli di carriera e insight sul tuo CV, a prescindere dall’esito della candidatura. Niente AI, solo persone. E, grazie all’iniziativa Your Time Back, ti restituiamo il tempo investito nei colloqui con un percorso di empowerment firmato Unobravo.




💰 Retribuzione

Per questa posizione la RAL prevista è compresa tra 25.000 € e 36.000 € lordi annui.

La proposta retributiva sarà definita all’interno di questa fascia in base all’esperienza, alle competenze maturate e al livello di seniority coerente con il ruolo, applicando criteri oggettivi e neutrali. Si applica il CCNL Commercio - Terziario.




🌱 Ready to start?

Non è solo una candidatura. È un percorso che comincia ora. Inviaci il tuo CV: non vediamo l’ora di conoscerti!

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Tecnomat, con i suoi oltre 30 negozi, è l'azienda leader in Italia nella vendita di prodotti tecnici professionali di uso corrente e di finitura per la manutenzione, ristrutturazione e costruzione dell’habitat.

COSA CI CARATTERIZZA

L'attenzione ai clienti e l'ambiente informale sono le chiavi del nostro successo. Condividere un progetto chiaro favorisce il gioco di squadra attraverso l'iniziativa e l'autonomia personale.

Creiamo una spirale positiva tra la nostra soddisfazione, quella del cliente e quella del territorio dove contribuiamo a generare un impatto positivo sull’ambiente e sulle comunità.

Ti piacerebbe far parte di questo progetto?

Con L’obiettivo Di Fare Crescere La Squadra Data-performance, Creata Per Supportare La Vendita, i Processi Decisionali Sui Negozi e Diffondere Una Cultura Orientata Ai Dati, Abbiamo La Necessità Di Inserire Un/a

DATA SCIENTIST

Lavoriamo a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder business per comprenderne gli obiettivi e definire come i dati possano raggiungerli, applicando approcci matematici, statistici e soluzioni di AI. Trasformiamo idee ed esigenze in prototipi da testare e iterare, collaborando fianco a fianco con i team di Data Engineering e Software Development per rilasciare soluzioni solide e capaci di generare un impatto reale. Entrando nella squadra, la tua responsabilità sarà tradurre i fabbisogni aziendali negli approcci analitici più efficaci, rendendo i dati vere e proprie leve decisionali.

I Tuoi Principali Obiettivi Saranno


sviluppare soluzioni di ricerca operativa / ottimizzazione matematica, seguendone tutto il ciclo di vita: formalizzazione matematica del problema, scelta e implementazione dell'approccio più idoneo (programmazione Lineare/Mista intera, algoritmi euristici e meta-euristici), presentazione dei risultati e monitoraggio in produzione
monitorare e far evolvere le soluzioni interne esistenti di Ricerca Operativa, intervenendo su ambiti decisionali chiave come la pianificazione dei turni del personale e l'ottimizzazione dei flussi logistici
sviluppare modelli di Machine Learning end-to-end, dalla definizione dei task e analisi esplorativa fino a validazione e presentazione, con un focus particolare su Time Series Analysis / Forecasting e Regressioni
scrivere codice Python pulito, modulare, efficiente e documentato in ottica collaborativa
acquisire una solida padronanza dell'architettura dati Tecnomat per velocizzare il reperimento delle informazioni e collaborare con il team di Data Engineering alla progettazione di modelli dati volti a esporre e rendere facilmente fruibili i risultati delle soluzioni di Data Science e Ottimizzazione


Avrai Inoltre L’opportunità Di


confrontarti con casi d'uso di Generative AI: partecipare a progetti su ottimizzazione di contenuti in chiave SEO, sviluppo di sistemi di Evaluation, Monitoring e Feedback Loop per soluzioni GenAI in produzione o in via di sviluppo
generare impatto strategico sui dati aziendali: utilizzare competenze statistiche e quantitative per estrarre pattern dai principali indicatori finanziari, supportando gli stakeholder interni in analisi strategiche legate all'evoluzione dello stock, all'ottimizzazione dei flussi di cassa e alle performance di business.


E’ L’OPPORTUNITA’ GIUSTA PER TE SE


hai una laurea in materie matematico-statistiche o titoli equipollenti
hai un’esperienza di 2-3 anni in ruoli analoghi e una solida base teorica e pratica in Ricerca Operativa
hai una forte passione per la matematica applicata, in particolare per la Ricerca Operativa e machine learning
hai passione per la programmazione e possiedi una solida conoscenza di Python
hai conoscenze pregresse nell'interrogazione di database (SQL), strumenti di versioning (Git) e familiarità con ambienti Cloud (Google Cloud Platform)
la conoscenza di DevOps / MLOps, containerizzazione (docker), restful APIs, ci/cd costituisce un plus
ti caratterizzano un'ottima capacità di leggere il contesto di business e spiccate doti relazionali
ami il lavoro di squadra, sei curioso e hai spirito d’iniziativa
nutri una forte curiosità per il mondo retail e desideri applicare un approccio data-driven per ottimizzare la gestione dei punti vendita
hai una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese.


COSA ABBIAMO PENSATO PER TE


esposizione diretta a un'ampia gamma di problemi tecnici e strategici su cui fare la differenza
l'opportunità di costruire sistemi di AI pratici ed efficaci, collaborando e condividendo soluzioni all'interno dell'ecosistema internazionale del Gruppo ADEO
accesso a tool di AI-assistant (Gemini, Github Copilot) e tempo dedicato alla sperimentazione e all'esplorazione di nuove tecnologie e approcci
un piano di formazione continua, in aula, on the job e in digitale, anche grazie a una piattaforma dedicata
un piano di welfare aziendale che va dal piano di assicurazione sanitaria al supporto psicologico on line
un portale di convenzioni dedicate, che spaziano dal noleggio auto, viaggi, al tempo libero
momenti in cui celebriamo i successi e gli eventi importanti perché i traguardi raggiunti sono frutto dell’impegno di tutti
un clima di lavoro informale, in cui ognuno è accolto e valorizzato nella propria unicità.


COSA OFFRIAMO


contratto a tempo indeterminato, con inquadramento a partire dal 2° livello del CCNL Distribuzione Moderna Organizzata. Per questa posizione è prevista una RAL a partire da € 35.000. Le condizioni finali saranno commisurate all'effettiva esperienza e competenze del candidato, in coerenza con le policy aziendali
smart working al 40%
entrata/uscita flessibili
premi legati al progresso trimestrale dei risultati economici e al risultato annuale dell'azienda, sviluppati grazie al contributo di tutti e al lavoro di squadra, accessibili dal settimo mese di assunzione.


Luogo di lavoro: Ibrido/Segrate (MI)

In Tecnomat viviamo nel rispetto reciproco, nello spirito di squadra e nell'inclusione come via per fare della nostra azienda una comunità di valore. Formiamo ogni nuovo collega sul nostro Codice Etico di condotta, per essere trasparenti e coerenti sul modo di "stare" insieme. Incoraggiamo le persone ad essere loro stesse e alimentiamo la consapevolezza sui temi della diversità, equità e inclusione, attraverso la formazione continua.

La ricerca rispetta il d.lgs. 198/2006 ed è aperta a persone di qualsiasi orientamento o espressione di genere.

Per qualsiasi richiesta di supporto, contattaci all'indirizzo: selezione@tecnomat.it

  • hai conoscenze pregresse nell'interrogazione di database (SQL), strumenti di versioning (Git) e familiarità con ambienti Cloud (Google Cloud Platform)
  • la conoscenza di DevOps / MLOps, containerizzazione (docker), restful APIs, ci/cd costituisce un plus
  • ti caratterizzano un'ottima capacità di leggere il contesto di business e spiccate doti relazionali
  • ami il lavoro di squadra, sei curioso e hai spirito d’iniziativa
  • nutri una forte curiosità per il mondo retail e desideri applicare un approccio data-driven per ottimizzare la gestione dei punti vendita
  • hai una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese.

COSA ABBIAMO PENSATO PER TE

  • esposizione diretta a un'ampia gamma di problemi tecnici e strategici su cui fare la differenza
  • l'opportunità di costruire sistemi di AI pratici ed efficaci, collaborando e condividendo soluzioni all'interno dell'ecosistema internazionale del Gruppo ADEO
  • accesso a tool di AI-assistant (Gemini, Github Copilot) e tempo dedicato alla sperimentazione e all'esplorazione di nuove tecnologie e approcci
  • un piano di formazione continua, in aula, on the job e in digitale, anche grazie a una piattaforma dedicata
  • un piano di welfare aziendale che va dal piano di assicurazione sanitaria al supporto psicologico on line
  • un portale di convenzioni dedicate, che spaziano dal noleggio auto, viaggi, al tempo libero
  • momenti in cui celebriamo i successi e gli eventi importanti perché i traguardi raggiunti sono frutto dell’impegno di tutti
  • un clima di lavoro informale, in cui ognuno è accolto e valorizzato nella propria unicità.

COSA OFFRIAMO

  • contratto a tempo indeterminato, con inquadramento a partire dal 2° livello del CCNL Distribuzione Moderna Organizzata. Per questa posizione è prevista una RAL a partire da € 35.000. Le condizioni finali saranno commisurate all'effettiva esperienza e competenze del candidato, in coerenza con le policy aziendali

Title: EXPERT POWER QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS AND PREDICTIVE ANALYTICS (IT)
Description:
Job Description

Come Expert Power Quantitative Analysis and Predictive Analytics farai parte della Direzione Global Natural Resources di Eni, in particolare entrerai a far parte del business Power Generation & Marketing. Il tuo team si occuperà di sviluppare modelli, strumenti e analisi data-driven nel contesto del mercato italiano dell’energia elettrica.

Attività Principali


Sviluppare, implementare e manutenere modelli quantitativi relativi alle attività di Risk Management, Asset Management, Portfolio Management e Trading
Contribuire allo sviluppo di modelli di ottimizzazione per la gestione a mercato del parco produttivo elettrico di Eni
Sviluppare modelli di previsione dei prezzi dell’energia elettrica e delle principali variabili di mercato
Realizzare analisi quantitative, statistiche e data-driven per interpretare le dinamiche del mercato elettrico italiano e l’evoluzione dei fondamentali
Sviluppare modelli previsionali per i consumi elettrici di grandi clienti industriali
Elaborare metodologie e strumenti di pricing B2B, integrando analisi profili di consumo, rischio, marginalità e scenari di mercato
Contribuire alla costruzione di strumenti analitici, dashboard, librerie e workflow in Python, con l’obiettivo di rendere i processi quantitativi dell’unità più scalabili, robusti e replicabili
Produrre analisi quantitative per lo sviluppo di nuovi business, iniziative strategiche e progetti speciali
Analisi di lungo periodo, anche di contenuto quantitativo-economico, relative a:


meccanismi regolatori

evoluzione di mercati

player nazionali e internazionali

Finalizzate a


definire la partecipazione in progetti e contrattualizzazioni di lungo termine
sviluppare il piano strategico di lungo periodo e supportare le attività di business development
definire pricing e condizioni di contratti di lungo termine


Caratteristiche Richieste


Laurea magistrale in Matematica, Fisica, Data Science oppure Economia con indirizzo quantitativo; potranno essere presi in considerazione titoli di studio differenti, anche inferiori, a valle di significativa esperienza nell’ambito
Esperienza di almeno 3 anni maturata in ruoli analoghi, costituirà condizione preferenziale una buona conoscenza del settore elettrico o dottorato di ricerca in materie quantitative
Buona capacità di programmazione in Python, con esperienza nello sviluppo di codice orientato all’analisi quantitativa
Solida conoscenza di metodi matematici, statistici e probabilistici applicati a serie storiche, forecasting, ottimizzazione e analisi dati
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese
Disponibilità alla mobilità nazionale e internazionale


Completano Il Profilo


Familiarità con database SQL, cloud environment, strumenti di versioning e pratiche di sviluppo collaborativo
Conoscenza di metodologie di finanza quantitativa, modelli stocastici, risk modelling o valuation
Esperienza nello sviluppo di modelli di machine learning applicati a forecasting, anomaly detection, clustering o scenari di mercato
Esperienza nell’analisi quantitativa del mercato elettrico italiano e/o europeo


Sede

San Donato Milanese

Promuoviamo forme flessibili di lavoro, offrendo opzioni di Smart working ed orari flessibili al fine di sostenere il maggior equilibrio tra vita professionale e personale.

Proponiamo


Contratto di lavoro a Tempo Indeterminato
Il nostro contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro di riferimento è il CCNL Energia e Petrolio
Proponiamo una retribuzione annua lorda compresa tra 48.000 e 56.000 euro
L’offerta finale sarà formulata in coerenza con l’esperienza professionale, le competenze tecniche e trasversali possedute dalla risorsa funzionali per il ruolo e apprezzabili per l’azienda
L’Azienda in presenza di esperienze professionali e competenze tecniche e trasversali particolarmente rilevanti potrà valutare un’offerta con un livello di inquadramento/RAL migliorativo
Sistema di reward e programma articolato di benefits e iniziative di welfare in ambito sanitario, previdenziale, di supporto al reddito e per la conciliazione vita-lavoro. Scopri di più: link welfare
Ambiente di lavoro in cui ogni risorsa possa sentirsi riconosciuta e apprezzata nella propria unicità


Le candidature ritenute di maggior interesse saranno contattate per le fasi successive.

Per informazioni sul processo di selezione e consigli utili puoi cliccare qui .

Eni è una società integrata lungo l’intera catena del valore e impegnata con azioni concrete a fornire energia sempre più sicura, diversificata e a emissioni progressivamente ridotte.

Il modello di business punta alla creazione di valore di lungo termine per tutti gli stakeholder.
