Title: Graduate data scientist
Description:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilities
Design and improve data pipelines. Contribute to the design and evolution of data systems—ensuring data is accurate, reliable, and efficiently processed across diverse tech stacks.
Ensure data correctness and scalability. Work closely with software engineers to validate data, define metrics, and improve the robustness of reporting and analytics systems.
Develop internal data products and tooling. Help build scalable solutions (e.g., reporting engines, forecasting tools) used by product teams across the company.
Support platform-wide decision-making. Partner with multiple teams to provide the analytical and modeling backbone for business planning and performance tracking.
Leverage AI to accelerate work and uncover insights. Use AI tools to move faster, surface ideas and opportunities, and study competing products and trends.


What we look for
Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.


What we offer
Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.
Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.


Commitment & contract
Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location
Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland).

The selection process
In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply
If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

Title: Data & AI Consultant - New Graduate
Description:
Vorresti iniziare la tua carriera professionale in un contesto multinazionale, altamente specializzato ed innovativo?

Stiamo ricercando profili neolaureati in Fisica, Matematica, Statistica, Data Science, Ingegneria Matematica, Ingegneria Fisica o discipline quantitative affini per il nostro team di consulenza in ambito Data & Artificial Intelligence.

Il/la candidato/a lavorerà su progetti di alto profilo in ambito Data & Artificial Intelligence, contribuendo all’analisi e valorizzazione dei dati, alla progettazione di soluzioni di Machine Learning e Intelligenza Artificiale e alla realizzazione di iniziative di trasformazione data-driven, con l’obiettivo di generare valore concreto per clienti e organizzazioni.

Il Tuo Contributo In Questo Ruolo


Analizzare dataset complessi, individuando pattern, correlazioni e insight utili al business e ai processi decisionali.
Contribuire alla preparazione, trasformazione e qualità dei dati necessari alle analisi e ai modelli.
Supportare lo sviluppo e la sperimentazione di modelli di Machine Learning, AI generativa e soluzioni data-driven.
Collaborare alla progettazione di prototipi e use case, traducendo problemi complessi in approcci quantitativi e implementabili.
Lavorare con team multidisciplinari, contribuendo alla raccolta dei requisiti, alla validazione dei risultati e alla presentazione degli insight.
Documentare analisi, modelli e risultati in modo chiaro, strutturato e riproducibile.



Il Profilo Ideale


Laurea magistrale, conseguita o in fase di conseguimento, in Fisica, Matematica, Statistica, Data Science, Ingegneria Matematica, Ingegneria Fisica o discipline quantitative affini.
Solida preparazione in matematica, statistica, probabilità e metodi quantitativi.
Conoscenza di almeno un linguaggio di programmazione per l’analisi dei dati, preferibilmente Python.
Capacità di affrontare problemi complessi con approccio analitico, strutturato e orientato alla sperimentazione.
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese.
Attitudine al lavoro in team, curiosità, capacità di apprendimento e interesse concreto per Data & Artificial Intelligence.



Nice To Have


Conoscenza di SQL e dei principali concetti di database e data processing.
Esperienza, anche accademica, con librerie e framework di Machine Learning/Data Science.
Conoscenza di base di Large Language Model, Generative AI o sistemi agentici.
Familiarità con piattaforme cloud e strumenti per l’analisi o la visualizzazione dei dati.
Tesi, project work, hackathon o progetti personali su dati, Machine Learning o Intelligenza Artificiale.



Sede di lavoro

Milano, Roma, Napoli, Bari. P ossibilità di modalità di lavoro Ibrida (Smart Working).

Costruisci il tuo futuro con NTT DATA.

Entra a far parte di un’azienda globale, leader nei servizi di business e tecnologici, che ascolta la tua voce e riconosce il valore del tuo lavoro. Collaborerai con clienti, partner e colleghi di tutto il mondo per creare soluzioni innovative capaci di avere un impatto reale sulla società. Qui potrai sviluppare nuove competenze e ampliare il tuo network.

Siamo presenti in Italia con oltre 6000 dipendenti a Milano, Roma, Torino, Genova, Bologna, Treviso, Pisa, Padova, Napoli, Cosenza, Bari e Salerno.

Make this the place where you grow.

Unisciti a noi!

Il/la candidato/a lavorerà su progetti di alto profilo in ambito Data & Artificial Intelligence, contribuendo all’analisi e valorizzazione dei dati, alla progettazione di soluzioni di Machine Learning e Intelligenza Artificiale e alla realizzazione di iniziative di trasformazione data-driven, con l’obiettivo di generare valore concreto per clienti e organizzazioni.

Il Tuo Contributo In Questo Ruolo

  • Analizzare dataset complessi, individuando pattern, correlazioni e insight utili al business e ai processi decisionali.
  • Contribuire alla preparazione, trasformazione e qualità dei dati necessari alle analisi e ai modelli.
  • Supportare lo sviluppo e la sperimentazione di modelli di Machine Learning, AI generativa e soluzioni data-driven.
  • Collaborare alla progettazione di prototipi e use case, traducendo problemi complessi in approcci quantitativi e implementabili.
  • Lavorare con team multidisciplinari, contribuendo alla raccolta dei requisiti, alla validazione dei risultati e alla presentazione degli insight.
  • Documentare analisi, modelli e risultati in modo chiaro, strutturato e riproducibile.


Il Profilo Ideale

  • Laurea magistrale, conseguita o in fase di conseguimento, in Fisica, Matematica, Statistica, Data Science, Ingegneria Matematica, Ingegneria Fisica o discipline quantitative affini.
  • Solida preparazione in matematica, statistica, probabilità e metodi quantitativi.
  • Conoscenza di almeno un linguaggio di programmazione per l’analisi dei dati, preferibilmente Python.
  • Capacità di affrontare problemi complessi con approccio analitico, strutturato e orientato alla sperimentazione.
  • Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese.
  • Attitudine al lavoro in team, curiosità, capacità di apprendimento e interesse concreto per Data & Artificial Intelligence.


Nice To Have

  • Conoscenza di SQL e dei principali concetti di database e data processing.
  • Esperienza, anche accademica, con librerie e framework di Machine Learning/Data Science.
  • Conoscenza di base di Large Language Model, Generative AI o sistemi agentici.
  • Familiarità con piattaforme cloud e strumenti per l’analisi o la visualizzazione dei dati.
  • Tesi, project work, hackathon o progetti personali su dati, Machine Learning o Intelligenza Artificiale.

Milano, Roma, Napoli, Bari. P ossibilità di modalità di lavoro Ibrida (Smart Working).

Make this the place where you grow.

Description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you'll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world's toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

Description

Join our team at Thermo Fisher Scientific as a Data Scientist III within the Data Science Center of Excellence.

In this role, you will help design, build, and operate the enterprise platform that enables scalable data science and AI solutions across the organization. Working at the intersection of analytics, software engineering, and cloud infrastructure, you will partner closely with Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Product Managers, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, production-ready capabilities that generate measurable business value.

This role combines advanced analytics with platform engineering and operational excellence. In addition to developing machine learning and AI solutions, you will contribute to the automation, orchestration, monitoring, and support of the data science platform. You will help establish engineering best practices that enable reliable, scalable, and maintainable production workloads.

As part of a multidisciplinary technical team, you will contribute to the operational health, reliability, and continuous improvement of the enterprise data science platform. Working closely with Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Product Managers, and technical leadership, you will help ensure production solutions are scalable, resilient, and well-supported throughout their lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Design & Delivery


Design, develop, and deploy machine learning, AI, and advanced analytics solutions that address commercial and operational business needs.
Translate business requirements into scalable analytical solutions and actionable recommendations.
Partner with Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Product Managers, and business stakeholders to design technical solutions that balance business value, scalability, and maintainability.
Apply statistical analysis, machine learning, and AI techniques to solve complex business problems and deliver measurable outcomes.


Platform Engineering & Automation


Build and maintain reusable data science components, automated workflows, and production pipelines using Databricks, Spark, and AWS.
Develop workflow orchestration, deployment automation, and operational tooling that improve platform efficiency, reliability, and reduce manual effort.
Contribute to platform architecture, engineering standards, and technical best practices supporting enterprise AI solutions.
Collaborate with Data Engineers to integrate analytical solutions into production systems and enterprise data platforms.


Platform Operations & Engineering


Contribute to the operation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of the enterprise data science platform.
Collaborate with the broader technical team to maintain reliable production pipelines, scheduled workflows, and deployed machine learning solutions.
Investigate production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement improvements that increase platform reliability, observability, and operational efficiency.
Participate in release activities, disaster recovery planning, and operational readiness to support resilient production systems.


Collaboration & Technical Leadership


Partner closely with Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Product Managers, and technical leadership to design scalable, maintainable solutions.
Communicate technical concepts, solution designs, and analytical findings to both technical and business audiences.
Contribute to documentation, code quality, knowledge sharing, and engineering best practices across the Data Science Center of Excellence.
Stay current with emerging technologies and recommend improvements that strengthen the team's capabilities and platform.


Requirements

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
3+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning engineering, analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
Experience developing and deploying production data science or analytics solutions.
Hands-on experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, and AWS.
Experience building or supporting data pipelines, automated workflows, or production data platforms.
Experience with workflow orchestration, automation, or job scheduling.
Experience monitoring, troubleshooting, and supporting production systems.
Experience with Git/GitHub and modern software development practices.
Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.


Preferred Qualifications


Master's or PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field and 2+ years of relevant professional experience.
Experience building recommendation systems or AI-enabled commercial solutions.
Experience with MLflow and machine learning lifecycle management.
Familiarity with Salesforce data models and CRM workflows.
Experience implementing CI/CD, infrastructure automation, or MLOps practices.
Experience supporting cloud-based analytics platforms in a production environment.
Experience working in life sciences, healthcare, or other regulated industries.

Title: Data scientist
Description:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilities
Design and improve data pipelines. Contribute to the design and evolution of data systems—ensuring data is accurate, reliable, and efficiently processed across diverse tech stacks.
Ensure data correctness and scalability. Work closely with software engineers to validate data, define metrics, and improve the robustness of reporting and analytics systems.
Develop internal data products and tooling. Help build scalable solutions (e.g., reporting engines, forecasting tools) used by product teams across the company.
Support platform-wide decision-making. Partner with multiple teams to provide the analytical and modeling backbone for business planning and performance tracking.
Leverage AI to accelerate work and uncover insights. Use AI tools to move faster, surface ideas and opportunities, and study competing products and trends.


What we look for
Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.


What we offer
Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.
Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.


Commitment & contract
Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location
Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland).

The selection process
In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply
If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

Title: Data & AI Specialist
Description:
Data & AI Specialist 

La tua sfida 

Datwave è la società del gruppo Bip focalizzata su tecnologie Google Cloud Platform (GCP), spin-off di Bip xTech nata per offrire soluzioni avanzate di AI, Cloud, Data Analytics e Martech. 
Operiamo con un team altamente specializzato per aiutare le aziende a sfruttare il valore dei dati e dell’intelligenza artificiale per migliorare le strategie di marketing e customer engagement. 

Datwave sta cercando un Data & AI Specialist appassionato di dati, modelli AI e delle loro applicazioni concrete sul business per il proprio team di Data Analytics, BI & Business Analysis.

La tua sfida sarà supportare l'azienda nel percorso di adozione dell’intelligenza artificiale attraverso la realizzazione di soluzioni AI azionabili e integrate nei processi esistenti.

Il tuo ruolo 

In questo ruolo, non ti limiterai a sviluppare modelli, ma lavorerai a stretto contatto con i dati per estrarre valore concreto e generare insight strategici per il business.

Sarai responsabile della progettazione e dello sviluppo di modelli avanzati per comprendere e predire le dinamiche di business, ottimizzando le strategie data-driven. Progetterai soluzioni di Artificial Intelligence (AI) scalabili e distribuite per specifici casi d'uso.

Collaborerai a stretto contatto con altre figure come Cloud & Data Architect, Data Engineer e Business Analyst per sviluppare soluzioni di AI Generativa & Machine Learning, portando gli insight in produzione con architetture scalabili.

Chi stiamo cercando 

Una persona curiosa, motivata e con un mindset analitico, capace di lavorare in team e di affrontare sfide nuove con entusiasmo. 

Requisiti richiesti 


Formazione: Laurea specialistica in Ingegneria Informatica, Data Science, Informatica, Statistica, Matematica o discipline affini (STEM). 
Esperienza: Esperienza pregressa di almeno 3 anni in ruoli di Data Science o sviluppo software focalizzato sui dati. 
Programmazione: Conoscenza avanzata di Python ed esperienza nello sviluppo software in almeno un linguaggio tra: Python, Scala, Java o NodeJs. 
Database & SQL: Conoscenza avanzata di SQL per l'interrogazione, la gestione e la modellazione dei dati , sia in ambito transazionale che analito , incluse attività di ETL.
AI & Machine Learning:
Esperienza consolidata nell'applicazione di soluzioni AI (inclusa Generative AI) e nello sviluppo di modelli di AI avanzati.
Ottima conoscenza dei concetti, algoritmi e metodologie di Machine Learning e Generative AI.
Competenza nella Context Engineering (Prompt Engineering) per ottimizzare l'integrazione dei modelli AI (LLM) nei sistemi software. 
Buona conoscenza di librerie Python come Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow o PyTorch. 
Cloud (GCP): Competenza sulla piattaforma Google Cloud, in particolare su:
Vertex AI per il training, fine-tuning e deployment di modelli AI. 
BigQuery per analisi avanzate su grandi volumi di dati. 
BigQuery ML per integrare modelli AI nei flussi di analisi. 
Altro:
Esperienza nel disegno di soluzioni software e nell’implementazione di algoritmi e strutture dati. 
Esperienza con strumenti di version control (es. Git). 
Conoscenza fluente di italiano e inglese professionali. 



Requisiti plus 



Data Visualization: Conoscenza di strumenti di Data Visualization e BI (es. Looker, Power BI, Tableau).
RAG & Vector DB: Conoscenza approfondita e esperienza pratica con Vector Database (es. Pinecone, ChromaDB) e relative pipeline di RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). 
Architetture: Esperienza nello sviluppo di applicazioni distribuite e architetture a microservizi. 
AI Coding: Esperienza pratica con strumenti di coding assistito da AI (es. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code). 
Integrazione AI: Esperienza nell’integrazione di modelli di AI Generativa (es. Large Language Models, NLP, Vision AI). 
DevOps: Conoscenza di Terraform e di stack di observability. 
Modellistica: Esperienza pregressa con modelli di ottimizzazione o profilazione (es. NBA/NBO models, modelli di attribuzione, dynamic profiling).


Cosa offriamo / What we offer

La retribuzione prevista per questa posizione è compresa tra € 34.000 e € 48.000 lordi annui, in funzione dell'esperienza, delle competenze e del livello di seniority del candidato.

 L'inquadramento sarà definito durante il processo di selezione sulla base del profilo individuato e nel rispetto della normativa e del CCNL Metalmeccanici Industria

La retribuzione indicata si riferisce alla sola RAL (Retribuzione Annua Lorda).

Il pacchetto complessivo può includere ulteriori componenti variabili, correlate al raggiungimento di specifici obiettivi individuali e/o aziendali, welfare e benefit aziendali. La proposta economica finale sarà definita in base alle caratteristiche del profilo selezionato e alla coerenza con i requisiti della posizione.

Perché unirti a Datwave 

Lavorerai su progetti innovativi per grandi brand nei settori retail, telco, banking e travel 

Avrai la possibilità di formarti su tecnologie Google Cloud e metodologie avanzate di AI & Martech 

Farai parte di una community giovane e in crescita, che valorizza la sperimentazione e l’apprendimento continuo 

Potrai contribuire in prima persona all’evoluzione di soluzioni AI-driven per il marketing del futuro 

Se vuoi crescere in un contesto dinamico, imparare da esperti del settore e portare l’AI nel mondo del marketing, Datwave è il posto giusto per te!

Title: Data Scientist / AI Engineer - MILANO
Description:
Fincantieri è uno dei principali complessi cantieristici al mondo, l’unico attivo in tutti i settori della navalmeccanica ad alta tecnologia. È leader nella realizzazione e trasformazione di unità da crociera, militari e offshore nei comparti oil & gas ed eolico, oltre che nella produzione di sistemi e componenti, nell’offerta di servizi post-vendita e nelle soluzioni di arredamento navale. Grazie alle capacità sviluppate nella gestione di progetti complessi il Gruppo vanta referenze di eccellenza nelle infrastrutture, ed è operatore di riferimento nel digitale e nella cybersecurity, nell’elettronica e sistemistica avanzata. Con oltre 230 anni di storia e più di 7.000 navi costruite, Fincantieri mantiene il proprio know-how e i centri direzionali in Italia, dove impiega 10.000 dipendenti e attiva circa 90.000 posti di lavoro, che raddoppiano su scala mondiale in virtù di una rete produttiva di 18 stabilimenti in tre continenti e oltre 21.000 lavoratori diretti.




Il gruppo Manpower in collaborazione con Fincantieri cerca un/una Data Scientist / AI Engineer.

La missione del ruolo è trasformare dati e processi in insight e soluzioni AI concretamente utilizzabili, combinando data science, machine learning, LLM e agenti per supportare decisioni, automazione e produttività.







Responsabilità principali

Analizzare dataset complessi e di grandi dimensioni, identificando pattern, KPI, anomalie e insight a supporto delle decisioni.
Sviluppare modelli statistici e di machine learning, dalla preparazione dei dati alla validazione dei risultati.
Progettare e prototipare soluzioni basate su LLM e Agentic AI, incluse architetture RAG, orchestrazione multi-agent, tool use e integrazione con fonti dati e servizi.
Analizzare processi e use case, trasformando bisogni di business in requisiti esecutivi, soluzioni implementabili e criteri di valore misurabili.
Realizzare automazioni e assistenti tramite Microsoft Power Automate e Copilot Studio, collaborando con team tecnici e stakeholder di business.
Comunicare analisi, risultati e raccomandazioni in modo chiaro anche a interlocutori non tecnici.




Competenze richieste

Python e SQL; solide basi di statistica, data analysis e machine learning.
Esperienza con LLM, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, RAG e framework di orchestrazione agentica.
Conoscenza di Microsoft Power Automate e Copilot Studio; familiarità con API e integrazione di tool/servizi.
Capacità di lavorare su dati strutturati e non strutturati e di valutarne qualità, affidabilità e rilevanza.
Approccio problem-solving, autonomia, capacità di sintesi e forte orientamento al valore.
Ottime capacità comunicative e di interazione con stakeholder tecnici e business.




Profilo ideale

Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, Data Science, Matematica, Statistica o discipline affini.
1-2 anni di esperienza in progetti Data Science / AI, preferibilmente con componenti GenAI o Agentic AI e contesti enterprise.




Elementi distintivi

Title: Reliability Data Scientist (maternity cover)
Description:
OUR STORY

At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.

When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.

Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.

Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.

Responsibilities


Develop AI/ML models and advanced analytics to improve semiconductor quality and reliability
Build predictive solutions for anomaly detection, failure pattern recognition, and early risk identification.
Integrate data from test, manufacturing, field returns, and reliability sources into scalable analytical workflows.
Translate complex data into actionable insights through statistical modeling, explainable AI, and visualization.
Collaborate across product, quality, manufacturing, process, and customer teams to support root-cause analysis and decision-making.
Contribute to reliability metrics, data standards, and monitoring dashboards.


Requirements


Master’s degree in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Statistics, or Applied Mathematics.
Strong programming skills
Experience with AI/ML and analytics tools such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
Solid knowledge of statistics, predictive modeling, and data visualization.
Good understanding of semiconductor technologies; reliability engineering knowledge is an advantage.
Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in cross-functional environments.


The expected salary range for this position is € 38.000 - 45.000 gross annual salary (RAL), plus variable pay relevant for the role.

In accordance with the EU Pay Transparency Directive and applicable Italian legislation, this compensation range has been determined based on objective, gender-neutral criteria, including job responsibilities, required skills, relevant experience, qualifications, and market benchmarks. Placement within the range will depend on the candidate’s profile and demonstrated competencies. The final offer will be made in compliance with the applicable National Collective Bargaining Agreement (CCNL), where relevant, and our internal compensation policies. We are committed to equal pay for equal work and equal opportunities for all candidates.

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance.

At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture.

To discover more, visit st.com/careers.

DXC Technology is looking for a Data Scientist to support AI and Generative AI projects, contributing to practical solutions and improving business processes through ML models, NLP and intelligent automation, within the Data & AI team based in Milan.

Key Responsibilities


Contribute to the design and implementation of AI solutions, including machine learning models, NLP, and computer vision applications
Collaborate with senior team members to understand client requirements and translate them into practical AI solutions
Support the direct relationship with clients/stakeholders for requirements gathering and solution validation
Support pre-sales activities, including preparing technical materials and contributing to client presentations
Stay up to date on AI trends and emerging technologies, applying knowledge to support solution development
Contribute to maintaining best practices and methodologies within the AI & Data Science team
Take part in AI solution projects, gaining hands-on experience in real client environments and progressively growing in autonomy.

Proven experience in Gen AI projects.
Ability to translate business requirements into practical AI solutions, including design and implementation.
Deep expertise in core Generative AI technologies, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Prompt Engineering, Observability, and AI Guardrails.
Extensive experience with enterprise-grade GenAI development frameworks and platforms, including LangChain, LangGraph, LiteLLM, and Langfuse.
Proven experience in addressing AI governance, GDPR, and EU AI Act compliance requirements throughout the AI solution lifecycle.
Good knowledge of machine learning frameworks and libraries (Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, etc.)
Strong proficiency in AI-powered software development and code generation tools.
Extensive experience with enterprise software delivery practices and platforms, including source code management, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployment frameworks.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Good communication skills and strong ability to work in a collaborative team.
Growing autonomy in managing assigned tasks and deliverables.
Ability to organize project activities by identifying priorities and ensuring deadlines are met

Previous involvement in presales or solution support tasks

Title: Experienced Professional | Data Scientist Manager
Description:
📍 Sede: Milano

👀 Rank: Manager




Chi siamo

JAKALA è un'azienda che lavora su dati, intelligenza artificiale e sviluppo di esperienze per generare un impatto significativo e duraturo a livello globale.

Presenti in oltre 30 città in 21 paesi, i nostri team uniscono competenze su strategia, tecnologia, creatività e operations per offrire esperienze personalizzate e soluzioni trasformative ai nostri clienti, grazie al supporto di dati e intelligenza artificiale. I Jakalers sono un gruppo eterogeneo di oltre 3.000 persone, animate da passione, ambizione e idee brillanti. Proprio questa combinazione unica di talenti è il fattore distintivo che ha ispirato il nostro purpose: Together to get there.

Creare un mondo migliore è il nostro obiettivo ultimo: la nostra ambizione è generare valore per tutti i nostri stakeholder in modo sostenibile, con particolare attenzione a etica, clima e qualità. Nel 2021, abbiamo scelto di diventare una Società Benefit, dimostrando il nostro impegno di lungo periodo e la volontà di proteggere i principi e i valori che ogni giorno guidano le nostre azioni.

Crediamo che la diversità sia la chiave del nostro successo e, per questo, siamo impegnati a creare un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, dove ciascuno possa sentirsi valorizzato per la propria unicità. Tutte le nostre opportunità di lavoro sono aperte ai candidati appartenenti alle categorie protette L.68/99.




Scopri il team

Siamo alla ricerca di un/una Data Science Manager con forte background tecnico e capacità di leadership, che guidi la delivery di progetti avanzati di data science e machine learning in ambito marketing e business analytics.

Sarai una figura chiave in grado di tradurre obiettivi di business e complessità degli ecosistemi dati in roadmap analitiche, interfacciandoti in prima persona con C-level, Marketing Director e stakeholder tecnici. Lavorerai a stretto contatto con Data Engineer, MarTech / Media Specialist e Account, con l'obiettivo comune di trasformare dati grezzi in strategie scalabili e soluzioni ad altissimo impatto per i brand.

Avrai inoltre la responsabilità di definire approcci analitici, supervisionare la qualità delle soluzioni sviluppate e contribuire attivamente alla crescita tecnica e professionale del team.




🎯 Le tue responsabilità:

Sarai il punto di riferimento per il cliente, guidando in modo proattivo presentazioni strategiche e momenti di avanzamento (SAL), con la capacità di tradurre modelli complessi e analisi avanzate in insight chiari e rilevanti anche per stakeholder non tecnici.
Lavorerai su grandi volumi di dati, interrogando e modellando dataset su Cloud Data Warehouse (es. BigQuery, Databricks) per generare insight concreti a supporto delle decisioni di business.
Definirai l’impianto di misurazione e guiderai lo sviluppo di modelli avanzati di Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) e attribuzione data-driven, contribuendo all’ottimizzazione di budget marketing complessi.
Progetterai soluzioni di machine learning e customer analytics (segmentazione, clustering, modelli di propensity, Customer Lifetime Value), pensate per essere attivate direttamente su piattaforme media e sistemi di marketing automation, con un forte focus su retention e audience strategy.
Coordinerai l’integrazione di fonti dati marketing eterogenee (advertising platform, CRM, CDP, dati web/app), trasformandole in un ecosistema dati coerente e funzionale alla crescita e all’efficienza.
Collaborerai in modo continuativo con team multidisciplinari (Media, CRO, IT, CRM, Account), fungendo da ponte tra competenze diverse e trasformando analisi complesse in strategie e azioni concrete.
Promuoverai l’adozione di soluzioni innovative, inclusi use case di Generative AI (LLM open source, OpenAI, Vertex AI) applicati al digital marketing, come automazione, personalizzazione avanzata e content intelligence.
Avrai un ruolo chiave nella crescita del team, definendo best practice, diffondendo la cultura del dato e supportando lo sviluppo professionale delle persone.




🙌 Se ti riconosci in queste caratteristiche, potremmo essere il perfetto match:

6+ anni di esperienza hands-on in Data Science e Advanced Analytics, preferibilmente maturata in contesti di consulenza strategico-tecnologica o in primarie realtà di agenzia digital/media.
Solido business acumen e forte standing consulenziale, con capacità di comunicare e presentare in modo chiaro ed efficace risultati complessi a stakeholder e decision maker enterprise.
Esperienza nell’estrazione, gestione e modellazione di dati in ambienti Cloud (es. Google Cloud Platform, AWS, Azure), con eccellente conoscenza di Python e SQL.
Esperienza pregressa in ruoli di responsabilità (team lead, tech lead o project lead), con gestione di risorse, priorità e delivery in contesti complessi e caratterizzati da SLA sfidanti.
Formazione accademica in discipline quantitative o ingegneristiche (Informatica, Matematica, Statistica, Ingegneria, Fisica o affini).
Familiarità con ecosistemi martech e adtech, in particolare architetture di digital marketing e tracking (es. GA4, piattaforme advertising, CDP, DMP, CRM e Big Data marketing stack).
Costituisce titolo preferenziale l’esperienza con framework avanzati di Marketing Mix Modeling (es. Robyn, Meridian) o con librerie bayesiane come PyMC o Stan.




💜 Scopri nel video le ragioni per cui scegliere JAKALA come prossimo step di carriera:

In JAKALA crediamo che il tempo e il benessere delle persone vadano rispettati, sempre: incoraggiamo una presenza in ufficio di 10 giorni al mese, lasciando piena libertà di lavorare da dove preferisci, sia in Italia che all’interno della Comunità Europea.
Il nostro sistema di Total Reward include convenzioni esclusive per viaggi, ristoranti, shopping, palestra e tempo libero, oltre a servizi gratuiti di telemedicina e supporto psicologico, pensati per te e per chi ami.
Investire nel nostro processo di selezione significa ricevere supporto autentico: un Recruiter dedicato ti accompagnerà con feedback personalizzati, consigli di carriera e insight sul tuo CV, a prescindere dall’esito della candidatura. Niente AI, solo persone. E, grazie all’iniziativa Your Time Back, ti restituiamo il tempo investito nei colloqui con un percorso di empowerment firmato Unobravo.




💰 Retribuzione:

Per questa posizione la RAL prevista è compresa tra 45.000 € e 65.000 € lordi annui. La proposta retributiva sarà definita all'interno di questa fascia in base all'esperienza, alle competenze maturate e al livello di seniority coerente con il ruolo, applicando criteri oggettivi e neutri sotto il profilo del genere. Si applica il CCNL Commercio – Terziario.




🌱 Ready to start?

Non è solo una candidatura. È un percorso che comincia ora. Inviaci il tuo CV: non vediamo l’ora di conoscerti!

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. Fluency in both Italian and English

Title: AI Scientist
Description:
Build the science that shapes the future of human health.

Application closing date: 11.11.2026

Join a place where ambitious science thrives

Human Technopole (Milan) is a rapidly expanding life science institute where international researchers and cutting-edge technologies converge to accelerate biomedical discovery. Our mission is to transform bold scientific ideas into advances that improve human health.

Within this mission, the Casale Group in the Health Data Science Centre develops AI methods that transform population-scale human data into mechanistic models of disease. Our research integrates large-scale human genetics with molecular and clinical data to generate testable hypotheses that accelerate biological discovery and therapeutic innovation.

We are recruiting an ambitious AI Scientist to build the reusable AI foundations and agentic scientific systems that power the group’s research across human genetics, multimodal biology, and disease.

Your mission

As AI Scientist, you will develop next-generation AI systems at the interface of ambitious biological research and frontier artificial intelligence, using population-scale genetics and multimodal biomedical data to uncover mechanisms of human disease.

You will turn methods and models emerging from this research into robust, reusable AI capabilities—including foundation models, multimodal representation learning, agentic workflows, evaluation frameworks, and scalable research software—that can accelerate discovery across multiple projects.

A longer-term goal is to develop AI systems that increasingly act as scientific collaborators: connecting evidence across biological scales, proposing testable hypotheses, identifying informative analyses, and working alongside researchers to accelerate iterative cycles of biological discovery.

Your work will combine methodological innovation, biological discovery, and scientific software development at the intersection of artificial intelligence, computational biology, and human genetics. You will have substantial scientific and technical ownership, with the opportunity to help shape the group’s technical AI architecture while leading and contributing to high-impact scientific publications, open-source software, and reusable research capabilities.

As part of Human Technopole’s interdisciplinary AI ecosystem, you will engage closely with the European AI community, including through collaborations with Helmholtz Munich and connections to the ELLIS network. Your work will benefit from interactions with computational, biological, and clinical groups across the institute, alongside opportunities for international collaboration, research exchanges, interdisciplinary training, and engagement with industry.

You will also draw on the group’s established network across leading academic institutions and industry partners in Europe and North America, helping you build collaborations, broaden your expertise, and accelerate the impact of your research.

Grow Your Skills

You will enhance your scientific and professional skills by:


Developing next-generation AI methods through ambitious biological research.
Building foundation models, multimodal representation learning approaches, and agentic AI systems for scientific discovery.
Turning scientific advances into robust, benchmarked, and reusable AI capabilities that accelerate discovery across multiple research projects.
Building scalable research software and AI workflows for large and heterogeneous scientific datasets.
Shaping the future of AI for science through high-impact publications, open-source software, international collaborations, and entrepreneurial initiatives.


Human Technopole supports career development through training, mentoring and dedicated learning opportunities.

Essential

What you'll bring


PhD in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Computational Biology, or a related quantitative discipline, or expected completion within the next six months.
At least 4 years of relevant research experience by the start of the position, including doctoral research.
Strong track record of scientific output in AI, machine learning, computational biology, or biomedicine, demonstrating independent methodological or technical contributions through publications, open-source software, models, or comparable research outputs.
Excellent programming and software engineering skills in Python, with experience building scalable and maintainable research software, model-training workflows, or AI systems.
Strong expertise in modern machine learning and AI, with demonstrated ability to design, develop, and critically evaluate advanced methods for challenging research problems.
Experience with modern software engineering and computational research practices, including version control, testing, documentation, reproducibility, and large-scale GPU or HPC environments.


Preferred


Industry or applied R&D experience in roles such as AI/ML architect, research scientist, machine learning scientist, or equivalent positions with substantial technical ownership.
Experience developing foundation models or other large-scale AI systems for scientific or biomedical applications.
Experience developing or applying LLM-based agents and agentic workflows for scientific or technical tasks, including analysis, information integration, automation, or hypothesis generation.
Experience integrating multimodal biomedical datasets, including molecular, imaging, clinical, or population-scale data.
Experience leading collaborative software projects and contributing to open-source scientific software or models.
Experience with workflow management, containerisation, and scalable GPU/HPC computing.
Familiarity with human genetics and computational biology is advantageous but not required.
Experience applying AI within drug discovery, translational research, or related biomedical pipelines is an advantage.


Organizational and social skills


Strong analytical thinking and scientific curiosity.
Ability to work independently while thriving in an interdisciplinary and collaborative environment.
Excellent communication and scientific writing skills.
Creativity, intellectual humility, and enthusiasm for tackling challenging biological questions.
Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to take ownership of ambitious research projects.


At HT, your discoveries contribute to a global effort to improve human health.

Why Human Technopole

HT offers an international and dynamic workplace, competitive welfare provisions, flexible working policies and relocation support. Candidates moving to Italy may benefit from attractive tax benefits. We promote work–life balance and provide parental support initiatives.

Title: AI Research Scientist – AI-Driven Modeling, Robotics & Vision-Language-Action (VLA) Systems
Description:
OUR STORY

At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.

When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.

Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.

Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.

YOUR ROLE

The Applied Mathematics Team (AMT), part of System Research & Applications (SRA), develops advanced AI and mathematical technologies to address complex industrial challenges and create competitive advantages for ST. We work at the intersection of AI, mathematical modeling, simulation, digital twins, robotics, and software engineering, transforming cutting-edge research into impactful industrial solutions.

Job Summary

We are looking for an exceptional AI Research Scientist passionate about advancing the state of the art in AI-driven modeling of complex systems.

You will explore how foundation models, scientific machine learning, multimodal learning, and simulation can be used to model, understand, and optimize physical and industrial processes. A key focus of the role is the development of intelligent systems for Robotics and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) applications through advanced modeling, simulation, and foundation-model technologies. The role also includes the development of physical modeling algorithms for Digital Twins, enabling the creation of predictive, adaptive, and explainable representations of complex physical systems.

Key Responsibilities


Drive research in AI-driven modeling, robotics, and intelligent systems.
Design and develop advanced AI models for physical, industrial, and embodied environments.
Build prototypes and proof-of-concepts based on emerging AI technologies.
Contribute to multimodal AI, simulation-driven learning, robotic intelligence, and VLA systems.
Design and develop physical modeling algorithms and hybrid AI-physics models to support next-generation Digital Twin solutions.
Create modeling frameworks that combine data, domain knowledge, and physical constraints.
Design rigorous experiments and evaluation methodologies.
Publish results, contribute to patents, and communicate technical findings.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across research, engineering, and product groups.


Required Qualifications

Technical Skills


Strong hands-on AI experimentation and software development skills.
Ability to independently identify problems, formulate research hypotheses, and execute projects.
Expertise in one or more of:
Multimodal Learning
Time-Series Modeling
Physics-Informed Neural Networks
Reinforcement Learning
Simulation
Representation Learning
AI Evaluation
Deep expertise in Robotics and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) systems, including modeling, simulation, and learning for physical or embodied environments and the development of physical modeling algorithms for Digital Twins.
Strong Python and modern AI framework skills (PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow).
Experience with scientific experimentation and benchmarking.

Personal Skills


Strong scientific judgment and problem-solving mindset.
Intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and initiative.
Excellent collaboration and communication skills.
Passion for research and innovation.


Preferred Qualifications


PhD or equivalent research experience in AI, Machine Learning, Robotics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or related fields.
Publications in leading conferences or journals.
Experience with robot learning, embodied AI, digital twins, or simulation environments.
Experience with foundation model training or adaptation.
Open-source or research community contributions.


Why Join Us


Work on cutting-edge AI research with direct industrial impact.
Shape the future of AI-driven modeling, robotics, and intelligent systems.
Collaborate with experts across AI, mathematics, software, and semiconductor technologies.
Influence strategic technology directions within ST.


The expected salary range for this position is €38,000 – €45,000 gross annual salary (RAL), plus variable pay and productivity premium.

In accordance with the EU Pay Transparency Directive and applicable Italian legislation, this compensation range has been determined based on objective, gender-neutral criteria, including job responsibilities, required skills, relevant experience, qualifications, and market benchmarks. Placement within the range will depend on the candidate’s profile and demonstrated competencies. The final offer will be made in compliance with the applicable National Collective Bargaining Agreement (CCNL), where relevant, and our internal compensation policies. We are committed to equal pay for equal work and equal opportunities for all candidates

We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. A key focus of the role is the development of intelligent systems for Robotics and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) applications through advanced modeling, simulation, and foundation-model technologies. The role also includes the development of physical modeling algorithms for Digital Twins, enabling the creation of predictive, adaptive, and explainable representations of complex physical systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive research in AI-driven modeling, robotics, and intelligent systems.
  • Design and develop advanced AI models for physical, industrial, and embodied environments.
  • Build prototypes and proof-of-concepts based on emerging AI technologies.
  • Contribute to multimodal AI, simulation-driven learning, robotic intelligence, and VLA systems.
  • Design and develop physical modeling algorithms and hybrid AI-physics models to support next-generation Digital Twin solutions.
  • Create modeling frameworks that combine data, domain knowledge, and physical constraints.
  • Design rigorous experiments and evaluation methodologies.
  • Publish results, contribute to patents, and communicate technical findings.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across research, engineering, and product groups.

Required Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on AI experimentation and software development skills.
  • Ability to independently identify problems, formulate research hypotheses, and execute projects.
  • Expertise in one or more of:
    • Multimodal Learning
    • Time-Series Modeling
    • Physics-Informed Neural Networks
    • Reinforcement Learning
    • Simulation
    • Representation Learning
    • AI Evaluation
  • Deep expertise in Robotics and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) systems, including modeling, simulation, and learning for physical or embodied environments and the development of physical modeling algorithms for Digital Twins.
  • Strong Python and modern AI framework skills (PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow).
  • Experience with scientific experimentation and benchmarking.
Personal Skills

  • Strong scientific judgment and problem-solving mindset.
  • Intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and initiative.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills.
  • Passion for research and innovation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD or equivalent research experience in AI, Machine Learning, Robotics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or related fields.
  • Publications in leading conferences or journals.
  • Experience with robot learning, embodied AI, digital twins, or simulation environments.
  • Experience with foundation model training or adaptation.
  • Open-source or research community contributions.

Why Join Us

  • Work on cutting-edge AI research with direct industrial impact.
  • Shape the future of AI-driven modeling, robotics, and intelligent systems.
  • Collaborate with experts across AI, mathematics, software, and semiconductor technologies.
  • Influence strategic technology directions within ST.

The expected salary range for this position is €38,000 – €45,000 gross annual salary (RAL), plus variable pay and productivity premium.

In accordance with the EU Pay Transparency Directive and applicable Italian legislation, this compensation range has been determined based on objective, gender-neutral criteria, including job responsibilities, required skills, relevant experience, qualifications, and market benchmarks. Placement within the range will depend on the candidate’s profile and demonstrated competencies. The final offer will be made in compliance with the applicable National Collective Bargaining Agreement (CCNL), where relevant, and our internal compensation policies. We are committed to equal pay for equal work and equal opportunities for all candidates

Title: Advanced Analytics Project Leader
Description:
The Group Advanced analytics and Automation Solutions Unit is in charge of driving the identification and execution of key Advanced Analytics projects at Group level, related both to AI-driven automation and AI recommendations/predictions, and support local BUs, where needed, to implement local projects; the unit is also responsible for designing, implementing and continuously improving the library of central shared analytics / automation services available for the BUs through a central platform.




Advanced Analytics Project Leader, in charge of identifying, designing, developing and managing, in collaboration with the various business structures, artificial intelligence solutions that data analytics aim to provide recommendations / predictions to be used by different stakeholders, such as anti-fraud models or price elasticity models.




Main tasks and responsibilities:

You will drive the project set-up, the analysis of the as-is process / situation, the creation of a business case, the design of the target solution and its continuous improvement based on the results obtained during the testing phase
You will be responsible for the implementation of the end-to-end initiatives, including priorities definition, budget management, management of internal and external service providers and business interfaces and ensuring buy-in and execution
In particular, you will coordinate the development of the solution both from a logical point of view, you will lead the Data Scientists in the technical execution of all the analytical components - including Machine Learning models - and you will ensure their deployment with the support of Automation Engineers and IT Architects
You will have the opportunity to have regular and frequent interactions with the business functions, who from time to time will be involved in the various projects, as well as with the management.




Requirements

5+ years as Data Scientist in a consulting firm or in a company
1-2 years experience in managing projects related to artificial intelligence, digital transformation or operational excellence
Degree in scientific disciplines (mathematics, computer science, engineering, economics, physics)
Experience in main Python Data Science libraries (Pandas, Scikit-learn, Numpy, XGBoost, Pytorch, LightGBM, Tensorflow)
Experience in designing, developing and evaluating Statistical modeling or Machine Learning models (clustering, classification, regression, forecasting, …)
Excellent knowledge of the Office package, in particular Excel
Good knowledge of written and spoken English (B2)
Excellent propensity to work in a team, operational autonomy, proactivity, high level of commitment and result / output orientation
Strong ability to communicate effectively with the various organizational levels.




Nice to have:

Strong problem-solving skills (analysis of complex problems and structuring of solutions)
Excellent analytical and deductive skills, familiar with the design and evaluation of algorithms
Basic knowledge of IT architecture
Creativity and determination.




What we offer

We offer employment at manager level with the relevant salary, in accordance with the CCNL ANIA for non-executive employees and the Generali Group Company Agreement.

Gross annual salary ranging between 45K and 60K. The final offer will be aligned with the candidate’s professional experience, technical and soft skills relevant to the role, and may include an individual variable component.




We also offer:

Smart working and flexible hours
Corporate welfare system
Meal vouchers
Supplementary health insurance and discounted insurance policies
Well-being initiatives
Training and development
Structured continuous learning paths (technical and managerial)
Career development programs within the Group
Access to learning platforms and internal mobility opportunities, including international.




Why work with us

Joining Generali means becoming part of an international Group with a strong heritage and a forward-looking vision, where people are at the center of our sustainable growth strategy.

We foster a responsible, inclusive, and innovation-driven work environment, where everyone can contribute to creating value for customers, society, and the communities in which we operate.

We believe that diversity, equity and inclusion are essential to building a stronger culture and driving sustainable growth.

At Generali, you will find opportunities to grow through continuous learning, career development paths, and internal mobility across the Group.

We recognize talent and merit, and support flexibility as a key enabler of well-being and a sustainable work-life balance.

Working with us means sharing strong values and taking on meaningful challenges together to build a safer and more sustainable future every day.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Generali evaluates all applications based exclusively on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including skills, experience and potential, ensuring fairness and transparency throughout the selection process.




Company Profile

Generali Group Head Office is the guidelining unit of the Generali Group, one of the largest global insurance and asset management providers. Established in 1831, Generali is present in over 50 countries in the world, with a total premium income of € 82.5 billion in 2023. With around 82,000 employees serving 70 million customers, the Group has a leading position in Europe and a growing presence in Asia and Latin America.

At the heart of Generali’s strategy is its Lifetime Partner commitment to customers, achieved through innovative and personalised solutions, best-in-class customer experience and its digitalised global distribution capabilities. The Group has fully embedded sustainability into all strategic choices, with the aim to create value for all stakeholders while building a fairer and more resilient society.




Workplace: Milano, Trieste.

Nel Team di Artificial Intelligence & Data avrai l’occasione di aiutare, in ambito Analytics, le aziende a valorizzare i dati provenienti da fonti eterogenee trasformandoli in informazioni accurate e immediatamente utilizzabili, elementi indispensabili per quelle aziende che vogliono fare decision-making fact-driven. La risorsa Junior sarà inserita in un team di lavoro, affiancando colleghi senior e occupandosi di:


Interpretare proattivamente i bisogni del cliente, individuando metodologie e approcci coerenti
Sviluppare iniziative e soluzioni in modo indipendente, raccogliendo ed analizzando dati a supporto dell’elaborazione di soluzioni per i clienti

Collaborare efficacemente in team eterogenei ed internazionali

La retribuzione prevista per la posizione di Analyst è compresa tra EUR 26.500 e EUR 31.000 lordi annui.

In caso di stage, è prevista un’indennità di tirocinio.

L'inquadramento verrà definito in fase di selezione sulla base del profilo e in applicazione del CCNL Terziario Distribuzione e Servizi.

La definizione del compenso specifico, inclusi eventuali elementi variabili (come MBO) o benefit accessori, dipenderà dalla valutazione del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione.

Winning Requirements


Brillante percorso accademico con laurea specialistica in materie STEM
Familiarità con la modellazione e linguaggio di interrogazione dei data base; conoscenza di uno o più linguaggi di accesso al dato e programmazione (Python, R, Java, SQL); ottima conoscenza degli applicativi MS Word, MS Excel e MS Power Point; nozioni accademiche di modelli statistici per l’analisi dei dati
Forte propensione/interesse per le nuove tecnologie e per l’informatica
Elevata attitudine a lavorare sia autonomamente che in team, capacità analitiche e di problem solving, gestione dello stress, flessibilità, precisione e uno spiccato orientamento al raggiungimento dei risultati
Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese; disponibilità a lavorare in trasferta, anche all’estero

Title: Machine Learning & AI Engineer
Description:
Alkemy Group supporta le aziende nell’innovare la relazione con i propri clienti attraverso dati, tecnologia, AI, media, design e creatività, dando vita a esperienze che superano i confini tra fisico e digitale.




Alkemy Group si articola in tre aree di eccellenza:

[Alkemy] Data.Tech.AI, specializzata nell’evoluzione di modelli di business potenziati dalla tecnologia e abilitati dall’AI
[Alkemy] Retail Tech, focalizzata su software e tecnologia per il mondo Retail
[Alkemy]+, che integra creatività, comunicazione, design, media e commerce




A queste si affianca Alkemy Nova, la practice che valorizza trasversalmente l’intero ecosistema, con un focus sull’evoluzione dei modelli di customer engagement e loyalty.

Il Gruppo nasce con il supporto di FSI – il principale fondo europeo di investimento dedicato alla crescita di imprese italiane – dall’unione di realtà leader nei rispettivi ambiti: Alkemy, COSMIC, Konvergence, Retex e Tier 1.

Con sede a Milano, oltre 2.000 professionisti e una presenza consolidata in Italia e Spagna, Alkemy Group supporta un portfolio di oltre 1.000 clienti in diversi mercati: Financial Services, Utility, Retail, Fashion & Luxury, Healthcare, Industrial, Telco, Sport & Media.







Cerchiamo un Machine Learning & AI Engineer capace di seguire il dato lungo tutto il percorso: dalla domanda di business ai dataset, dai modelli al loro funzionamento in produzione.

È un ruolo a spettro ampio più che specialistico. Chi lo ricopre scrive codice Python, interroga e modella i dati in SQL, costruisce pipeline, addestra modelli e ne cura il rilascio – muovendosi con disinvoltura tra analisi, machine learning e data engineering. Lavorerai in un team di Advanced Analytics e MLOps su clienti enterprise in settori diversi, dal telco al banking, dall’automotive alle utility.




Cosa farai




Sviluppare in Python analisi, modelli e componenti riutilizzabili.
Interrogare e modellare i dati in SQL: query complesse, data modeling, costruzione di customer table / ABT.
Preparare i dati: data cleaning, integrazione da fonti eterogenee, trasformazione e feature engineering.
Sviluppare modelli di machine learning – regressione, clustering, modelli ad alberi, reti neurali – partendo da analisi esplorativa e descrittiva.
Costruire data pipeline e orchestrarle con Airflow, fino al deployment dei modelli in produzione.
Definire KPI e metriche che rendano misurabile il risultato, e restituirlo con visualizzazioni e reportistica leggibili dal cliente.
Presidiare le attività di progetto e collaborare con data scientist, data engineer e referenti di business.







Competenze richieste

Description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
