Title: Delivery Lead
Description:
YOU ARE

As a senior AI/ML Computational Scientist, you will design, build, and operationalize artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions for enterprise clients, combining custom models with cloud and third-party AI services to deliver production-ready outcomes. Your role spans the full solution lifecycle — assessing client needs and data, selecting and customizing models (including Deep Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models), designing scalable data and MLOps/LLMOps pipelines for training and production, and ensuring quality, value, and reliability of deployed systems.

THE WORK



Formulate real-world problems into practical, efficient, and scalable AI and Machine Learning solutions

Develop and implement machine learning algorithms, models, and computational systems; design and build scalable data pipelines to support model training and production with DevOps & MLOps

Customize and apply Deep Learning and Gen AI models for various use cases based on the business needs, data availability, system and infrastructure requirements - including edge device and HPC

Engage in research and development of new AI and high-performance compute algorithms, models, and simulations along with their applications to solve complex business problems at client sites

Work with large-scale datasets and utilize data preprocessing techniques to ensure high-quality input for training and production

Implement and maintain efficient data storage and retrieval mechanisms for models and knowledge using appropriate tools

Justify the value of model approaches in business problems

Collaborate with teams from both business and technical sides, including users, use case representatives, business owners, engineers, architects, and UI designers, to achieve end-to-end project goals and integrate into production



EDUCATION





Bachelor's Degree or equivalent



Basic (required) Qualification



Significant experience as a machine learning engineer or scientist, deploying models in production at scale , including monitoring, alerting, automatic bug filing and auditing.

Solid experience in applying theoretical foundations of computer science, including computer system architecture, system engineering, and programming

Proven experience in distributed computing systems and architecture that may include big data, high-performance compute, engineering simulations, scientific compute, grid and cloud computing, distributed networks

Experience in building and deploying AI/ML based software to a cloud environment.



Preferred Qualification



Proficiency in Python and python-based AI/ML framework and familiarity with relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch)..

Experience working with language models like LLM's APIs and optimizing their usage for specific applications.

Experience with the following programming languages: Python, C++, Java, R, SQL

Strong written & verbal communication skills and ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

Strong client-facing skillsets in a consulting environment

Strong cross-functional skills with the ability to collaborate with a variety of internal and client-side teams

Entrepreneurial mindset with a curiosity and passion for emergent tech and driving innovation

MS or PhD in related field preferred (computer science, engineering, etc.)



Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors including but not limited to role, level, seniority, responsibility, skillset, and level of experience. For this position, the job level is Dirigente under the Metalmeccanico National Collective Bargaining Agreement.

The gross annual salary range is between 67,400 and 95,200.

L’ufficio Attuariato analizza dati statistici e finanziari per valutare rischi e prevedere costi futuri legati a eventi incerti, come malattie, mortalità, sinistri o pensionamenti.

Produzione di analisi ad-hoc di natura tecnica-attuariale sul portafoglio della compagnia e relativa rappresentazione attraverso strumenti informatici evoluti: Power BI, SAS, Python.

Partecipa ad attività di sviluppo e test sui processi attuariali della compagnia.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Experience in CRO environment and vendor management preferred

Strong attention to detail and quality focus

Title: ANALISTA MERCATO GAS
Description:
Unisciti a Edison!




Siamo leader nella transizione energetica, con una storia di innovazione lunga 140 anni




Cerchiamo un/a Analista Mercato Gas da inserire nella funzione Market Analysis, Structuring & Pricing della Divisione Gas & Power Portfolio Management & Optimization. A diretto contatto con i team della Divisione e, in particolare, con la Business Unit Integrated Portfolio Management Optimization & Execution, la risorsa si occuperà di monitorare e analizzare i fondamentali dei mercati gas (prezzi, bilanci domanda/offerta e flussi tra paesi), utilizzando modelli statistici ed econometrici per prevedere le dinamiche future supportando le decisioni di business







Cosa farai nel quotidiano

• Analisi e gestione dati relativa ai fondamentali dei mercati gas di riferimento (Italia ed Europa)

• Sviluppo di modelli di previsione della domanda e dell’offerta di gas naturale attraverso l’utilizzo di svariate tecniche di previsione: statistica/econometrica, advanced machine learning, modelli fondamentali, market view, suppy/demand balance su diversi orizzonti temporali (short term to long term) con il fine di delineare indicazioni strategiche per il portafoglio della Divisione

• Predisposizione di analisi quotidiane, analisi ad hoc e presentazioni, a supporto delle decisioni di business

• Sviluppo di indicatori e metodologie di analisi utili al monitoraggio dei mercati del gas e delle commodity di interesse







Chi sei

• Hai conseguito una laurea in Economia con indirizzo quantitativo o in discipline statistiche

• Hai maturato almeno 3 anni di esperienza in un ruolo analogo nel settore Energy

• Hai un solido background quantitativo (matematico-statistico) oltre che ottime capacità di analisi numerica

• Hai un’ottima conoscenza di MS Office (in particolare Excel, VBA e Power Point) e di software statistico/analitici quali Eviews, Matlab e Python

• Hai un approccio proattivo, flessibile e determinato

• Sei preciso e possiedi ottime capacità di organizzazione e orientamento ai risultati

• Ti piace lavorare in team e hai ottime doti relazionali e di comunicazione

• Hai un’ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese (parlata e scritta)







Come funziona il processo di selezione

Il nostro processo di selezione prevede colloqui motivazionali e tecnici e, per i profili junior, anche test di personalità e di logica deduttiva. Garantiamo l'equità in tutte le fasi del processo di assunzione, monitorando l'"Adverse Impact", un sistema di valutazione dal quale emerge l’assenza di biais di genere







Cosa ti proponiamo

• Inquadramento previsto: Impiegato con CCNL Elettrici

• Retribuzione Annua Lorda iniziale di riferimento: 42.000 Euro

In base agli elementi che emergeranno durante la fase selettiva, sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutri rispetto al genere ed in considerazione del sistema classificatorio previsto dal CCNL, verrà individuata la retribuzione specifica







Perché scegliere Edison?

• Crescita personale e professionale: le competenze apprese sul lavoro, la community di tecnici ed esperti e la crescita individuale sono il primo fattore per cui i tuoi futuri colleghi continuano a sceglierci

• Work-life balance: smart working, benefit aziendali e iniziative per il benessere mentale e fisico delle nostre persone sono al centro di un sistema di welfare flessibile e capace di rispondere a bisogni diversi: dalla genitorialità alla salute, dalla mobilità sostenibile alla conciliazione vita-lavoro

• Giovani e innovazione: potrai entrare nella nostra Young Community, un percorso volto a scoprire l'azienda e i suoi business, caratterizzato da momenti di formazione e sviluppo, socializzazione e networking. Con il piano company social housing diamo ai neoassunti neolaureati l’opportunità di una casa a costi accessibili in prossimità della sede di lavoro

• Energia che cambia tutto: lavora in un settore chiave per il futuro dell’ambiente e lascia la tua impronta per costruire un domani migliore







Siamo la società leader dell’energia, con oltre 140 anni di storia e primati che fanno di noi il più antico operatore del settore in Europa. Impieghiamo oltre 6.000 persone, operando in Italia ed Europa nella produzione rinnovabile e low carbon, nell’approvvigionamento e vendita di gas naturale, nella mobilità sostenibile, e attraverso Edison Energia ed Edison Next nei servizi energetici, ambientali e a valore aggiunto per clienti, aziende, territori e Pubblica Amministrazione. Come Gruppo siamo impegnati in prima linea nella sfida della transizione energetica, in coerenza con i Sustainable Development Goals dell’Onu e le politiche europee di decarbonizzazione




Unisciti al #futuroincorso!




Candidati all’offerta di lavoro cliccando il bottone in alto




Il presente annuncio è rivolto ad entrambi i sessi, ai sensi del decreto legislativo 11 aprile 2006 n. 198 “Codice delle pari opportunità tra uomo e donna” e a persone di tutte le età e nazionalità, ai sensi della Direttiva 2000/78/CE “Parità di trattamento in materia di occupazione”

Description:
Tech Architect ML & AI Engineer | Advanced Analytics

Sedi: Roma, Milano, Bologna, Torino, Napoli, Padova

In Avanade siamo alla ricerca di Machine Learning & AI Engineer appassionati di Intelligenza Artificiale e innovazione, con almeno 5/6 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di soluzioni di Intelligenza Artificiale in contesti aziendali strutturati; competenze di people management.

Entrerai a far parte del team Advanced Analytics, all’interno dell’area AI, contribuirai alla progettazione e allo sviluppo di progetti di Data Science, tra cui modelli predittivi, soluzioni basate su Large Language Models (LLM), agenti intelligenti e sistemi di Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

Together we do what matters.

Cosa Farai


Collaborerai con altri ML & AI Engineers, sviluppatori full stack AI, data engineers e solution architects per integrare modelli ML/AI in architetture cloud moderne.
Scriverai codice Python/PySpark di alta qualità e SQL per l’analisi e la trasformazione dei dati.
Lavorerai con modelli tradizionali di Machine Learning e Deep Learning.
Svilupperai soluzioni basate su Large Language Models, con conoscenza di tecnologie come RAG e agenti intelligenti.
Progetterai e svilupperai pipeline di ML e soluzioni AI, dalla fase di prototipazione alla messa in produzione
Utilizzerai strumenti di MLOps e DevOps per la gestione, versionamento e deployment dei modelli.
Contribuirai al confronto con i clienti, traducendo esigenze di business in soluzioni AI efficaci.


Qualifications

Competenze ed esperienze:

Il Profilo Ideale Possiede Buona Parte Delle Seguenti Competenze


Solida conoscenza di Python per il Machine Learning e la Data Science.
Solida conoscenza di SQL e modellazione dei dati.
Esperienza con librerie di Machine Learning (es. Scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, Prophet).
Esperienza con i framework di Deep Learning (es. PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras).
Familiarità con strumenti di MLOps (es. MLFlow).
Esperienza con Large Language Models, tecniche di prompting e sistemi di Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Esperienza con piattaforme e servizi Cloud Microsoft come Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Fabric e/o Databricks (ML/GenAI).
Conoscenza delle pratiche di versionamento con Git, testing, CI/CD.
competenze di people management


Nice To Have


Esperienza con i principali framework per LLM come LangChain, LangGraph e LlamaIndex.
Esperienza con LLM open-source (LLaMA, Mistral, Mixtral) e tecniche di ottimizzazione (LoRA, fine-tuning).
Esperienza con Hugging Face Transformers.
Esperienza con servizi come AI Foundry.
Esperienza in deployment di modelli AI su infrastrutture containerizzate (Docker, Kubernetes).
Certificazioni rilevanti in ambito AI/ML, tra cui:
Microsoft: AZ-900, AI-900, AI-102, AI-100, DP-100, DP-600
Databricks: Machine Learning Associate, Machine Learning ---Professional, Databricks Certified GenAI Practitioner


Il Tuo Profilo


Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica, Data Science o discipline affini.
Analitic*, curios*, agile, orientat* alla qualità
Capacità di lavorare in team cross-funzionali e di comunicare efficacemente con stakeholder tecnici e non.
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, sia scritta che parlata.

Title: AI DEVELOPER
Description:
Chi cerchiamo

Per la nostra sede di Milano – Piazza Trento siamo alla ricerca di una risorsa da inserire come AI Developer all’interno del team “AI Factory”. La struttura ha lo scopo di presidiare lo sviluppo e la configurazione di soluzioni AI.

Per quale Società 

A2A Life Ventures. A2A Life Ventures nasce dall’esperienza e dalla visione innovativa del Gruppo A2A per supportare le Business Unit nell’accelerare la transizione energetica e ambientale. Evolutasi dal polo di innovazione del Gruppo in una piattaforma integrata di venture capital, venture building, sviluppo tecnologico, AI e partnership strategiche, opera come motore di crescita per nuove soluzioni ad alto potenziale. Trasforma idee e tecnologie emergenti in soluzioni ad alto impatto, creando valore per il Gruppo, per il mercato e per i territori. Un ecosistema aperto che connette ricerca, industria e startup per anticipare le sfide della sostenibilità e favorire la nascita di nuovi modelli industriali.

Ti occuperai di


Sviluppo Agentico e Generativo: progettare e implementare applicazioni basate su Agentic AI e architetture RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), orchestrando modelli LLM per interagire con database e sistemi aziendali
Ciclo di Vita del Modello (End-to-End): gestire l'intero workflow, dallo sviluppo di modelli di Machine Learning (Supervised/Unsupervised) e Deep Learning, fino alla loro integrazione in microservizi tramite API REST/gRPC

Title: MICROSOFT FABRIC | DATA SCIENTIST | DATA ENGINEER
Description:
Techyon® è la boutique di Head Hunting che definisce lo standard di eccellenza nella ricerca e selezione di ruoli C-Suite, Manageriali e Mission-Critical nel dominio dell’Information Technology.

Hiring Company: Per prestigiosa Università milanese, i nostri Recruitment Engineer sono alla ricerca di un MICROSOFT FABRIC FULLSTACK DEVELOPER.

Core Responsibilities:

Siamo alla ricerca di un Microsoft Fabric Full Stack Developer, che entrerà a far parte della unit Innovation, Transformation & Foresight che presidia le attività di data architecture e data governance dell’Ateneo. All’interno di questo contesto, la persona contribuirà alla progettazione e alla realizzazione di soluzioni dati end-to-end basate su Microsoft Fabric, operando in stretta collaborazione con interlocutori tecnici, funzionali e di business.

Il ruolo coprirà l’intero ciclo di vita del dato: dall’integrazione di fonti eterogenee alla definizione dell’architettura, dalla trasformazione e modellazione dei dati fino alla realizzazione di semantic model e attività legate gestione e implementazione di data governance. La risorsa avrà il compito di tradurre esigenze informative e operative in soluzioni scalabili, sicure, governate e facilmente fruibili, contribuendo alla diffusione di standard e best practice comuni all’interno dell’organizzazione.

Principali attività:


Progettare e sviluppare soluzioni dati end-to-end all’interno dell’ecosistema Microsoft Fabric
Contribuire alla definizione e all’evoluzione dell’architettura dati basata su OneLake, Lakehouse e, ove opportuno, Data Warehouse.
Progettare e gestire processi di acquisizione, integrazione e trasformazione di dati provenienti da fonti eterogenee
Sviluppare notebook, procedure e trasformazioni attraverso SQL, Python e PySpark
Progettare modelli dati e semantic model efficienti, coerenti con le esigenze informative e di reporting dell’organizzazione
Configurare e ottimizzare le modalità di accesso ai dati, tra cui Direct Lake, Import e DirectQuery
Applicare principi di sicurezza, qualità, tracciabilità e governance lungo l’intero ciclo di vita del dato
Collaborare all’implementazione di processi di catalogazione, lineage, classificazione e controllo degli accessi
Monitorare e ottimizzare performance, affidabilità e costi delle soluzioni sviluppate
Supportare attività di prototipazione e la realizzazione di proof-of-concept e demo delle funzionalità di Microsoft Fabric
Collaborare con il team multidisciplinare coordinato dalla unit, favorendo l’allineamento tra esigenze funzionali, priorità organizzative e soluzioni tecnologiche
Interagire con stakeholder tecnici e di business per raccogliere, analizzare e tradurre i requisiti in soluzioni concrete


Job Requirements

Essential Qualifications:


Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica, Data Science, Statistica, Matematica, Ingegneria Gestionale, discipline STEM affini o preparazione equivalente maturata attraverso una significativa esperienza professionale
Almeno 3-5 anni di esperienza in ruoli di Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering o Business Intelligence, con esperienza concreta nello sviluppo di soluzioni end-to-end su Microsoft Fabric
Esperienza di studio e/o lavoro fuori dall’Italia (min. 4 mesi)
Ottima conoscenza di inglese ed italiano
Solide competenze in data modeling, semantic model, SQL e Python/PySpark.
Conoscenza dei principi di data governance e capacità di progettare soluzioni scalabili, sicure e mantenibili
Approccio operativo e orientato alla soluzione, capacità di tradurre le esigenze di business in soluzioni tecniche e di comunicare con interlocutori non specialisti.
Attitudine alla collaborazione in contesti multidisciplinari


Desiderable Competencies:


Conoscenza di Microsoft Purview e dei servizi dati Azure
Possesso di certificazioni Microsoft pertinenti


Other Info

Location: Milano

Contract Offered:

Permanent contract - full time

Compensation:

RAL: 45 - 65.000 €

Further information: Ibrido; Smart Working 10 gg/mese

Title: AI Engineer, Certilogo
Description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About The Team And The Role

Certilogo, an eBay company, empowers brands and consumers through trusted product authentication and brand engagement solutions. You will work within Product & Engineering, alongside product managers, software engineers, data specialists, UX designers and other AI experts to turn AI opportunities into real product capabilities.

Working closely with Product, Tech Leads and the Innovation team, you will design, prototype and productionize AI-based solutions across Certilogo’s authentication and digital product experiences. You will help evaluate new AI approaches, translate promising experiments into scalable product features, and continuously evolve the AI capabilities already supporting our platform.

This is a full-time position based in Milan, with a hybrid work model (3 days per week in the office) and flexibility to support work-life balance.

What You Will Accomplish


Turn AI opportunities into measurable product outcomes, from problem framing and data exploration through experimentation, validation and production deployment.
Design, develop and evolve Machine Learning and Computer Vision solutions supporting product authentication, fraud detection and digital product experiences, selecting the right approach for the problem rather than applying a fixed model or technique.
Evaluate and apply modern AI approaches, including multimodal and foundation models, embeddings and Generative AI, identifying where they can create meaningful value and where simpler, targeted models are preferable.
Build robust AI experimentation and evaluation practices, including representative datasets, meaningful metrics, error analysis and repeatable validation, so that model quality and business impact can be assessed objectively.
Productionize AI components in collaboration with engineering teams, with attention to scalability, latency, reliability, cost, model/version management, monitoring and continuous improvement.
Collaborate with Product, Engineering, UX, Data and external partners to shape requirements, communicate trade-offs and turn AI capabilities into usable, maintainable product features.



What You Will Bring


4+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing and deploying Machine Learning / Deep Learning solutions, ideally including Computer Vision and production AI systems.
Strong Python skills and solid experience with modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch and/or TensorFlow, plus the ability to build maintainable, testable production code.
Strong understanding of Computer Vision and Deep Learning techniques, with experience in areas such as image classification, detection, embeddings, similarity, anomaly detection or related visual recognition problems.
Practical experience evaluating and applying foundation models, multimodal / Vision-Language Models or Generative AI techniques; ability to assess accuracy, limitations, latency and cost.
Strong data and experimentation skills, including dataset preparation, feature engineering, statistical reasoning, error analysis and model evaluation; familiarity with SQL and common data/ML libraries.
Experience with MLOps / production AI practices such as experiment tracking, model versioning, CI/CD, containerization, cloud deployment, monitoring and model performance or drift management.
Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI concepts, make pragmatic technical trade-offs, stay current with the AI landscape and work effectively across Product, Engineering and business stakeholders.
Fluency in English. Italian language skills are a plus.



Additional Details

The base pay range for this position is expected in the range below:

42,800 EUR - 59,000 EUR

Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a range of insurance coverage (including medical) and/or other benefits (including retirement plan eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO, wellbeing and parental leave). Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided upon an offer of employment.

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center and AI Hiring Guideline.

Let's build the future of AI & Data, together 🧙




At Data Wizards, we're focused on 3 things: Data, AI & you.




We're a small team who genuinely love digging into data that makes a real difference for the companies we work with, and who want to discover how AI and data can help companies out there.




Why join us? Apart from tackling exciting challenges with passionate people in an environment that wants to see you thrive, you'll be part of a young company that keeps its feet on the ground, its eyes on the stars, and believes the best growth comes from the unique magic each Wizard brings.




We are continuously on the lookout for bright data engineers, data scientists, machine learning engineers, AI engineers, and data analysts. But this job description is for Senior Data Scientists out there feeling the magic in them and ready to spread it 🪄




We are currently looking for a senior data scientist for a fraud detection project where you would do:




Strengthening our fraud models by improving how we collect, label, structure and engineer features from complex transactional and behavioral data
Designing, building and continuously refining fraud detection models using machine learning, graph analytics, anomaly detection and behavioral analytics
Turning large volumes of transactional and customer data into actionable fraud intelligence through feature engineering, data enrichment and pattern discovery
Partnering with Fraud Operations, Risk, Compliance and Product teams to spot emerging fraud trends and translate business needs into scalable analytical solutions

You’re a step closer to joining our team if you bring:




Background




At least 5 years of experience in data science, with a solid grounding in fraud detection, ideally within the financial sector
A Master's degree in a quantitative field such as statistics, computer science or engineering. A PhD is a plus, and candidates with a different academic background but strong analytical skills are equally welcome




Technical Skills




Hands-on experience processing large-scale, complex transactional and behavioral datasets using SQL, Python (Pandas) and distributed processing frameworks such as Spark or Hadoop

Strong Python skills, with experience deploying AI applications into production; familiarity with Java is a plus

Autonomous & Proactive: You take initiative and drive projects forward.
Curious & Adaptive: You embrace learning and thrive in dynamic environments.

Creative Thinker: You find innovative solutions to challenging problems.

💰 A compensation package that keeps you motivated




Competitive salary
Mobility budget or company car with an electrical card
30 days of paid time off
A top-tier laptop & smartphone with a subscription
Representation allowances
Group, hospitalization & dental insurance
Meal vouchers & eco-cheques
Opportunity to earn company stock over time




🌱 A place to be your best self, grow, and thrive




Work with the most innovative technologies in Data & AI
Work in an agile, collaborative environment
Hybrid work model: up to 3 days per week
Monthly team-building events (plus one epic annual celebration)
Tailored training programs to fuel your career growth
A cool, ergonomic office with creative meeting spaces, a Nintendo Switch for spontaneous Mario Kart battles, a massage chair for those deep-thinking moments and fresh coffee & drinks to keep you energized ☕

📲Quick intro call with our HR team (5')

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Senior Data Scientist | Brussels




At Exsolvæ, our consultants carry the title of Solver, and it's a title you earn. We take the development of every Solver seriously, each one belongs to a Core Domain, works with a Leader who actually follows their progress, and presents their work in Cerebro sessions to colleagues who know the field as well as they do. It's a demanding place, on purpose.




The Data Science & AI Core Domain serves some of the biggest names across finance, retail, automotive, etc.




For this mission, you'll join the marketing data science team of a leading company in Belgium, building responsible AI models that make campaigns more relevant for millions of customers.




That's the work we're hiring for.




Your role, on mission

Build responsible AI models that make marketing campaigns more relevant and impactful, from target group selection to customer journey driven campaigns (next best action)
Use LLMs and fine-tuned models to turn large volumes of unstructured text, such as client interaction notes and web analytics data, into insights on products discussed, customer intent and feedback
Own the full lifecycle: capturing business needs, assessing feasibility, building models and data pipelines, deploying and monitoring them in production
Set up rigorous evaluation: experiment design, impact measurement, guardrails and validation of LLM-driven predictions
Build feedback loops and dashboards that let business users correct predictions and keep models learning
Bring MLOps best practices to the team (MLflow, reproducible models and datasets)
Translate technical results into clear, actionable insights for business owners, and guide junior data scientists along the way




Your role, within the community

Share what you learn: Cerebro sessions, co-built playbooks, code reviews between Solvers
Mentor peers and be mentored: seniors who enjoy passing on what they know do well here
Help shape where the Core Domain goes next




Must-haves

Master's degree in a quantitative field (statistics, mathematics, computer science); other academic backgrounds with substantial data science experience are welcome
Senior profile: minimum 5 years of relevant experience in data science
Expert Python and its data science ecosystem (scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow), with solid engineering practices (git, bash, SQL)
Expertise in customer journey modeling
Solid understanding of statistical methods, experiment design and machine learning, both traditional and deep learning
Proven expertise using LLMs for text classification, including interpretability, guardrails and validation of LLM-driven predictions
Fluent English, plus fluent French or Dutch
Based in Belgium and available on-site in Brussels 50% of the time
A genuine desire to be part of a community: you share what you know and you show up for the collective moments




Strong assets

Incremental learning and closed feedback loops
Uplift modeling
Marketing Mix Modeling and optimization under constraints
MLOps: MLflow, model monitoring and delivery pipelines
SAS, Streamlit
Financial services background




Joining Exsolvæ, concretely

A community before anything else: a Core Domain led by a Leader who follows your development, Cerebro sessions where Solvers present and learn, playbooks built together
A Knowledge & Networking budget to keep learning and stay plugged into the ecosystem (emerging AI topics, MLOps, AI governance)
A followed career path with a dedicated Manager, regular check-ins, an evolution committee that formalises your progression and issues recommendations
Long-run missions at leading companies, in production
A permanent employee contract, with a competitive package




Interested, or know someone who fits? Apply here or reach out to us!

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Position Description

The opportunity

Join CGI's multidisciplinary innovation environment and help clients turn data into decisions, products and new ways of working. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will frame complex business questions, design robust analytical approaches and build AI and machine-learning solutions that create practical value.

You will combine technical delivery with consulting: translating emerging trends into relevant client solutions, making insights easy to understand, supporting business development and helping less-experienced colleagues grow.

Only candidates legally residing in Belgium will be considered for this position.

C2-level in one of the 2 national languages and at least B2-level in the other and strong English proficiency is also mandatory.

What you will do


Frame the right problems. Work with clients and multidisciplinary teams to translate business challenges into clear analytical questions, hypotheses, success measures and realistic delivery plans.
Build advanced analytics solutions. Develop, evaluate and improve machine-learning and statistical models for classification, regression, forecasting, NLP and other relevant use cases.
Create reliable experiments. Explore and prepare data, select appropriate methods, design experiments and validate results with attention to quality, bias, explainability and business relevance.
Make insights actionable. Translate model outputs and complex findings into clear visualisations, recommendations and narratives that decision-makers can understand and use.
Support industrialisation. Collaborate with data, software and cloud engineers to move promising models towards secure, maintainable and scalable production solutions.
Shape client strategy and growth. Connect industry and technology trends to client operations, contribute to workshops and proposals, and help create new opportunities with existing and prospective CGI clients.
Mentor and collaborate. Coach colleagues, review approaches and share good practices while working openly with experts from different disciplines to find the strongest solution.


What you bring


Relevant education and experience. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Applied Mathematics, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Econometrics or another discipline with a strong statistical component, plus at least 5 years of experience in the data domain.
Python and/or R. Strong practical skills with the data-science ecosystem, including tools such as pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, matplotlib or equivalent libraries.
Machine learning and advanced analytics. Proven experience solving complex problems through data analysis, modelling and evaluation, including classification and regression techniques.
Natural language processing. Experience with NLP concepts and libraries such as spaCy, NLTK or Stanford NLP, and the ability to select an appropriate approach for the use case.
Data and cloud platforms. Experience with advanced analytics and large datasets, together with practical knowledge of at least one major cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.
Consulting and communication. Strong problem-solving, stakeholder and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical choices and results to non-specialist audiences.
Agile collaboration. Comfort working iteratively in Agile environments, taking ownership of deliverables and collaborating across business, data, engineering and design disciplines.
Additional assets. Experience in software development or DevOps, Docker, Kubernetes, MLOps, computer vision, Unity, Linked Data, semantic technologies or knowledge graphs is an advantage.


A pre-employment screening is part of the application process.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

The Data Scientist supports the design and delivery of analytics and machine learning solutions by working with complex datasets, building tailored models, and contributing to scalable data pipelines. The role collaborates closely with technical, functional, product, and client stakeholders to develop robust solutions and help standardize analytics practices across projects.

Analyze and preprocess complex data sets from various sources to prepare them for analytics solutions.
Develop, implement, and fine-tune machine learning models tailored to specific project needs.
Collaborate with the team to build robust and scalable data pipelines.
Participate in client meetings to discuss technical results and gather feedback.
Work together with the functional team involved in the project, including business experts and the project manager.
Provide technical support and mentorship to junior team members, promoting knowledge sharing within the team.
Work together with the product team to integrate developed solutions into our products.
Document processes and contribute to the standardization of analytics solutions.

3-6 years of work experience in Data Science and Analytics.
Knowledge for Data Science, including Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, and Operations Research.
Strong knowledge of Python and main Machine Learning frameworks, such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, pandas, and NumPy.
Experience with object-oriented programming.
Practical experience in developing, validating, and tuning Machine Learning models.
Experience with cloud services to store data, build automated pipelines, and run analytics or machine learning solutions.
Experience with Databricks.
Familiarity with development tools such as VSCode or other IDEs, and Jupyter notebooks.
Knowledge of Git, including push, pull, fetch, and merge.

Proficient in English.

Title: Data Scientist – Text mining / NLP senior
Description:
About Cronos Europa

Cronos Europa is a leading IT and digital transformation partner dedicated exclusively to European Institutions and agencies, delivering mission-critical solutions that shape Europe's digital future. As part of the Cronos Group, one of the most innovative and fastest-growing tech ecosystems in Europe, we benefit from a vast pool of expertise and cutting-edge capabilities. With over 1,000 specialists across Belgium, Luxembourg, and the Netherlands, we combine deep institutional knowledge with strong engineering excellence to support long-term, high-impact EU programmes requiring reliability, scalability, and innovation.

About The Job

We are looking for a Data Scientist specialised in text mining and Natural Language Processing to design, develop and optimise advanced AI, NLP and Machine Learning solutions. The role focuses on building robust, scalable and efficient models and applications, including the use of LLMs, RAG frameworks and state-of-the-art approaches to support complex institutional projects.

Responsibilities


Design, implement and optimise advanced AI, NLP and ML models using LLMs, RAG frameworks and other state-of-the-art approaches.
Create methods for tokenisation, part-of-speech tagging, named entity recognition, classification, clustering and other text mining-related tasks.
Fine-tune pre-trained models on domain-specific tasks.
Conduct research and stay updated on the latest trends and advancements in NLP, ML and AI technologies.
Develop and maintain robust, scalable and efficient code using Python.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI/ML solutions into existing products and services.
Perform rigorous analysis and experimentation to improve model accuracy, efficiency and scalability.
Participate in peer reviews and contribute to the continuous improvement of AI solutions.
Contribute to the design and implementation of ML application architecture and its solution stack.
Develop comprehensive reports and visualisations to communicate insights and findings to stakeholders.


Specific expertise and technologies


EQF6 qualification with a focus on Statistics, Data Science or Machine Learning.
Experience in Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing.
Excellent knowledge of Python and libraries such as Pandas, SpaCy, NLTK and Hugging Face.
Experience with deep learning frameworks for complex model architecture, such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.
Experience with AI-powered code assistants, such as Amazon Kiro or GitHub Copilot.
Good knowledge of SQL tooling, including Oracle and PostgreSQL.
Knowledge of NoSQL databases, including Elasticsearch and MongoDB.
Knowledge of architectural design of scalable ML solutions, such as model servers and GPU resource optimisation.
Experience with A/B testing and experimental design of ML models.
Experience with pre-trained models and LLMs such as GPT and other Transformer-based architectures.
Experience with tools such as Matplotlib and Seaborn for creating data visualisations.
Strong understanding of linguistics and text processing techniques.
Proficiency in continuous code delivery and unit testing.
Understanding of bias in ML applications and bias mitigation techniques.
Knowledge in one of the following areas: predictive analytics, prescriptive simulation, topic detection, plagiarism detection, trend or anomaly detection in datasets, and recommendation systems.
Good knowledge of the European Commission grant management ecosystem, including eGrants, would be an asset.


Skills And Competencies


Proficiency in understanding and applying statistical concepts and models.
Ability to formulate problems and develop solutions using data-driven approaches.
Ability to communicate complex data insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Results-oriented mindset focused on delivery.
Good communication skills in English, both orally and in writing.
Ability to write clear and well-structured documentation.


If you wish to integrate a dynamic structure on a human scale while working with the latest technologies, don't wait anymore and join Cronos!

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Travailler à la MC, c’est travailler avec enthousiasme.

Parce qu’à la MC, vous avez un impact positif sur la vie de millions de Belges. C’est ce que vivent chaque jour nos milliers de collaborateurs. Nous contribuons ensemble à une société plus saine pour tous. Cela donne de la satisfaction et de l’énergie.

Pour vous aussi, la MC est un environnement de travail agréable et bienveillant, où vous échangez des idées et où vous vous développez. Où l’on peut compter sur ses collègues et où l’on est en relation les uns avec les autres. Éprouver du plaisir dans notre travail, c’est notre raison d’être !

À la MC, chaque jour compte. Pour les gens, pour la société et pour soi-même.

Avec 650 collègues ICT, nous travaillons ensemble chaque jour pour fournir le meilleur service à nos 4,7 millions de membres et à nos près de 8.000 membres du personnel.

Flexibilité garantie ! Possibilité de travailler à domicile 4 jours par semaine ou depuis l’un de nos bureaux régionaux.

Description de fonction

L'équipe Data Analytics soutient la MC dans son ambition de devenir la mutualité la plus orientée données de Belgique. Nous accompagnons l'organisation tout au long de son parcours data et analytique et développons des solutions sur mesure basées sur des technologies modernes. Nous aidons ainsi les différents domaines métier à exploiter pleinement leurs données afin de stimuler l'innovation, optimiser les processus et atteindre leurs objectifs stratégiques.

Notre expertise couvre notamment la stratégie de données, la gouvernance des données, l'analytique avancée, l'animation d'ateliers d'innovation ainsi que le développement de solutions data sur mesure.

Vous rejoignez une équipe multiculturelle composée d'environ 30 professionnels, parmi lesquels des Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Reporting Specialists et Analystes. Ensemble, nous concevons des solutions innovantes au service des différents domaines métier de la MC.

Aujourd'hui, l'équipe est au cœur d'une transformation majeure. Nous évoluons d'un modèle de services centralisé vers des équipes Agile orientées domaine, où les métiers et l'IT partagent la responsabilité des solutions de données qu'ils développent et gèrent.

En tant que Data Scientist, vous analysez des problématiques complexes et développez des différents types de produits data tels que des modèles prédictifs des dashboards ou des API qui contribuent aux décisions stratégiques. Vous réalisez des analyses approfondies, expérimentez avec des algorithmes et transformez les insights en solutions concrètes à impact sociétal.

Vous collaborez étroitement avec les parties prenantes de l’entreprise, les ML Engineers et d’autres spécialistes data afin non seulement de construire ces produits, mais aussi de les implémenter avec succès.

Vos Responsabilités


Analyser les défis et formuler des solutions basées sur les données.
Développer, entraîner et valider des modèles de machine learning et d’optimisation.
Réaliser des analyses exploratoires et du feature engineering.
Visualiser et communiquer les insights via des dashboards et du storytelling.
Collaborer avec les ML Engineers autour du MLOps et de l’opérationnalisation des modèles.
Conseiller les clients et parties prenantes sur l’utilisation de l’IA dans leur contexte.


Le profil idéal


Minimum 5 ans d’expérience dans des projets de data science et de machine learning.
Maîtrise approfondie de Python (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, framew


orks ML/DL).


Solides bases en statistiques, SQL et design expérimental.
Expérience avec des outils de visualisation comme Power BI ou QuickSight.
Bonne compréhension du MLOps et collaboration avec des équipes techniques.
Vous êtes orienté résultats, vous pensez avec le business et vous voulez mettre des solutions en place qui fonctionnent vraiment.
Vous communiquez aisément avec des interlocuteurs techniques et non techniques, en néerlandais en français et en anglais.


Notre proposition

Une rémunération attractive : Vous bénéficiez d'un contrat à durée indéterminée, , d’un salaire attrayant et d'un ensemble d'avantages intéressants : chèques-repas de 9 euros et restaurant d’entreprise, 13e mois, prime supplémentaire en juillet, une indemnité forfaitaire nette, 100% des transports en commun remboursés, indemnité vélo, allocations familiales supplémentaires, assurance groupe, assurance hospitalisation, assurance revenu garanti, location de vélos, ...

Travail flexible : Vous travaillerez avec des horaires de travail flexibles avec possibilité de travailler à domicile jusqu’4 jours par semaine ou depuis l'un de nos bureaux régionaux.

Impact social: à La MC, vous ne faites pas que travailler. Avec vos collègues, vous contribuez directement ou indirectement à la santé de nombreuses personnes. Votre travail a une véritable signification.

Formation et possibilités de croissance: à La MC, vous êtes aux commandes de votre carrière. Vous avez la possibilité d'évoluer dans votre travail et dans l'organisation.

Team : Des collègues formidables et une culture d'entreprise dynamique et ouverte, visant à obtenir des résultats exceptionnels ensemble.

Envie de relever ce défi?

Envoyez-nous votre CV et votre lettre de motivation via le lien ci-dessous. Nous avons hâte de recevoir votre candidature !

Title: Data Scientist Junior
Description:
🚀 #WEAREALTIA

ALTIA is a multidisciplinary team focused on delivering advanced data-driven solutions that generate measurable impact and enable smarter decision-making. Working across international environments, we combine analytics, artificial intelligence, and business expertise to transform data into strategic value. Our mission is to help organizations evolve through innovation, scalable data platforms, and high-quality analytical solutions, fostering continuous learning, collaboration, and technological excellence.

We are looking for a Junior Data Scientist with solid hands-on expertise in machine learning, natural language processing (NLP), business intelligence, data preparation, and MLOps to join our team in digital transformation initiatives supporting large-scale administrative, financial, and digital service domain platforms.

The role involves collaborating with business stakeholders, UX designers, data analysts, and solution architects to frame business challenges into data science hypotheses. The specialist will design, train, and deploy predictive and statistical models handling both structured and unstructured data, as well as build automated data preparation pipelines and feature engineering processes. Additionally, the candidate will focus on MLOps practices (CI/CD, model registries, APIs, containerization), model monitoring (bias, drift, accuracy), interactive reporting (Power BI, Qlik, SAP Analytics), and compliance with emerging AI governance frameworks (e.g., EU AI Act, GDPR, model cards, explainability).

In close collaboration with cross-functional product teams, the specialist will design rigorous experiments (A/B testing, cross-validation), build data visualization storyboards, and maintain production-grade models. The position requires strong proficiency in Python, R, and SQL, along with practical experience in machine learning libraries, ETL orchestration, and cloud/distributed data environments.

⭐ WHAT WE HAVE FOR YOU?

🚩 Remote work model (far-site delivery with occasional presence in Brussels if required).

⏰ Flexible working hours.

📈 Stable position with high-potential professional growth opportunities in international environments.

🚀 Continuous learning and upskilling in cutting-edge MLOps practices, NLP, AI governance, and advanced analytics.

💪 Integration into an experienced, collaborative, and multicultural international team.

💣 Participation in high-impact international digital and ICT projects.

💙 Inclusive and innovation-driven work environment.

REQUIREMENTS:

Educational level & Experience:


EQF Level 6 (Bachelor’s degree or equivalent) + minimum 2 years of professional IT experience.


General & Sector Experience:


Minimum 2 years of experience in scaled Agile frameworks, large-scale financial programming and/or procurement/management systems within international public organizations.


Languages:


Minimum C1 level in English (spoken and written).


TECHNICAL & FUNCTIONAL EXPERIENCE:


Data Analysis & Analytics: Minimum 2 years of experience utilizing Power BI, Qlik Sense, SAP BO, and analysis using SQL, Python, and R.
Data Engineering & ETL: Hands-on experience with data preparation/transformation tools, ETL processes, and orchestration (e.g., Talend, Informatica, dbt, Azure Data Factory).
Machine Learning & NLP: End-to-end model development (scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face), feature engineering, hyperparameter tuning, and statistical validation (A/B testing, cross-validation).
MLOps & Deployment: Model registries, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, APIs, unit testing frameworks, model serving, and reproducibility practices.
Data Architectures & Cloud: SQL, NoSQL, MongoDB, Hadoop, Data Lakes, Lakehouses, and cloud data services.
AI Governance & Ethics: Model risk management, drift detection, bias monitoring, model cards, transparency, explainability, GDPR compliance, and alignment with the EU AI Act.


TECHNOLOGIES & SKILLS:


Programming & Analytics: Python, R, SQL, SAS, Spark.
ML & NLP Frameworks: Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face.
BI & Visualization: Power BI, Qlik Sense, Tableau, SAP Analytics, SAP BO.
Data Engineering & Databases: Talend, Informatica, dbt, Azure Data Factory, SQL/NoSQL, MongoDB, Hadoop, Data Lakes/Lakehouses.
MLOps & DevOps: CI/CD, Model Registries, REST APIs, Containerization, Unit Testing.
Soft Skills: Strong problem-framing abilities, capability to tell compelling business stories using model insights, excellent interpersonal skills, and agility in scaled Agile/multilingual team environments.


NICE TO HAVE:


Relevant certifications directly related to Data Science, MLOps, or Cloud AI platforms.


This job offer has been drafted taking into account impartiality and non-discrimination based on gender, race, ideology, or any other reason, in accordance with applicable equality regulations.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
🚀 #WEAREALTIA

ALTIA is a multidisciplinary team focused on delivering advanced data-driven solutions that generate measurable impact and enable smarter decision-making. Working across international environments, we combine analytics, artificial intelligence, and business expertise to transform data into strategic value. Our mission is to help organizations evolve through innovation, scalable data platforms, and high-quality analytical solutions, fostering continuous learning, collaboration, and technological excellence.

We are looking for a Data Scientist with solid expertise in advanced analytics, machine learning, statistical modeling, data governance, and AI compliance to join our team in high-impact international digital transformation initiatives applied to data-driven decision-making and analytical ecosystems.

The role involves developing, validating, and deploying end-to-end machine learning algorithms, statistical models, and predictive scripts to address complex analytical challenges. The specialist will design and execute rigorous experimental frameworks (such as A/B testing, cross-validation, and statistical significance testing), as well as build scalable data integration, cleansing, and validation pipelines. Additionally, the candidate will focus on implementing responsible AI governance frameworks (aligned with transparency, explainability, fairness, and the EU AI Act), model risk management, drift/bias monitoring, and interactive Power BI reporting.

In close collaboration with business stakeholders and technical teams, the specialist will perform data requirement analysis, model documentation (e.g., model cards), API-based data integration, and user acceptance testing (UAT). The position requires strong proficiency in Python, R, SQL, and Power BI, along with practical experience in distributed data architectures (data lakes, lakehouses, NoSQL) and automated data quality checks.

⭐ WHAT WE HAVE FOR YOU?

💪 Integration into an experienced and collaborative international team.

💣 Participation in high-impact international digital and ICT projects.

💙 Inclusive and innovation-driven work environment.

Educational level & Experience:


EQF Level 7 (Master's degree or 5 years of higher education) + minimum 5 years of IT experience, OR
EQF Level 6 (Bachelor's degree or 3 years of higher education) + minimum 7 years of IT experience.


General & Domain Experience:


Minimum 7 years of specific experience in data analysis or data science.
Minimum 2 years of experience in data management, analytics, or visualization applied to domain-specific areas (agricultural, environmental, or public sector datasets).
Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience with visualization tools, trend and anomaly detection, and database environment comparison.


English level: B2 or higher (spoken and written).

Data Scientist – Weather & Short-Term Power (HL 14)

📍 Location: Brussels

About ENGIE and Supply & Energy Management:

ENGIE, a global leader in low-carbon energy and services, relies on its Global Business Unit Supply & Energy Management (GBU S&EM) to provide reliable, sustainable, and affordable energy to all its customers. This strategic unit optimizes the Group’s and clients’ production assets and designs tailored energy solutions for our 200,000 professional clients and 15 million consumers.

The Global Business Unit Supply & Energy Management leverages ENGIE’s assets to deliver secure and sustainable energy to its B2B and B2C customers. It uses its expertise in energy management to provide decarbonized electricity 24/7.

Joining Supply & Energy Management means becoming part of a team of over 10,000 passionate experts spread across 20 countries, all united by a shared mission: shaping a greener and more efficient energy future. Together, we push the boundaries of innovation to deliver decarbonized energy 24/7. Join us and be part of those shaping the energy of tomorrow!

Context

The Expertise Center Market Analysis and the Business Platform Power Trading, Structuring & Origination (PTSO) are looking for a Data Scientist – Weather & Short-Term Power to join the Short-Term Power Market Analysis (STP) team in Brussels. The position sits on the trading floor, embedded in an extended team of market analysts, meteorologists, hydrologists and data scientists.

The STP team covers short-term power markets — week-ahead, day-ahead, intraday, ancillary and imbalance — in support of trading and portfolio management activities in Central Western Europe (CWE). Weather has become the dominant driver of these markets: renewable generation, demand and prices are increasingly shaped by it, and extracting value from weather information is one of the team’s key priorities.

This is not a conventional power analyst position. We are looking for a data scientist with strong weather expertise, or a quantitative meteorologist, to act as a bridge between two teams: as a member of the STP team, the successful candidate will also be integrated in the Meteo & Climate team, strengthening the collaboration between them. Above all, the candidate will work in close daily contact with our internal clients: the short-term power trading and asset optimization desks.

Your Mission

As Data Scientist – Weather & Short-Term Power, your mission is to turn weather data into market value: translating weather forecasts — and their uncertainty — into actionable signals, forecasts and strategies for the short-term power trading and asset optimization desks.

Your main activities:


Develop, industrialize and maintain weather-driven forecast products and trading signals for day-ahead, intraday and imbalance markets, owning the full model lifecycle from research to production.
Exploit deterministic and ensemble weather forecasts (post-processing, calibration, skill evaluation) to extract predictive value for renewable generation, demand and prices in CWE.
Work daily with the trading desks: understand their needs, deliver weather intelligence in actionable form, and communicate forecast confidence and risks clearly and on time.
Act as the bridge between the STP and Meteo & Climate teams: co-develop tools and data pipelines, spread weather best practices within STP, and bring power market awareness to the weather team.
Monitor upcoming weather and alert traders and analysts on market-moving weather events and forecast revisions.
Contribute to the team’s roadmap, dashboards and digital platforms, staying ahead of advances in weather forecasting, data science and AI.


Hard Skills

What we are looking for


In-depth knowledge of Numerical Weather Prediction models and weather data, including ensemble forecasting and reanalysis datasets.
Strong Python and data science skills: machine learning applied to time series, statistical post-processing, uncertainty quantification, and handling of large meteorological datasets.
Experience building, deploying and maintaining models in production; familiarity with cloud-based technologies (AWS, GCP or Azure) is a plus.
Knowledge of (short-term) power markets is a plus — a strong appetite to learn them is a must.


Soft Skills


Clear and effective communication, written and verbal: able to convey complex weather and model topics to traders and non-specialists.
Strong team spirit and collaborative mindset — you will operate across two teams and several desks.
Reactivity, autonomy and composure in a fast-paced trading-floor environment.
Curiosity, creativity and a solution-oriented attitude.


Education & Experience


Master’s degree or PhD in meteorology, atmospheric sciences, physics, applied mathematics, engineering or a related field.
3 to 5 years of experience in weather forecasting, data science applied to weather, or quantitative analysis — ideally in the energy sector.


Languages


Fluent in English.
French and/or Dutch is a plus.


Why join us?


A unique position at the crossroads of weather science and power trading, with direct daily exposure to trading decisions.
Integration in two expert teams — Short-Term Power and Meteo & Climate — with genuine intellectual depth and a strong collaborative culture.
Access to best-in-class weather data, proprietary data infrastructure and high-performance computing environments.
Autonomy, real responsibilities and the possibility to grow, learn and develop, including attendance to conferences.


Diversity & Inclusion

If you meet these requirements, then you are the talent we are looking for. Don’t wait – apply now with your CV.

At ENGIE S&EM, we are committed to fostering a gender-neutral and inclusive environment where everyone’s potential can thrive.

All our positions are open to people with disabilities. If you need any reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please inform your recruiter — we will be happy to support you.

ENGIE is a global leader in low-carbon energy and services, committed to accelerating the transition towards a carbon-neutral world. Our purpose (“raison d’être”) is clear: act to reduce energy consumption and develop cleaner, more sustainable solutions that balance economic performance with a positive impact on people and the planet.

We rely on our core businesses — gas, power, renewable energy, and services — to deliver competitive, tailored solutions to our customers worldwide.

With 96,000 employees and a strong network of partners and stakeholders, ENGIE is more than a company: we are a community of Imaginative Builders, working every day to create harmonious, sustainable progress.

ENGIE is committed to promoting Equal Opportunity employment. We pro-actively foster an inclusive environment that not only embraces but celebrates diversity. Our goal is for all employees to experience a real sense of belonging. We aim to provide them with a safe and inclusive working environment in which they feel empowered to thrive and excel. Company: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) Belgium

Employment Type: Full-time

Collaborate with stakeholders to collect requirements, frame business problems as data science hypotheses, define success metrics, and develop or deploy advanced data mining and machine learning solutions.
Collaborate with User Experience (UX) and product teams to specify design requirements for the effective presentation and interpretation of model outputs and insights.
Develop process to monitor and analyse data accuracy.
Identify, collect, and prepare data for analysis, collaborating with Data Analysts to ensure robust production-grade data pipelines, with a focus on feature engineering and data readiness for modelling.
Produce data models according to specific problem statements.
Develop and implement machine learning algorithms, statistical models, and scripts to solve specific business problems.
Collaborate with Data Analysts and Architects on the design of the analytics architecture to ensure it supports the scalability and performance requirements of data science models.
Write the different documentation associated with the tasks and liaise with other teams as necessary to address cross-system interdependencies.
Develop visualizations to communicate model behaviour, key insights, and performance metrics, and collaborate with Data Analysts on integrated dashboard reporting.
Design, develop, and evaluate predictive models capable of handling both structured and unstructured data, including model selection, training, and hyperparameter tuning.
Elaborate processes to ensure the compliant implementation of regulatory frameworks (e.g., EU AI Act), including model risk management, monitoring for drift/bias, and comprehensive documentation (e.g., model cards).
Ensure that model development, deployment, and monitoring practices adhere to all relevant regulatory frameworks and internal governance policies.
Communicate model insights, limitations, and behaviour effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences, and create interpretable outputs and documentation.
Conduct rigorous experiment design (e.g., A/B testing), employ cross-validation techniques, and perform statistical significance testing to validate findings and model performance.
Deploy and maintain models into production using Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) practices, including Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, model registries, and ensuring reproducibility.




Specific Expertise and Technologies

Knowledge of advanced analytics techniques and tools (e.g., Python, R, SAS, Spark) to design and implement data-driven solutions.
Knowledge of machine learning and natural language processing (e.g., Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face) to build predictive and text-based models.
Knowledge of programming languages (e.g., Python, R, SQL; Perl optional) commonly used in data science for modelling and automation.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

The Tribe Artificial Intelligence aims to deliver an efficient and seamless banking experience for our customers and empower our employees through AI. Our expert team of approximately 100 experts includes Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Business Analysts, Scrum Masters, Product Owners and Managers. We are seeking a Data Scientist with a minimum of 3 years of experience in developing AI applications, including both generative and traditional AI.




AND IN DETAIL

You develop AI applications to address various business challenges, including virtual assistants to enhance client experiences, advanced AI tools to support employee efficiency and creativity, and automating and optimizing internal processes.
You use various analytical methods, including large language models (prompt engineering, RAG, fine-tuning, …), Speech AI, agentic AI, image generation and interpretation, and classical statistical/machine learning techniques. While we don't expect you to be an expert in all areas, you should possess very strong expertise in core technologies and the ability to learn new methods as required.
You ensure scientific rigor in delivered solutions by applying robust methodologies, evaluating model generalization performance, adopting data-centric approaches through error analysis and data curation or augmentation, selecting relevant frameworks, and adhering to responsible AI guideline.
You present the results of your work directly to stakeholders and managers.
You contribute to deploying AI applications in production using a comprehensive stack of tools.
You access one of the richest volumes of varied data in the market and apply your skills to it.
You evolve in an environment where innovation and lean processes are praised, straight-forward communication is encouraged, and peers understand the meaning of team up.
You work with a team of colleagues in an Agile organization who are ready to collaborate and to share their experience.




YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

You hold at least a Master’s degree in a quantitative field like statistics, computer science or engineering, with a focus on natural language processing. A PhD is advantageous. Candidates from other academic backgrounds with strong analytics knowledge are also welcome.
You have a minimum of 3 years’ experience in data science, preferably in the financial sector, though less experience may be accepted if your academic achievements are substantial.
You are fluent in English and have a good command of French and/or Dutch.
You are proficient in Python for model building and understand ML engineering fundamentals (e.g., versioning systems) to produce code ready for CI/CD pipelines.




WHAT WE HAVE TO OFFER

OUR IMPACT

We strongly believe in the positive impact that the financial sector can have on the world. BNP Paribas Fortis offers sustainable and responsible investment products and solutions and encourages social entrepreneurship. Together with our customers, we are working towards a better future every day.




YOUR CAREER PERSPECTIVES

We offer a wide range of training courses, workshops and webinars to choose from depending on your availability, interests and goals.




OUR OFFER

In addition to your remuneration and benefits (meal vouchers, insurance, holidays), we offer flexible salary options, allowing you to convert part of your salary into personalised benefits (phone use, IT equipment, transport, etc.).




OUR ENGAGEMENT

At BNP Paribas Fortis, we want to attract and retain all talent, whatever their gender, age, background or sexual orientation, and irrespective of whether they are living with a disability, as every person has their own experiences and their own identity. All of our full-time vacancies are also open to candidates wishing to work on an 80% or 90% full-time equivalent basis.




If the function is categorized as a banking services provider function (cf. Law of 22 April 2019 establishing an oath and a disciplinary regime for the banking sector), you will also need to provide us with a 'certificate of absence of professional ban' from the FSMA confirming that you are not professionally disqualified.




TEMPTED BY THE CHALLENGE?

A first selection is made based on your CV and motivation letter. Are we convinced that you are the right candidate? Then we will contact you. Good luck!

Title: Senior Data Scientist - Commodity Trading and Risk Management
Description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, mental health, and vision coverage for you, your spouse/partner, and children.


Your Impact

You will leverage your creativity and problem-solving skills to tackle clients’ most pressing issues using an analytical lens, meeting client needs and communicating your work to executive audiences.

Client counterparts span a wide range of audiences and functions from treasury and risk professionals, marketing & sales teams, procurement category managers, to high-level stakeholders (e.g., CFO). When working internally, you will build innovative algorithms and products (what we call “IP development”) to best meet our most common client needs, from building price forecasting models for commodities markets, to brainstorming and developing new offers and solutions to support future clients. You will also work with our engineers to design new interfaces to deliver faster, more impactful insights to our clients.

Your work on the team will primarily be in applying advanced analytics to enable better commodity risk management decisions. For example, you might work as the lead in maintaining and expanding existing hedging strategies by re-training existing models through process driven approaches. You might also modify and improve algorithm performance across market regimes, by introducing new features, data sources, and modelling approaches; rapidly identify opportunities for our clients to increase earnings potential and reduce downside risk by back testing various risk management strategies; co-build bespoke tools with client data science teams that tailor machine-learning algorithms to attain an optimal balance of earnings and volatility given clients’ risk appetite and capital constraints; and/or collaborate with and train cross-functional client teams to instill long-lasting capabilities and ensure new decision-making models are embraced by organizations.

You will receive best-in-class training in structuring business problems and serving as a client adviser and have opportunities to work closely with and learn from our senior commodity and risk practitioners, as well as industry players that are shaping the future of commodity markets and trading. You will get access to unparalleled career acceleration, with a huge amount of ownership and responsibility from the get-go in a collaborative, diverse, non-hierarchical environment. You will get the opportunity to travel to client sites, locally and around the world (once travel resumes). Lastly, you will be able to provide direct and measurable impact to some of the largest organizations in agribusiness, materials, energy, industrial, and consumer foods sectors around the globe.

As a member of the Commodity Analytics team, you will be based in one of the following offices: Brussels, Amsterdam, Madrid or Lisbon. You’ll work closely with McKinsey’s Commodity Trading Service Line to support clients across sectors and geographies.

Commodity Analytics helps commodity producers, processors, buyers, and traders across agriculture/softs, metals, energy, and consumer sectors improve commodity price risk capabilities with cutting-edge data science.

The Commodity Trading Service Line at McKinsey supports clients in commodity trading and risk strategy, trading operations transformation, and trading and risk digitization driven by deep trading experts with hands-on trading experience and advanced analytics assets.

Our Risk Practice supports clients in many different industries facing challenges of developing and implementing tailored concepts for risk.

Your Qualifications and Skills

Required:


Undergraduate degree
Production-quality Python for model development, including optimization, time series forecasting, feature engineering, backtesting, and evaluation using standard DS toolkits (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels, gradient boosting, etc.)
Familiarity with pytest and reproducible research workflow; experience operationalizing models: versioned experiments, CI/CD, model monitoring and drift detection, and collaboration with engineering on APIs and model/solution design
Experience applying advanced analytical and statistical methods to solve business problems involving commodity markets
Ability to explain commodity market nuances and/or complex analytics approaches and results in layman’s terms to executive audiences across commodity trading, operations, supply chain / logistics, and finance / accounting functions


Preferred experience (all not expected):


Advanced degree in a quantitative discipline (computer science, applied mathematics, economics, quantitative finance, engineering) or equivalent practitioner experience
2+ years’ experience in commodity markets developing market research, trading, or hedging/risk management strategies such as netback/deal economics, signal backtesting, stress testing, and/or hedge effectivenes
2+ years’ experience in physical/cash markets of metals, power/electricity markets, natural gas, crude oil, refined products, and/or ocean freight
2+ years’ experience applying time series analysis of mean-reverting and cointegrated commodity prices/premiums (e.g., ARIMA, VECM, GARCH), supervised learning (e.g., SVM, LSTM, parallel or sequential tree-based models), unsupervised learning (e.g., PCA, K-means clustering), optimization (e.g., LP/MILP and stochastic models), and/or NLP sentiment analysis
6+ months’ experience with LLM-based analytics in enterprise settings (e.g., document/comms extraction, RAG, evaluation/guardrails)
Experience integrating data science and/or automation workflows with CTRM/ETRM systems via API
Experience automating middle/back-office processes with PRA and LLMs (e.g., pre-trade KYC/credit, trade execution, compliance, logistics, trade settlement)
