Title: PhD Researcher: AI-driven Employee-Customer Relationship Management in the Service Sector
Description:
Please note that Dutch at the B2 level is required for this vacancy.

Do you have a passion for business-relevant research and the ambition to obtain your PhD on the hot topic of creating business value with data analytics and AI? Do you have the right academic background and are you ready to start this 4-year journey in our open, international and collegial environment? Let’s meet!

PhD Researcher: AI-driven Employee-Customer Relationship Management in the Service Sector

Vlerick Business School is an innovative, top-ranked and sustainable international business school in the heart of Europe. Our purpose is to transform people for a better world! We want being at Vlerick to be a transformative experience where you discover the knowledge, mindset and confidence you need to take your next leap – and become the entrepreneurial leader our world needs.

Glowi is a dynamic group offering innovative services across multiple domains to make life easier for individuals and businesses. Its business units include Het Poetsbureau & Easy Life (Glowi Home); Friends of Cartel (Marketing Solutions), Glowi Jobs and Motmans & Partners (HR Solutions). Together, they combine expertise and passion to create solutions that truly make a difference.

As a Belgian company, Glowi is at the forefront of innovation in the cleaning services sector, combining operational excellence with data-driven insights to transform how clients and cleaners connect. With a strong focus on decentralised communication, performance tracking, and human-centric consultancy, Glowi empowers its teams to deliver measurable impact across cleaner acquisition, client retention, and administrative efficiency. The company’s commitment to continuous improvement and smart technology integration makes it a catalyst for change in a traditionally manual industry. Their main office in Beringen.

At Glowi, data is an important asset that can be transformed into business value through innovative AI-based methodologies. In a collaboration with Vlerick Business School, Glowi wants to research these opportunities. We are looking for a business-oriented data scientist to develop and research AI opportunities in the service sector with academic rigour.

As part of our close-knit team, you’ll bring Vlerick’s strategy and purpose to life. Are you excited to join our Area Marketing & Sales team as a PhD Researcher? Here’s what you need to know!

Your Mission

You will combine academic research with direct business impact, translating data and AI insights into real-world applications.

Academic focus


Complete a 4-year PhD on data analytics and AI.
Conduct academic and applied research, including data collection, modelling, AI agent development, evaluation and reporting.
Disseminate insights through papers, reports, workshops, presentations and social media for both academic and business audiences.
Collaborate with faculty, researchers and support the activities of the research area.


Business impact


Work with client and employee data from Glowi.
Develop predictive models and AI-driven solutions that are operationalised within the organisation.
Design and evaluate genAI-supported workflows and AI agents embedded in existing processes.
Work closely with Glowi’s Data & AI team and business stakeholders to improve key business KPIs.


The Research

Your PhD research will focus on employee-customer relationship management (acquisition, development and retention) within the cleaning services sector, exploring how machine learning and AI agents can generate insights and improve processes.

The exact research topic will be defined together with the PhD candidate and may include:


AI-driven employee and customer acquisition
Consultant coaching effects on development and churn
Skills, knowledge and behaviour (KSB) matching in recruitment and retention
Employee absenteeism and performance modelling
Pricing and price sensitivity analysis
Hyper-personalised employee and customer communication using genAI
Process automation using genAI and reinforcement learning


All research is conducted in close collaboration with the business and combines state-of-the-art technology, real-world data, advanced modelling, and academic and managerial reporting.

You


Obtained a master’s degree in business analytics, business engineering, artificial intelligence, data science, business administration, economics, computer science, civil engineering, statistics, mathematics, or equivalent.
Have excellent qualifications during your studies, such as distinctions (cum laude or higher) at the bachelor's and master's levels.
Have good communication skills and a business mindset, which allows you to easily switch between different stakeholders at all levels.
Can take up responsibilities and work independently.
Are passionate about the topic, have a research mindset and great analytical skills.
Have a good knowledge of data analytics and machine learning.
Can program and have experience with Python and SQL.
Preferably have experience with Microsoft Fabric and Azure.
Are fluent in Dutch and English and have excellent writing skills.
Have a proactive attitude and don’t shy away from presenting your findings to an academic and business audience.
Will be based on one of our Vlerick campuses (Ghent or Brussels) and the office of Glowi at


#ProudtobeVlerick


Autonomy and responsibility in an engaging work environment.
A dynamic, open, and international company culture.
Opportunities for professional and personal growth.
A team of enthusiastic, driven colleagues, passionate about learning.
Opportunities to build your network, both in academics and in business.
You’ll have a real impact and inspire people to live, learn and leap!


At Vlerick, openness to the world is part of our DNA. We are continuously working towards being a truly diverse, equitable and inclusive place to work and learn at. So, no matter who you are, where you come from, or what your dreams are, we are looking forward to receiving your application.

Vlerick Business School is the hosting institute for this PhD journey with Philippe Baecke as your promoter. Your salary will be in line with the salary scales at Ghent University. More information on the salary can be transparently accessed via this link.

Take the leap!

In case you are interested in this PhD journey and meet the mentioned criteria, please apply with your resume, motivation letter and transcripts from both your bachelor’s and master’s degree via our website. If available, please also add the results of your TOEFL or IELTS and your GRE score. We look forward to hearing from you! Happy to give you more information on the job content: philippe.baecke@vlerick.com. For more information on the selection process, please reach out to charlotte.mahieu@vlerick.com.

With a strong focus on decentralised communication, performance tracking, and human-centric consultancy, Glowi empowers its teams to deliver measurable impact across cleaner acquisition, client retention, and administrative efficiency. The company’s commitment to continuous improvement and smart technology integration makes it a catalyst for change in a traditionally manual industry. Their main office in Beringen.

At Glowi, data is an important asset that can be transformed into business value through innovative AI-based methodologies. In a collaboration with Vlerick Business School, Glowi wants to research these opportunities. We are looking for a business-oriented data scientist to develop and research AI opportunities in the service sector with academic rigour.

As part of our close-knit team, you’ll bring Vlerick’s strategy and purpose to life. Are you excited to join our Area Marketing & Sales team as a PhD Researcher? Here’s what you need to know!

Your Mission

You will combine academic research with direct business impact, translating data and AI insights into real-world applications.

Academic focus

  • Complete a 4-year PhD on data analytics and AI.
  • Conduct academic and applied research, including data collection, modelling, AI agent development, evaluation and reporting.
  • Disseminate insights through papers, reports, workshops, presentations and social media for both academic and business audiences.
  • Collaborate with faculty, researchers and support the activities of the research area.

Business impact

  • Work with client and employee data from Glowi.
  • Develop predictive models and AI-driven solutions that are operationalised within the organisation.
  • Design and evaluate genAI-supported workflows and AI agents embedded in existing processes.
  • Work closely with Glowi’s Data & AI team and business stakeholders to improve key business KPIs.

The Research

Your PhD research will focus on employee-customer relationship management (acquisition, development and retention) within the cleaning services sector, exploring how machine learning and AI agents can generate insights and improve processes.

The exact research topic will be defined together with the PhD candidate and may include:

  • AI-driven employee and customer acquisition
  • Consultant coaching effects on development and churn
  • Skills, knowledge and behaviour (KSB) matching in recruitment and retention
  • Employee absenteeism and performance modelling
  • Pricing and price sensitivity analysis
  • Hyper-personalised employee and customer communication using genAI
  • Process automation using genAI and reinforcement learning

All research is conducted in close collaboration with the business and combines state-of-the-art technology, real-world data, advanced modelling, and academic and managerial reporting.

You

  • Have excellent qualifications during your studies, such as distinctions (cum laude or higher) at the bachelor's and master's levels.

  • Preferably have experience with Microsoft Fabric and Azure.

  • A team of enthusiastic, driven colleagues, passionate about learning.

Title: Senior Data Science & AI Expert | AI Governance
Description:
About the job




We are looking for a Senior Data Science & AI Expert to lead advanced analytics and artificial intelligence initiatives while helping define and implement an enterprise-wide AI governance framework in a regulated environment.




The role combines hands-on technical delivery, business-facing advisory and team coaching. You will lead use cases from business scoping and value assessment through production deployment and monitoring, while helping ensure that AI initiatives are assessed, approved and managed consistently in terms of value, investment, risk and regulatory compliance.




Assignment: October 2026 – 31 March 2027.




Responsibilities:

-Lead Data Science and AI use cases end to end, from business scoping and value assessment through development, deployment, adoption and performance monitoring.

-Challenge business needs, assess technical feasibility and expected value, and define success criteria.

-Provide clear recommendations to support use-case prioritisation and investment decisions.

-Develop advanced analytics, Machine Learning and generative AI solutions, or supervise their delivery by team members and partners.

-Coordinate business, Data and IT stakeholders, managing risks, dependencies and decisions throughout delivery.

-Provide hands-on technical guidance, review deliverables and coach team members to strengthen their Data Science and AI capabilities.

-Define and promote robust technical practices.

-Advise business teams and management on AI opportunities, limitations and implementation choices.

-Lead the definition and implementation of an enterprise-wide AI governance framework aligned with applicable organisational standards, responsible AI principles and the EU AI Act.

-Establish practical processes to identify and assess AI initiatives, validate implementations and support investment decisions.

-Track expected and realised value and establish oversight processes supporting regulatory compliance across the organisation.




Must-have requirements:

-University degree in a quantitative or technical field, or equivalent professional experience.

-At least 7 years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning or AI.

-Proven end-to-end delivery experience, from business scoping through production deployment and monitoring.

-Strong hands-on expertise in Python, SQL, Machine Learning and generative AI.

-Solid understanding of solution industrialisation and MLOps.

-Experience acting as a senior technical reference, including guiding colleagues, reviewing their work and coaching less experienced team members.

-Ability to challenge business needs and assess the value and feasibility of proposed solutions.

-Ability to translate complex technical topics into clear recommendations for business stakeholders and management.

-Good understanding of enterprise-wide AI governance and the ability to help establish processes for identifying, assessing, approving and overseeing AI initiatives.

-Understanding of how AI governance addresses investment, value creation, risk and regulatory compliance.

-Ability to coordinate cross-functional stakeholders and work effectively in a regulated environment.

-Fluent English and fluency in either French or Dutch.




How to apply:

Apply directly through this job post with your CV, highlighting your experience in end-to-end AI delivery, technical coaching and enterprise-wide AI governance.

At ING Belgium, we are looking for a Model Developer to join our Credit Risk Regulatory Modelling team. In this role, you will contribute to the development, maintenance and enhancement of regulatory credit risk models that support key business and regulatory decisions.

You will work in an international environment alongside highly qualified professionals and play an important role in ensuring the robustness and accuracy of ING's credit risk framework.

As a Model Developer, you will be responsible for the development and maintenance of models used to calculate Regulatory Credit Capital under Basel regulations and Loan Loss Provisions under IFRS 9.

You Will


Develop, maintain and monitor credit risk models, including PD, LGD, EAD and IFRS 9 models
Perform quantitative analyses and translate regulatory requirements into modelling solutions
Support the implementation and validation of models throughout their lifecycle
Prepare high-quality analyses and reports for senior management, Model Validation, Audit and regulatory authorities
Collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders across Risk, Finance and Business teams
Participate in discussions with internal and external auditors, Model Validation teams and the European Central Bank

A Master's degree or PhD in Econometrics, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Economics or another quantitative discipline
Experience in credit risk modelling, preferably within IRB and/or IFRS 9 frameworks
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Experience with SAS or other statistical programming languages
The ability to work independently while maintaining a collaborative mindset
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
A proactive, critical and solution-oriented attitude
Professional proficiency in English

At ING, you'll have the opportunity to grow both professionally and personally in a challenging and dynamic environment.

We Offer


Challenging projects at the forefront of risk management and regulation
A collaborative and international working environment
Opportunities for continuous learning and development
An agile way of working where innovation is encouraged
Flexible working arrangements
A competitive salary package with a wide range of additional benefits

Title: Senior Analyst - Consumer Credit Risk & Underwriting
Description:
Klarna, briefly

At Klarna, we're building an everyday finance network, helping over 120 million consumers across 26 countries save time and money, and worry less about their finances.Working at Klarna means taking on problems most companies never get to solve, and being hands-on enough that the interesting part of the work lands with you, not someone else. You'll build with AI, not watch it happen.

This is the stretch zone. Come find out what you're capable of.

About The Role

Klarna is bringing its Fair Financing product live in Belgium. As a Senior Analyst on the credit decisioning team, you'll build and defend the underwriting policies that decide who gets credit in Belgium and on what terms, working from bureau data and models built specifically for the Belgian market.

You'll work alongside Product, Risk, and the regional Belgium team to bring that policy onto Klarna's Global Underwriting Platform (GUP), the shared framework that will power credit decisions across markets.

What You'll Do


You'll analyze Belgian consumer credit risk using SQL and Belgian credit bureau data to find where underwriting policy should tighten or loosen.
You'll work with Product, Risk, and the Belgium regional team to bring Belgium's credit policy onto Klarna's Global Underwriting Platform.
You'll align purchase power and pre-qualification logic for the Belgian market across Klarna's App and its One Card product.
You'll monitor how the Belgian bureau data feeding your models performs, and flag where sourcing or model quality needs to change.
You'll turn what your analysis shows into policy changes that underwriting, product, and the regional team can act on directly.


Who you are


You've worked in consumer credit risk, underwriting, or credit policy, and you understand how a policy change affects both approval rates and portfolio health.
You're proficient in SQL and comfortable working directly with large, messy datasets.
You know credit bureau data, repayment behavior, and credit risk modeling well enough to spot where the numbers don't add up.
You work through ambiguous or inconsistent policy logic methodically until you find the actual root cause.
You've built underwriting or payment logic for a market where direct debit or local push payment methods, not card, are the default.
You can turn a data finding into a policy change that underwriting, product, and regional teams can each act on.


Bonus points for


A degree in Finance, Economics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.


Things you should know before applying


Working together: we value co-located teams; most teams currently meet in the office 2–3 days per week, and this varies by team and can change over time.
Non-obvious backgrounds are welcome. Diversity of skills, perspectives and backgrounds is how we create, innovate, and disrupt like no other.
Final compensation will be based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and experience.
Depending on your background, this could land as an Analyst role or a Data Scientist role — we'll settle the exact title with you once we understand your experience.


Please include a CV in English.

Title: Freelance Data Scientist with Ontology and Graph expertise
Description:
Job Description

adesso Belgium is looking for a data scientist (2) to support our customer in building an AI Agent Platform Data Foundations.

Customer Info

Our customer is an international, independent provider of indirect procurement services.

Job Requirements

Preferred start date: 1xASAP and 1x January 2027

Duration: 12 months

Rate: depending on your location

Time Zone: CET

Your role

Build the data and context layer that powers the customer's procurement AI agent platform — canonical models, knowledge graph, semantic/taxonomy layer, and the retrieval and evaluation pipelines agents depend on. This is production infrastructure from day one, not a proof of concept: versioned, tested, and built for multiple tenants.

You Will Work On


Data products & canonical modeling — Design and deliver the first reference data products (Supplier Master, Spend Cube, Contract Register) end to end, from source ingestion through the canonical model.
Knowledge graph & ontology — Stand up and operate the platform and working graphs (ontology, reference data, tenant separation); own the graph-plus-vector retrieval design, deciding per source whether data is represented as entities/relationships, embeddings, or both.
Master data & semantic layer — Build matching rules, golden records, and stewardship processes for Suppliers, Contracts, and Categories; contribute to the business glossary and taxonomy-to-ontology mapping.
Extraction & evaluation — Build document-extraction pipelines (e.g., from SharePoint sources) with confidence scoring and human review for uncertain cases; build and maintain labelled evaluation datasets and accuracy benchmarks against agreed thresholds.
Connector framework — Build source connectors (starting with Fabric data products and master data golden records) so new sources can be onboarded without modifying the graph core or query service.
Quality feedback loop — Implement the mechanism routing agent overrides, failures, or low-confidence retrievals back to data owners so data products improve over time rather than decay.
Engineering practice — Work exclusively in the GitHub/Azure environment; ship via pull request with CI (build, tests, security scan, evaluation fixtures); version all schemas, connector contracts, and extraction configs.


Hard Skills

Required Experience


Demonstrated experience taking a knowledge graph system to production (not just prototyping) — schema design, query performance, tenant/data isolation - Using Neo4J and Python
Strong background in semantic modeling: ontologies, taxonomies, business glossaries, and their relationship to graph and canonical data models.
Hands-on experience with semantic web standards and technologies including OWL/OWL2, RDF, RDFS, SPARQL, ontology lifecycle management, taxonomy alignment, and semantic reasoning.
Experience building data products and master-data pipelines (entity matching, golden-record consolidation, stewardship workflows).
Experience designing and implementing hybrid retrieval architectures combining graph databases (e.g., Neo4j) and vector databases to support semantic search, RAG, and AI agent workloads.
Experience with retrieval architectures combining graph and vector/embedding approaches.
Experience building and maintaining labelled evaluation datasets and measuring extraction/model accuracy against a threshold.
Proficiency with modern data/ML engineering practices: version control, CI/CD, automated testing, containerized deployment
Experience with Microsoft Fabric and SharePoint-based document extraction pipelines.


Soft Skills


Fluent in ENG
Open to travelling if needed (EU), this position is fully remote
Collaborative mindset, ideally with a proven similar work experience


Why join adesso Belgium?


Work in an international group with strong local expertise in Belgium.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver trusted, compliant, reusable data products.
Flexible freelance setup with the support of a growing adesso Belgium community.

Title: Research & Insights Analyst F/M (Advanced Quant & Data Integration)
Description:
Are you excited for your new career adventure?   


At Lyreco, we offer more than just a job, but a career!

About Lyreco

Lyreco is the European leader and the third largest distributor of workplace products and services in the world. Privately owned since 1926, Lyreco has continuously adapted to the evolving workplace through operational excellence, strong customer focus, and long-term supplier partnerships.

With more than 12,000 employees, Lyreco operates directly in 25 countries across Europe and Asia and covers 17 additional markets through a network of distribution partners.

To learn more about Lyreco – see our career website here

What We Offer

To support the development of our Customer Intelligence Team, we are looking for a Customer Experience Research & Insights Analyst who will help us transform customer knowledge into meaningful business decisions.

As Customer Experience Research & Insights Analyst, you will play a key role in generating actionable customer insights through advanced quantitative research and data analysis.

Working closely with Customer Experience, Marketing, Sales Excellence and Merchandising stakeholders, you will connect multiple data sources and uncover the customer behaviours, needs and drivers that help shape strategic business decisions.

You will join an international team of customer research, journey management and service design professionals focused on turning insights into action.

In This Role You Will


Design and execute quantitative research projects to better understand customer needs, behaviours and expectations.
Gather business information needs and translate them into research objectives and methodologies.
Conduct advanced statistical analyses including segmentation, cluster analysis, regression analysis and driver modelling.
Analyse and connect multiple data sources including survey data, CRM information, digital analytics, customer care interactions and revenue data.
Identify patterns, correlations and key drivers influencing customer behaviour and business performance.
Develop dashboards and reporting solutions combining behavioural, attitudinal and operational data.
Collaborate with external research agencies when required and ensure business needs are translated into research requirements.
Partner with internal stakeholders to transform complex analyses into clear and actionable business recommendations.
Support the evolution of customer intelligence capabilities across Lyreco by helping connect existing data sources and uncovering new insights opportunities.



YOUR PROFILE



Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Market Research, Business Analytics, Economics, Marketing Analytics, or a related field.
Minimum 5 years of experience in Market Research, Customer Insights, Consumer Insights or Analytics.
Strong expertise in quantitative research methodologies and advanced statistical analysis.
Hands-on experience with techniques such as segmentation, cluster analysis, regression analysis and driver analysis.
Experience working with survey platforms such as Qualtrics or equivalent research tools.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to transform data into business recommendations.
Advanced Excel skills.
Experience with SPSS or similar statistical analysis tools.
Knowledge of R and/or Python would be considered a strong advantage.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in an international environment.
Experience in a B2B environment would be an advantage. Previous experience gained within a research, insights, or consulting agency would also be highly valued.


Reasons To Join Lyreco Management


A full- time job in a dynamic, passionate, international team
Possibility to join internal accelerator program
Competitive salary
Hybrid work model
Pension plan
Personal growth budget



If the above job description interests you and you think you are a good fit, apply now! We look forward to receiving your application!

Description:
Senior AI Engineer - Consultant

Permanent

FR or NL + EN




Our Data & Digital team at Orange Business is a dynamic community of expert consultants revolutionizing Customer Experience, Cloud, Data, and AI across various sectors, including retail, finance, manufacturing, life sciences, and public services.




With 30 years of expertise, we remain at the forefront of innovation, revolutionizing business transformation across industry with the full potential of AI and GenAI technologies at scale in a sustainable way.




We have a significant international presence, with 20% of our activity extending beyond Belgium, and this number continues to grow. By joining us, you will be part of a global impact on businesses around the world.




Check out some of our ongoing project:

Orange Business dives into restoration of the coral reefs with Tēnaka:
In order to monitor the effects of coral restoration programs, we are designing, implementing and monitoring a fish diversity counting system using Computer Vision.
Our customer Sappi, global pulp and paper company, requested our help to significantly reduce energy costs on a daily basis using analytics. Our team (10 consultants) is ingesting & transforming data, creating, deploying and optimizing multiple ML models and exposing it in dashboards to drive down energy consumption.
Together with Carrefour we created a Unified Customer Feedback Insights Platform that used Generative AI to assign a topic and a sentiment to all incoming customer feedback, allowing us to have a unified and actionable view per topic.
Agentic AI: automatizing part of the customer service for major retailer through multi-agentic system integrating ERP, CRM data and unstructured technical product documentation.
Our Redbull Customer, requested us to provide an agentic AI on one of their website to support a end-user creative/brainstorming request.
Our internal AI team is focusing on reviewing / re-inventing our way to providing IT Consultancy services leveraging power of AI agents and Coding models.




Orange Business gets recognized “Best in Class” in Europe for 4 AI Categories including “GenAI services” in the 2024 PAC Radar.




We value people who are proactive on every level, deliver exceptional results, work well with others, and make a clear impact on our clients and our business. If you love collaborating, learning, sharing your expertise, and being recognized for your achievements, you’ll fit right in with our team.




Interested in taking part in this exciting journey? Please take a look at the following requirements and let’s meet up if that matches your profile!




What You’ll Do:

All the responsibilities we’ll trust you with




As a AI Engineer, you’ll be at the heart of exciting projects that leverage advanced analytics and machine learning. Your work will help our clients optimize their business processes by using, deploying and monitoring latest AI technologies.

Lead the Way: Design, deploy and monitor advanced analytical models tailored to meet the unique needs of our clients. From quick, high-impact proof-of-concepts to large-scale implementations, deliver solutions that create measurable value.
Get Creative: Dive into projects involving natural language processing, generative AI, optimization, anomaly detection, and predictive analytics. Use cutting-edge machine learning techniques to create impactful solutions.
Mentor and Collaborate: Share your expertise with junior data scientists and foster a collaborative environment. Work alongside cross-functional teams to integrate data-driven solutions seamlessly into client operations.
Engage with Clients: Present findings and strategic recommendations, translating complex concepts into clear, actionable insights. Build strong relationships with clients to understand their evolving needs and spot new opportunities.




Who you are:

What matters most for this role




Your interests & soft skills:

Interest in digital transformation and data-driven solutions
Proactive mindset and outside the box thinking to tackle challenges.
You are able to explain technical concepts to a non-technical audience.
You excel in interpersonal communication and know how to have a professional and commercial approach with customers.
You value collaboration as a way to succeed
Strong communication and presentation skills in French and/or Dutch + English




Your technical expertise:

A master’s or bachelor’s degree in IT, a related technical field.
5 to 8 years of AI experience, with at least one Generative AI project and a proven track record of leading complex projects.
Programming: Expert in Python, with strong SQL skills.
MLOPs: Deployment & Monitoring of AI models at scale using docker, ML pipelines…
Techniques and algorithms: Generative AI, regression, classification, NLP, clustering/ segmentation, …
Cloud Data Platforms: Azure or GCP for AI projects is highly valued.
Generative AI: tools leveraging Gen AI or developing projects using Gen AI.
Business understanding & problem solving: Strong ability to grasp business requirements and develop or refine algorithms to meet those needs effectively.




It is not a requirement, but other preferred qualifications would be:

DevOps methodologies: knowing what CI/CD and terraform is and being able to use it
Good coding practices: best practices in coding and code refactoring.




Why you should join us:

Some of the rewards of working at Orange Business




A community of experts - as Digital Natives, we put innovation at the heart of our expertise. Continuously seeking new ideas, we proudly host regular “Guild” workshops and knowledge-sharing sessions through our Data Meetups.
Career growth possibilities towards roles such as AI Architect and AI Strategist
We may work with tomorrow’s technology, but at our core we are a people-oriented organization.
An open and inclusive culture, that enables us to reach our full potential.
Hybrid ways of working and modern & collaborative office in Brussels
Compelling advantages including a yearly bonus scheme, a flexible mobility with possibility for a housing budget, representation and expense allowances…




Ready to build with us?

We screen applications on an ongoing basis, with the aim of conducting conversations and interviews as we receive them.

Interested but feel that you don´t match the criteria 100%? We encourage you to apply anyway! Your perfect match might be the next job we are announcing, so why not have a head start and apply now!

Apply with your CV and (if available) links to GitHub, portfolio, or examples of work that reflect your experience.




More about Orange Business:

Orange Business is the Orange Group entity dedicated to businesses and organizations. Our unique history as a telco operator and now an IT services company enables us to support the sustainable digital transformation of enterprise businesses worldwide.

We bring the rigor of a network and connectivity expert together with the agility of a global digital solutions integrator. We combine global presence with a local approach to get the most out of digital technology, from networks and cloud to data and service platforms.

Digital & Data is the dedicated Orange Business entity for professional services in digital and data, operating as part of the Orange Business European organization. We help enterprises design, build and deliver digital and data solutions, from consulting and advisory through to large-scale implementation and managed services, combining deep technical expertise with the operational agility of a ringfenced organization. By pooling expertise across countries, we offer clients a consistent European delivery model, the ability to reuse proven capabilities at scale, and seamless integration with Orange Business' wider proposition in network, AI, trusted cloud and cybersecurity. This dedicated focus on professional services, backed by the strength and reach of Orange Business and the Orange Group, means our clients benefit from specialized digital and data expertise delivered with clear accountability, European coverage, and the assurance of a trusted long-term partner.

Description:
Data Analyst / Data Visualisation Consultant

Who We Are

NORRIQ is a leading international consulting firm headquartered in Denmark and Belgium, with 350+ consultants driving business transformation through technology. Our Financial Services practice includes 100+ specialists supporting banks, insurers, and financial institutions in navigating regulatory challenges, embracing emerging technologies, and meeting evolving client demands. We prioritize growth, innovation, and excellence, offering abundant opportunities for professional development and collaboration.

The Opportunity

NORRIQ is seeking to grow its Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence team with additional Data Analyst / Data Visualisation Consultants to improve the business performance of financial institutions. You will help our clients to optimize the value they can get from their internal and external data, through improved business performance monitoring and enhanced reporting quality and readability. Join us to work on impactful projects that shape the future of finance.

Responsibilities


Collecting and interpreting internal and external data about customer behaviour via the digital platforms (Web and mobile) and their digital transactions with the bank.
Translate data insight into actionable recommendations in order to coordinate the business needs around data and improve the bank’s digital and marketing strategy and optimize future campaigns.

Title: AI Engineer

As an AI Engineer, you'll play a key role in designing, building, and deploying production-grade AI solutions that improve customer experience, automate business processes, and unlock value from large volumes of enterprise data.

Annual bonus

Title: Data Dashboard Developer (Python ETL, Power BI, Web Applications) for NATO with security clearance
Description:
The analysts have the numbers. You build what makes senior leaders actually read them.

A data analysis team at an international defence organisation in Brussels needs a developer who can turn data from many sources into clean web applications and dashboards for senior leadership. The work is mostly remote, with a handful of visits to Brussels.

Designing, building and deploying web applications and dashboards with modern front-end frameworks
Bringing data from classified and unclassified sources into those systems, with Python and ETL tooling doing the conversion and preparation

Building dashboards for leadership in Python or Power BI
Documenting code, endpoints and architecture, writing training material and handing knowledge over to staff
Supporting security testing and approval, reporting progress and flagging risks to the timeline early


What you would bring


At least 5 years of web development in JavaScript and HTML with React, Vue.js or Angular
Extensive MS SQL experience; .NET is an advantage
Python for automation, ETL and analysis (pandas, numpy, matplotlib) and experience building backend services or pipelines
Dashboards built for senior stakeholders in Python and/or Power BI
Git, Agile ways of working and a bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, IT or similar
Advanced English and clear, confident communication


Why this one is worth a look

Your work lands directly in front of senior decision-makers, the pattern is largely remote, and it sits under a standing framework rather than a one-off project.

Support the preparation of briefings and presentations.




What we're looking for




One of the following: a Master's degree (EQF level 7); or a Bachelor's degree (EQF level 6) and a minimum of 2 years of relevant IT professional experience; or secondary education and a minimum of 7 years of relevant IT professional experience.
Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written, at C1 level or higher.
At least 1 year of experience working with public administration and/or in the digital transformation of public administration, in a national or international context.
At least 1 year of experience collecting, cleaning and analysing data in the domain of public administration, using SQL, Python or R to extract, transform and analyse structured and unstructured datasets.
Eligibility to obtain EU security clearance, or already holding EU security clearance.
Experience creating dashboards and reports with Power BI or similar BI tools.
Ability to analyse datasets, detect trends and deliver evidence-based insights.
Ability to present findings with visuals and storytelling.
Ability to resolve data issues and propose actionable improvements.
Experience in stakeholder communication.
Experience working with collaborative platforms (e.g., SharePoint, JIRA).
Flexibility to adopt new data platforms, tools and approaches.




Nice to have




Good understanding of digital transformation and eGovernance in public organisations.
Experience designing and analysing surveys.
Experience supporting EU-funded or technical assistance projects.
Experience working within European Institutions or large public administration environments.
Knowledge of other EU languages, especially French.

Prestigious projects within European institutions.
International, innovative, and multicultural environments.
Continuous support from a team of experts in EU projects.

Job Description

Let’s shape the future of finance - together

At Isabel, we believe that real innovation happens when people and ideas connect

That’s why we’re building more than technology, we’re building an ecosystem.

One where every voice counts, and where your work can truly make a difference.

We’re looking for curious minds and collaborative builders. People who believe success means growing together, learning from each other, and challenging the status quo.

If that sounds like you, keep reading.

Strengthen Isabel’s AI-native data team by combining BI development with functional business and data-domain expertise.

An important objective is to go beyond delivering static reports and dashboards. This person will enable business users to interact directly and intuitively with data, using self-service BI, AI-powered solutions, and potentially conversational data experiences. This should make trusted data and insights more accessible while maintaining appropriate governance and quality.

Main tasks


Develop a strong functional understanding of Isabel’s business and data domains.
Engage with stakeholders to identify reporting, analytical, and operational needs.
Translate these needs into dashboards, insights, data products, and operational solutions.
Enable business users to explore, question, and interact with data through self-service and AI-powered capabilities.
Create intuitive and governed data experiences that reduce dependency on the data team for recurring questions.
Develop solutions using Databricks, Power BI, SQL, and related technologies.
Work closely with data engineers and business and technical stakeholders.
Apply an AI-native approach to analysis, development, testing, documentation, and delivery.
Proactively identify relevant insights, data-quality issues, and opportunities for business or process improvement.
Help improve data literacy and encourage effective use of data across the organisation.

What makes you a great fit


A hybrid functional and technical BI/data professional.
Strong stakeholder-management and requirements-analysis skills.
Able to understand complex business processes and data domains.
Hands-on knowledge of Databricks, Power BI, SQL, and modern data platforms.
Fluent in AI-assisted development and capable of creating AI-enabled ways for users to access and interact with data.
Able to make complex data understandable and accessible to non-technical users.
Proactive, curious, collaborative, and focused on delivering business value.

At Isabel, we offer more than a job, we offer a place to grow, contribute, and thrive.


A human-sized Belgian company (250 people) where your ideas and impact matter
50% hybrid work, flexible hours, and autonomy to manage your time

A flat, collaborative structure with real ownership and cross-functional work

A certified Top Employer with 30 years of tech leadership and ambition


Ready to join us?

Your voice, your vision, and your impact all have a place here.

Let’s shape smarter solutions and a stronger digital economy. Together.

Title: AI & Data Engineer
Description:
Wat je zal doen
Ben jij de AI & Data Engineer die ons team wil versterken om innovatieve data pipelines en state-of-the-art AI-oplossingen te ontwikkelen?

Als AI & Data Engineer bij iO ben je in de eerste plaats een ervaren software engineer die AI- en data-oplossingen bouwt, integreert en operationeel maakt binnen bestaande IT-ecosystemen van klanten.

Je gaat aan de slag met diverse AI-problemen: van het slim inzetten of fine-tunen van Large Language Models, agent en multi-agent setups, het toepassen van RAG-patronen, tot het bouwen van ETL-pipelines die een data platform voedt. Het terugkerende patroon is dat je bestaande cloud services en APIs integreert tot een efficiënt, schaalbaar en betrouwbaar geheel. De focus ligt daarbij op het bouwen van production-grade oplossingen die correct functioneren binnen complexe, vaak enterprise IT-landschappen.

Prompt engineering is voor jou een 'art form', waarbij je creatief nadenkt over hoe je de beste resultaten kunt krijgen, met oog voor het voorkomen van hallucinaties of het toepassen van slimme guardrails. Je evalueert je oplossingen op een systematische manier om inzicht te krijgen in de kwaliteit van de output.

Je komt in je werk in aanraking met allerlei soorten AI: van statistische modellen tot Large Language Models, van Generative AI op het vlak van afbeeldingen, video en audio tot Natural Language Processing. Het gaat vooral om het inzetten en toepassen van bestaande modellen en services, en het maken van de infrastructuur daaromheen.

Je werkt aan allerlei verschillende klantvraagstukken: van het automatisch analyseren van documenten tot het herkennen van gebeurtenissen in audio of videodata, aan het bouwen van agents en orchestratie oplossingen, aan het genereren van grafische output op basis van data, of aan het creëren of valideren van content. Daar waar AI een plek kan vinden, zet jij als engineer de totaaloplossing neer.

Je werkt samen met de verschillende AI-experten binnen iO en met diverse technische teams op klanten. Je oplossingen zijn gebaseerd op moderne (cloud)platformen, SaaS-services en talen als TypeScript en Python.

Wat zijn jouw taken als AI & Data Engineer?


AI en Data oplossingen bedenken: Klantenvraagstukken omtrent AI en data analyseren en uitwerken van oplossingen, aanpak en architectuur.
Software engineering & integratie: Ontwikkelen van backend componenten, API’s en services om AI-oplossingen correct te laten samenwerken met bestaande applicaties en platformen.
Data Pipeline Development: Ontwerpen en bouwen van robuuste ETL/ELT processen en real-time data streams
Data Platform Architecture: Opzetten van moderne data warehouses, data lakes en analytics platforms
AI Integration: Implementeren van machine learning pipelines en integratie van AI-services in data workflows
Data Quality & Governance: Waarborgen van datakwaliteit, security en compliance binnen data ecosystemen
Performance Optimization: Optimaliseren van data processing performance en schaalbaarheid
Cloud Data Services: Werken met cloud-native data diensten zoals AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, of Google DataFlow
Monitoring & Observability: Implementeren van monitoring en alerting voor data pipelines en AI-workloads


Je Kwaliteiten En Skills

Je hebt een Bachelor of Master diploma met focus op software engineering.
Je hebt meerdere jaren ervaring als software engineer en hebt gewerkt aan data- en/of AI-gedreven systemen in een professionele, bij voorkeur enterprise context.
Je hebt ervaring met verschillende LLM-architecturen en je weet waar de sterke en zwakke punten liggen van diverse AI-oplossingen. Je kent de principes van moderne data architecturen, data modeling en big data processing.
Je beheerst moderne data processing talen zoals Python, SQL en hebt ervaring met frameworks zoals Apache Spark, Pandas, of Dask. Je bent bekend met AWS of Azure cloud data platformen.
Je hebt een sterke basis in software engineering, met kennis van o.a. CI/CD, Unit Testing, Git (flow) en secure development, error handling, asynchrone operaties en real-time data streams.
Je kunt je ideeën goed omzetten in technische architectuurdiagrammen, dataflow schema's en documentatie, maar je slaagt er ook in je oplossingen toe te lichten aan een minder technisch publiek (klant en collega’s)
Je vindt het leuk om over je ideeën en oplossingen te sparren met collega's en om samen met hen tot een beter resultaat te komen.

Je werkt aan allerlei verschillende klantvraagstukken: van het automatisch analyseren van documenten tot het herkennen van gebeurtenissen in audio of videodata, aan het bouwen van agents en orchestratie oplossingen, aan het genereren van grafische output op basis van data, of aan het creëren of valideren van content. Daar waar AI een plek kan vinden, zet jij als engineer de totaaloplossing neer.

Je werkt samen met de verschillende AI-experten binnen iO en met diverse technische teams op klanten. Je oplossingen zijn gebaseerd op moderne (cloud)platformen, SaaS-services en talen als TypeScript en Python.

Wat zijn jouw taken als AI & Data Engineer?

  • AI en Data oplossingen bedenken: Klantenvraagstukken omtrent AI en data analyseren en uitwerken van oplossingen, aanpak en architectuur.
  • Software engineering & integratie: Ontwikkelen van backend componenten, API’s en services om AI-oplossingen correct te laten samenwerken met bestaande applicaties en platformen.
  • Data Pipeline Development: Ontwerpen en bouwen van robuuste ETL/ELT processen en real-time data streams
  • Data Platform Architecture: Opzetten van moderne data warehouses, data lakes en analytics platforms
  • AI Integration: Implementeren van machine learning pipelines en integratie van AI-services in data workflows
  • Data Quality & Governance: Waarborgen van datakwaliteit, security en compliance binnen data ecosystemen
  • Performance Optimization: Optimaliseren van data processing performance en schaalbaarheid
  • Cloud Data Services: Werken met cloud-native data diensten zoals AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, of Google DataFlow
  • Monitoring & Observability: Implementeren van monitoring en alerting voor data pipelines en AI-workloads

Je Kwaliteiten En Skills
  • Je hebt een Bachelor of Master diploma met focus op software engineering.
  • Je hebt meerdere jaren ervaring als software engineer en hebt gewerkt aan data- en/of AI-gedreven systemen in een professionele, bij voorkeur enterprise context.
  • Je hebt ervaring met verschillende LLM-architecturen en je weet waar de sterke en zwakke punten liggen van diverse AI-oplossingen. Je kent de principes van moderne data architecturen, data modeling en big data processing.
  • Je beheerst moderne data processing talen zoals Python, SQL en hebt ervaring met frameworks zoals Apache Spark, Pandas, of Dask. Je bent bekend met AWS of Azure cloud data platformen.
  • Je hebt een sterke basis in software engineering, met kennis van o.a. CI/CD, Unit Testing, Git (flow) en secure development, error handling, asynchrone operaties en real-time data streams.
  • Je kunt je ideeën goed omzetten in technische architectuurdiagrammen, dataflow schema's en documentatie, maar je slaagt er ook in je oplossingen toe te lichten aan een minder technisch publiek (klant en collega’s)
  • Je vindt het leuk om over je ideeën en oplossingen te sparren met collega's en om samen met hen tot een beter resultaat te komen.

Title: Data & AI Project Analyst - BYD & Denza BeLux
Description:
Data & AI Project Analyst

Brussels, Belgium | Full-time | Country Management

As part of our digital transformation, BYD BeLux is creating a cross-functional role dedicated to making the most of our data and to deploying AI solutions for all departments. As Data & AI Project Analyst, you are the central point of contact to identify, prioritize and deliver high-impact data and AI projects, whichever department asks for them. You report to the Country Manager and work across Belgium and Luxembourg with Sales, Aftersales, Marketing, Finance, HR and more.

Key Responsibilities


Data & reporting (30%)
Design and roll out consolidated dashboards (for example sales and aftersales reporting) giving real-time access to key indicators.
Collect, clean and make reliable the data coming from our different systems (CRM, ERP, internal files).
Automate recurring reporting processes.
AI solutions deployment (30%)
Keep a close watch on AI tools and use cases relevant for an automotive national sales company.
Test, select and deploy AI tools (automation, GenAI, predictive analysis) based on the needs identified.
Measure the impact of the solutions deployed (time saved, ROI).
Cross-functional project support (25%)
Support data and AI projects in any department, based on the priorities set together with management.
Coordinate stakeholders (business teams, IT, external providers).
Follow up planning and report on project progress.
AI culture & training (15%)
Train and support the teams in using the tools deployed.
Centralize and share AI best practices across the organization.
Raise awareness in all departments of automation opportunities.


Your profile


Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in data, business information systems, business analytics or equivalent.
Experience: 2 to 5 years in data analysis, business analysis or project management.
Tools: Proficiency in BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) and advanced Excel. Good knowledge of AI tools (GenAI, automation tools such as Power Automate or Zapier).
Languages: French and/or Dutch, plus professional English (Belgian and Luxembourg context, and exchanges with headquarters).
Autonomy: Able to work independently with a wide range of contacts, from the field to management.
Mindset: Service-minded, a good teacher and a self-starter.


What This Role Is Not


It is not an executive assistant position (agenda management, administrative tasks).
It is not a purely technical data engineering or AI development role.
It is not attached to a single department: priorities are set across the organization.


Our offer


Long-term contract
Attractive salary with individual and company bonus
Meal & Eco-vouchers
Full-time position, 40h/week with 12 RTT days per year
Group and hospitalization insurance
Real opportunities for growth and evolution
Recently renovated office, easily accessible, in Watermael-Boitsfort
And the chance to work for BYD!


About BYD

Our Purpose is to build a zero-emission future that reconnects humanity with nature. We are looking for talent that connects with this mission and want to create positive impact by joining a diverse and dynamic team.

BYD is a leading, high-tech multinational, based in Shenzhen, China. Operates in four core fields of IT, automotive, new energy, and rail transit and employs over 300,000 people worldwide. As a global pioneer in New Energy Solutions BYD is dedicated to building a zero-emission ecosystem.

BYD BeLux located in Brussel, Belgium. BYD offers a full line of BYD electric vehicles, including all-electric cars, all-electric buses, and all-electric forklift trucks.

About DENZA

DENZA is BYD Group's premium brand for electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles, founded in 2010 and now entering Europe. In Belgium and Luxembourg, we are building a premium brand, a high-quality retail network and a customer experience that lives up to one of Europe's most demanding markets.

Title: Data Scientist - QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey
Description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

You will work in multi-disciplinary environments harnessing data to provide real-world impact for organizations globally. You will influence many of the recommendations our clients need to positively change their businesses and enhance performance.

You will be responsible for working on complex and extremely varied data sets from some of the world’s largest organizations to solve real-world problems. You will develop high-quality data science products and solutions for clients as well as assets for our internal data teams, focusing on modeling and working alongside the Data Engineering team. Additionally, you will present findings, recommendations, and provide consultation to stakeholders, both internal and clients.

Throughout your tenure, you will learn to work across various industries and sectors, gaining insights into diverse business challenges and applications of data science. You will build large-scale data and analytics solutions, handling complex problems and advanced client situations. You will also learn best practices in data and analytics development, including framework, responsibility model, high-quality code, data security, sustainability, and scalability. Working in collaborative teams with diverse skill sets, you will foster effective teamwork and learn from colleagues in a multicultural and creative environment. Staying up-to-date with the latest advancements in data science tools, techniques, and technologies, as well as participating in first-class learning programs, will be a key part of your development. You will also develop strong client-facing skills, including effective communication, problem-solving, and presentation abilities.

You will work with other data scientists, data/ML engineers, designers, project managers, and business subject matter experts on interdisciplinary projects across various industry sectors to enable business ambitions with data and analytics.

Our tech stack is diverse. While we advocate for using the right tools for the right task, we also take into account the client’s current landscape and preferences. Often, we use Python, PySpark, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Databricks, SQL, Docker, and Kubernetes. We also leverage our own proprietary tools such as Kedro, CausalNex, and MLRun. We work on a regular basis with cloud service providers such as AWS, GCP, and Azure.

Your Qualifications and Skills


Degree in (business) math, statistics, machine learning, data science, physics, computer science or engineering required
Master's degree or PhD level in the field of data science, computer science, business informatics or equivalent is a plus
Up to 2 years of professional hands-on experience in applying advanced data science methods and implementing technical data solutions (e.g. develop machine learning models), to solve business problems
A strong grasp of various analytics landscape, including business intelligence, machine learning, AI, and generative AI, and how to apply them effectively in different scenarios
Proficiency in Python, SQL (focus on data & analytics applications)
Professional experience in cloud-based analytical tools from market-leading providers such as AWS, MS Azure, Google Cloud
Practical experience in generative AI application development
Proven record of advisory works
Proven record of leadership in a work setting and/or through extracurricular activities
Proficient communication skills in German and English
Effective communication and presentation skills, particularly the ability to explain complex analytical concepts in a comprehensible manner adapted to different groups of non-technical audiences e.g. business managers, heads of products, sales & marketing leads

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Data Scientist based in Switzerland.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will play a key role in shaping business strategy through advanced analytics, experimentation, and data-driven insights. You will investigate the factors influencing customer acquisition, conversion, monetization, and retention, helping teams make smarter decisions and accelerate sustainable growth. Working at the intersection of Data Science, Product, and Growth, you will turn complex business questions into actionable recommendations with measurable impact. You will own analytical projects end to end, from working with raw data and building reliable data models to applying statistical methods and communicating findings. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders, you will challenge assumptions, uncover new opportunities, and influence strategic priorities. This is an opportunity to combine technical expertise, commercial thinking, and analytical ownership within a collaborative, international, and innovation-driven environment.

Accountabilities


Lead business-critical investigations across the customer journey, from acquisition and activation to conversion, monetization, and retention, translating findings into actionable recommendations.
Analyze marketing channel performance, attribution, and incrementality across SEO, paid search, CRM, and emerging channels to evaluate investment effectiveness and identify growth opportunities.
Design, implement, and evaluate A/B tests in collaboration with Product and Growth teams, applying statistical analysis, causal inference, and quasi-experimental methods where traditional experimentation is not feasible.
Build, test, document, and maintain reliable, production-ready data models using SQL, Python, and data transformation tools, ensuring the quality and integrity of analytical foundations.
Go beyond descriptive reporting to explain business performance, identify underlying drivers, challenge assumptions, and recommend concrete actions that improve business outcomes.
Investigate unexpected changes in traffic, conversion rates, and customer behavior, developing analytical frameworks, predictive models, and data products that help teams identify and act on opportunities faster.
Partner with Product Managers, Growth specialists, engineers, and senior leadership to translate ambiguous business challenges into structured analytical approaches and measurable results.
Take ownership of analytical projects from initial problem definition and data preparation through modeling, interpretation, stakeholder communication, and implementation of recommendations.


Requirements


Significant experience in applied Data Science or advanced analytics, ideally within a SaaS, digital product, product-led growth, or marketing-driven business, with a proven ability to influence business decisions.
Advanced SQL and data modeling skills, including experience designing, building, testing, documenting, and maintaining reliable data models. Familiarity with dbt or similar data transformation tools is highly valued.
Strong Python programming skills, with the ability to conduct statistical analyses, develop predictive models, and build practical data products.
Solid knowledge of statistics, experimentation, and causal inference, including experience designing and evaluating A/B tests and selecting appropriate methods for complex analytical questions.
Experience in Growth or Marketing Analytics, with a strong understanding of acquisition channels, conversion funnels, attribution, incrementality, and customer behavior. Experience analyzing SEO or paid search performance is a plus.
Strong product and commercial acumen, with the ability to connect metrics to business outcomes, prioritize high-value questions, and identify opportunities for improvement.
An end-to-end ownership mindset, with the ability to manage the full analytical lifecycle, from raw data and modeling to interpretation, communication, and actionable recommendations.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, enabling you to explain complex analytical findings clearly and persuasively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
A curious, proactive, and independent approach, with a willingness to challenge assumptions, explore unfamiliar problems, and go beyond the initial request.
Professional proficiency in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively in an international working environment.


Nice To Have


Experience in subscription-based or product-led growth businesses, particularly in conversion optimization, pricing, retention, or customer lifetime value.
Hands-on experience with marketing incrementality, attribution modeling, Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), or quasi-experimental techniques.
Experience developing analytical frameworks or data products that are adopted and used by business teams.
Previous experience in a lean, high-impact Data team, independently owning both analytical projects and the underlying data models.
A proven track record of influencing Product, Growth, or Marketing strategy through rigorous analysis and clear, evidence-based recommendations.


Benefits


Meaningful business impact: Contribute to a global digital product used by more than 60 million people every month, with your analyses directly informing business performance and growth.
Autonomy and ownership: Take responsibility for complex analytical challenges from start to finish and see your recommendations translate into real business decisions.
Collaborative environment: Work closely with experienced Data, Product, and Growth leaders in a team that values curiosity, knowledge sharing, and thoughtful decision-making.
Remote flexibility: Enjoy a remote working environment across supported European locations, with a hybrid option for team members based in Zurich.
Generous annual leave: Benefit from 30 vacation days each year.
Sabbatical leave: Access extended leave after more than two years with the company.
Parental support: Receive 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave at 100% of salary for all new parents.
Professional development: Access an annual personal development budget of up to CHF 2,000, plus time off for courses and training.
Continuous learning: Benefit from internal knowledge-sharing sessions and external coaching opportunities during working hours to strengthen technical and interpersonal skills.
Innovation opportunities: Participate in dedicated hack days to experiment, collaborate, and develop new ideas.
International exposure: Work with a diverse, global team in an established digital product environment that combines scale with the agility of a lean organization.

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.   • Lead business-critical investigations across the customer journey, from acquisition and activation to conversion, monetization, and retention, translating findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Analyze marketing channel performance, attribution, and incrementality across SEO, paid search, CRM, and emerging channels to evaluate investment effectiveness and identify growth opportunities.
  • Design, implement, and evaluate A/B tests in collaboration with Product and Growth teams, applying statistical analysis, causal inference, and quasi-experimental methods where traditional experimentation is not feasible.
  • Build, test, document, and maintain reliable, production-ready data models using SQL, Python, and data transformation tools, ensuring the quality and integrity of analytical foundations.
  • Go beyond descriptive reporting to explain business performance, identify underlying drivers, challenge assumptions, and recommend concrete actions that improve business outcomes.
  • Investigate unexpected changes in traffic, conversion rates, and customer behavior, developing analytical frameworks, predictive models, and data products that help teams identify and act on opportunities faster.
  • Partner with Product Managers, Growth specialists, engineers, and senior leadership to translate ambiguous business challenges into structured analytical approaches and measurable results.
  • Take ownership of analytical projects from initial problem definition and data preparation through modeling, interpretation, stakeholder communication, and implementation of recommendations.

Requirements

  • Significant experience in applied Data Science or advanced analytics, ideally within a SaaS, digital product, product-led growth, or marketing-driven business, with a proven ability to influence business decisions.
  • Advanced SQL and data modeling skills, including experience designing, building, testing, documenting, and maintaining reliable data models. Familiarity with dbt or similar data transformation tools is highly valued.
  • Strong Python programming skills, with the ability to conduct statistical analyses, develop predictive models, and build practical data products.
  • Solid knowledge of statistics, experimentation, and causal inference, including experience designing and evaluating A/B tests and selecting appropriate methods for complex analytical questions.
  • Experience in Growth or Marketing Analytics, with a strong understanding of acquisition channels, conversion funnels, attribution, incrementality, and customer behavior. Experience analyzing SEO or paid search performance is a plus.

  • A curious, proactive, and independent approach, with a willingness to challenge assumptions, explore unfamiliar problems, and go beyond the initial request.

Nice To Have

  • Experience in subscription-based or product-led growth businesses, particularly in conversion optimization, pricing, retention, or customer lifetime value.

  • Previous experience in a lean, high-impact Data team, independently owning both analytical projects and the underlying data models.
  • A proven track record of influencing Product, Growth, or Marketing strategy through rigorous analysis and clear, evidence-based recommendations.

Benefits

  • Meaningful business impact: Contribute to a global digital product used by more than 60 million people every month, with your analyses directly informing business performance and growth.

Title: Data Scientist - Marketing (f/m/d)
Description:
As the top Swiss e-commerce platform, with a crew of over 4’000 across Switzerland, Germany, and Serbia, Galaxus is poised to move into new markets. Our driving force is our determination to keep challenging the status quo. That’s why we’re on the lookout for characters who’re passionate about making genuine improvements. We’ll give you the freedom and trust to make an impact, to grow with us and to be yourself. Act galactic. Be you.




As a Data Scientist, you join our Analytics & Data Science team for Marketing, working alongside a second Data Scientist, Data Analysts, the Marketing Tech team and the Marketing business teams. You step in wherever the team needs you, with machine learning and advanced data analysis as the equally weighted core. Your work shapes how customers discover our products on Google Shopping, price-comparison sites, and beyond. You'll be part of a tight-knit crew that supports each other through calm and rough seas, with an open ear and a good sense of humour.




Your responsibilities

Turn business challenges into data-driven insight by understanding the real business question, digging into performance data to find the root cause, and translating it into clear, actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences
Build robust machine-learning solutions in close collaboration with the product team and run them in production on our platform, raising the performance of our Marketing channels
Own your data products end to end, from spotting the opportunity through prototype and build to running them in operation. You care about the whole Marketing product, not just your model
Validate improvements by defining success metrics and analytical frameworks, and running experiments with the product team and Marketing business teams (e.g. A/B tests, causal inference, incrementality testing)
Work with web tracking and attribution data to build features, close measurement gaps, and sharpen our understanding of the customer journey
Shape our data-science practice together with the Senior Data Scientist and the wider Data Science Guild




Your skills

Higher education degree (MSc) in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field, plus relevant professional experience
Strong Python skills and experience with machine-learning libraries such as PyTorch, scikit-learn, and XGBoost
Solid grounding in statistics and experimental design (e.g. A/B tests, causal inference): you are equally adept at building a model and carrying out an advanced ad-hoc analysis
Experience deploying and operating ML models in production with tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, Airflow, or Dagster, including monitoring and alerting
Experience with large datasets and advanced SQL (e.g. BigQuery), and comfortable building and owning data pipelines with a transformation framework (e.g. Dataform, dbt) that feed reliable feature stores and data products
Strong communication skills and a proactive, self-directed way of working. You thrive in a team, working closely with product and cross-functional colleagues, and convey your results clearly and concisely to different stakeholder groups
Marketing know-how and hands-on web tracking experience (Google Tag Manager) are a strong plus
A willingness to challenge «how things have always been done» and propose more efficient, automated or effective solutions
Maintaining resilience and agility while adjusting strategies as needed
Fluent English and good German (at least B2, or actively learning): day-to-day, the team mostly communicates in German




Why start with us?

Values, not empty words: Cooperative, innovative, piratesque, responsible, ambitious – these five values are what we practice and preach.
Courageous thinking: We encourage everyone to think on their feet, and love it when they come up with bold or edgy ideas.
Uncomplicated approach: Simplicity is at our core. We avoid the unnecessary and focus on what really matters – from overcoming challenges to celebrating our shared successes.
Flexibility and freedom: We offer working-from-home options, up to 8 weeks of workation, and every position is possible with an 80% workload.
Rapid growth: With us, growth is a continuous journey. We also support you with 2’000 EDU Points per year for your professional development, so there’s no risk of you getting stuck in a rut.
Modern: With us you can work with the latest technologies every day, see our Tech-Radar.
More than "just" work: Take part in our various employee events such as Hackathons, hiking, skiing, Böötlen on the Limmat, LAN Parties or Friday Night Drinks and, if you're interested, contribute to our Techblog.
More benefits: 25 days of holiday, exclusive employee conditions in our online shop, mobile, internet and TV plans at company rates and many other benefits.




Diversity is our culture.




To build the best team, we want to draw from the full spectrum of talent out there. This means people from all walks of life have the same opportunities with us, regardless of their ethnicity, religion, disability status, gender identity, sexual orientation or age. We believe true inclusion means everyone is welcome and each contribution is valuable.
