Title: Statistician
Description:
Organizational Setting

The Statistics Division (ESS) develops and advocates for the implementation of methodologies and standards for data collection, validation, processing and analysis, in the food and agriculture statistics domains. In these statistical domains, it also plays a key role in the compilation, processing and dissemination of internationally comparable data, and provides essential capacity building in support of member countries. The Division also disseminates publications, working papers and statistical yearbooks, that cover agriculture and food security statistics, including prices, investments, production, trade and agri-environmental statistical data. Finally, as the ESS Director also plays the role of FAO Chief Statistician, the Division supports the various functions of the Chief Statistician, that is to ensure stronger governance of FAO's data and statistical system, foster consistency of FAO's Data and Statistical programme within the Strategic Framework, ensure statistical excellence through the implementation of statistical standards and quality assurance mechanisms, and position FAO's presence in data and statistical discussions at global level.

The incumbent will work in the Food Security and Nutrition Statistics team within the Statistics Division and will contribute to the production and dissemination of all statistics reported in the Food Security and Nutrition, Food and Diet, and Cost and Affordability of Healthy Diets data domains of FAOSTAT.

The position is located in the Statistics Division (ESS) at FAO headquarters in Rome, Italy.

Reporting Lines

The Statistician reports to the Senior Statistician and team leader of the Food Security and Nutrition Statistics Team, under the overall guidance of the Director of ESS.

Technical Focus

The S tatistician will provide statistical expertise in the improvement of existing methods and development of new methods for the generation of food security and nutrition statistics, and in the compilation, processing, validation, analysis, storage and dissemination of data, microdata and metadata, with a special emphasis on data from experience-based food security scales. The role includes: ensuring the correct application of methods to estimate the Prevalence of food insecurity based on Food Insecurity Experience Scale (FIES), the Prevalence of Undernourishment (PoU), and the Prevalence of Unaffordability of a healthy diet (PUA); the production of high quality documents and statistical tools, including software packages, scripts, datasets and reports on the analysis of food security and nutrition data; collaborating with external stakeholders and partners, including national statistical offices and other international organizations or research institutions, involved in the collection, analysis, dissemination and reporting of food security and nutrition statistics based on FAO endorsed statistical methods and definitions.

Key Results

Research and analysis of information, data and statistics, statistical methods, statistical and econometric modelling. Development and maintenance of specialized tools, methodologies, systems and/or databases and the technical assistance services to support the implementation/delivery and monitoring of the programme of work and related products, projects, publications and services.

Key Functions


Collects, reviews, processes and/or analyses key social/economic/environmental/indicators, based on both traditional statistical methods/sources or on unstructured sources and data science methods, to support the delivery of economic and social development programmes of work, which can be focused on products, projects, publications or services.
Develops improved/updated technical, statistical and/or analytical tools, systems, databases.
Conducts research, data collection, validation, analysis and/or reporting in support of the development of technical standards, international instruments, innovative tools and methodologies to be used within the Organization or by external stakeholders.
Produces a variety of technical reports and provides input in technical documents, divisional publications and/or web pages.
Provides response to requests and provides technical and/or policy advice, assistance and solutions to Regional, Subregional and Country Offices, including technical backstopping to field projects.
Participates in multidisciplinary teams, collaborates with other Divisions/Offices/Centres on work groups and committees and promotes best practices.
Provides capacity development services, including the planning and organization of training workshops and seminars and preparation of related information, materials, on-line tools and information kits.
Participates in divisional teams, Organization-wide committees, project teams and working groups and provides specialized expertise on international technical networks and or technical policy and standard setting bodies.
Supports the organization, conduct and follow-up of meetings, consultations and conferences, the development/production of required materials and the provision of information and assistance to partners.
Participates in resource mobilization activities in accordance with the Strategic Framework and divisional plans.
Promotes international cooperation and collaboration, advocates best practices, knowledge sharing, increased policy dialogue and provides technical expertise at international meetings and conferences.


Specific Functions

Maintains and refines the methodology and the statistical tools to compute the Prevalence of Food Insecurity based on FIES and other food security and nutrition indicators produced by the FSN statistics Team.


Contributes to the development of analytic models and scoring strategies for the FIES, with the aim of ensuring cross-country comparability and stability over time of the food security measure.
Analyses results to identify potential inconsistencies in the level s and trends of different indicators (FIES-based, PoU, PUA, economic and social well-being) and propose s appropriate strateg ies to address them.
Maintains and extends the analytic codes and statistical methods to analyse FIES data through Item Response Theory models (both dichotomous and polytomous) as needed for various purposes (capacity building, research, SDG monitoring, IPC classification etc.).
R eviews sampling frames of surveys used to inform food insecurity indicators, including post-stratification weighting, with the purpose of assessing the survey quality and re-adjusts the sampling weights if needed.
Provides methodological guidance for the improvement of other food security and nutrition indicators produced by the team, including the PoU and PUA.
Works on and refines the methodologies for data disaggregation and variance computation of the different food security and nutrition indicators.


Undertakes and supports data analysis and dissemination activities.


Conducts analyses of national datasets collected in order to determine the potential for producing food insecurity prevalence estimates to inform the global assessment.
Contributes to the publication of divisional reports and scientific papers on the FIES methodology and empirical application.
Conduct s research on extending existing methods to different applications (e.g. acute food insecurity monitoring, right to food, urban food security, etc.).
Contributes to discussions among food security analysts in different fora, providing guidance for the analysis and interpretation of food security indicators.
Disseminates and interprets results based on the analysis of FIES data in different platforms and systems (Statistical Working System -SWS, FAOSTAT, UNSD, etc.).
Drafts sections of the State of Food Insecurity and Nutrition in the World (SOFI) report that concern statistical data analysis and interpretation of the food security indicators, updating and interpreting the latest trends and contributing in the thematic part as needed.
Supports the computation of regional aggregates of various food security and nutrition indicators to be disseminated in FAOSTAT and other data platforms.


Provide technical assistance and capacity development on the FIES-based and other food security indicators.


Within the mandate of the Food Security and Nutrition Statistics Team , provides assistance for statistical analyses related to food security indicators to other teams and divisions in FAO, to professionals from other international agencies, NGOs and academicians with an interest towards food security measurement, their interpretation and use in policy making.
Provides technical assistance to national statistical offices for statistical analyses of food security data collected in national surveys.
Designs, tests and conducts capacity development activities on the use of the developed FAO software and modelling approach to assess access to food (may require travel and language courses).
Oversees the development of web-based learning materials for the software and model application to estimate the access to food, both for internal (FAO) and external (not FAO) users.


Provide statistical expertise/support to other members of the food security and nutrition statistics team as necessary.

______________________________________________________________________________________________________

CANDIDATES WILL BE ASSESSED AGAINST THE FOLLOWING

Minimum Requirements


Advanced university degree (Master’s degree or equivalent) in statistics, mathematics, economics, agricultural economics, or a related field.
Five years of relevant experience in the compilation and analysis of food and agricultural statistics in national or international organizations with focus on the methodological development and production of food security statistics.
Working knowledge (proficiency - level C) of English and intermediate knowledge (intermediate proficiency - level B) of another FAO official language (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian or Spanish).


Competencies


Results Focus
Teamwork
Communication
Building Effective Relationships
Knowledge Sharing and Continuous Improvement


Technical/Functional Skills


Work experience in more than one location or area of work, particularly in field positions.
Strong command of statistical methods including: data presentation, analysis and descriptive statistics; main continuous and discrete random variables (binomial, normal, standard normal, log-normal) and their properties; probability distributions; conditional probability, probabilities of intersections of events, Bayes' theorem; correlation and rank correlation; sampling and sample size: simple, stratified, and multistage random sampling; Inference, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing and significance; linear regression (single and multiple) comparison of population means and variances, ANOVA; Chi-square and goodness of fit tests; nonlinear models: maximum likelihood estimation; elements of survey and questionnaire design.
Extent and relevance of experience and knowledge of the main data sources used for the compilation of food security statistics.
Extent and relevance of experience in the compilation, validation, and analysis of food security statistics.
Extent and relevance of experience in software used for processing and analysing data, such as R, STATA, SPSS, SAS.
Extent and relevance of statistical programming skills.
Depth familiarity with relevant statistical methods for data analysis using Item Response Theory.
Ability to analyse complex statistical-related issues.

  • Drafts sections of the State of Food Insecurity and Nutrition in the World (SOFI) report that concern statistical data analysis and interpretation of the food security indicators, updating and interpreting the latest trends and contributing in the thematic part as needed.
  • Supports the computation of regional aggregates of various food security and nutrition indicators to be disseminated in FAOSTAT and other data platforms.

Provide technical assistance and capacity development on the FIES-based and other food security indicators.

Provide statistical expertise/support to other members of the food security and nutrition statistics team as necessary.

Description:
Descrizione dell'azienda

Chi è Sopra Steria

Sopra Steria - fra i maggiori player tecnologici in Europa, con 51.000 dipendenti in circa 30 paesi - è riconosciuta per i suoi servizi di consulenza, per i suoi servizi digitali e per le sue soluzioni IT. Sopra Steria supporta i propri clienti nel loro percorso di trasformazione digitale, garantendo loro benefici concreti e sostenibili. Nel 2025, il Gruppo ha registrato un fatturato di 5,6 miliardi di euro.

Con circa 1.200 persone e un fatturato 2025 di €107,35 milioni, Sopra Steria opera sul mercato italiano attraverso le sue sedi di Assago (MI), Roma, Collecchio (PR), Padova, Ariano Irpino (AV) e Pozzuoli (NA).

The World Is How We Shape It

Sopra Steria (SOP) è quotata su Euronext Paris (Comparto A) – ISIN: FR0000050809. Scopri di più su www.soprasteria.com

Descrizione del lavoro

Ai fini dell’ampliamento del nostro centro di competenza dedicato all’AI e al Data Science, siamo alla ricerca di un/una Data Scientist Manager che operi come leader tecnico con consolidata esperienza in Data Science, Machine Learning e AI, generativa e non, in grado di coordinare team multidisciplinari e guidare l’evoluzione delle soluzioni di Machine Learning e Intelligenza Artificiale per clienti enterprise.

Sarà responsabile di progettare, sviluppare e implementare modelli predittivi e algoritmi avanzati, coordinando l'integrazione e l'ottimizzazione con i Data Engineer e Data Scientist junior.

In scenari complessi, guiderai l'architettura del progetto in collaborazione con i Solution Architect, risolvendo problemi tecnici e strategici e garantendo la consegna di soluzioni scalabili ed efficienti.

In un contesto orientato all'innovazione tecnologica con un’impostazione Business Oriented, si occuperà di:


Sviluppo di modelli statistico-matematici, sviluppo di modelli di Machine Learning e tecnologie dell'IA;
Gestione del ciclo di vita del dato e tecniche di data mining;
Realizzazione della soluzione analitica;
Collaborazione agile con il team dei Data Engineer per le progettualità più complesse che richiedano una preparazione specifica delle basi di dati.


Qualifiche

La risorsa avrà la responsabilità di indirizzare la definizione delle architetture AI, coordinare le attività progettuali, contribuire allo sviluppo del business e promuovere l’adozione di soluzioni innovative basate su modelli predittivi e Large Language Models (LLM).

Responsabilità principali


Guidare team di Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer e AI Engineer.
Definire strategie e roadmap di adozione di AI e Generative AI.
Progettare e supervisionare soluzioni basate su Machine Learning, Deep Learning e LLM.
Supportare attività di prevendita, proposal e definizione di offerte Data & AI.
Collaborare con stakeholder business e IT per identificare casi d’uso ad alto valore.
Garantire l’industrializzazione delle soluzioni AI attraverso pratiche di MLOps e LLMOps.
Favorire la crescita professionale e tecnica del team.


Requisiti


Esperienza di 8-12 anni (in ambito Data Science e Artificial Intelligence).
Esperienza nella gestione di team e progetti complessi.
Conoscenza delle principali tecniche di analytics, machine learning e data management, costituisce requisito preferenziale la conoscenza della piattaforma SAS.
Ottima conoscenza di algoritmi di Machine Learning e Deep Learning.
Esperienza pratica con framework quali Python, Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch.
Esperienza nella progettazione di soluzioni di Generative AI basate su LLM, RAG, Agentic AI e Knowledge Management.
Conoscenza delle principali piattaforme cloud (Azure, AWS o GCP).
Esperienza con strumenti di Data Engineering e MLOps.
Capacità di relazione con il management e con clienti enterprise.


Soft Skills


Leadership e capacità di coaching.
Forte orientamento al risultato.
Visione strategica e innovazione.
Ottime capacità comunicative e relazionali.
Attitudine al lavoro in team e alla crescita delle competenze interne.


Informazioni aggiuntive

LA NOSTRA PROPOSTA:

Ti offriamo l’opportunità di lavorare in un ambiente dinamico, su progetti nazionali ed internazionali, che ti permetta di approfondire continuamente le tue conoscenze e di sviluppare le tue competenze.

Se vuoi dare una spinta alla tua carriera ed entrare a far parte di una società di servizi IT leader in Europa ed in continua crescita, inviaci il tuo curriculum!

Per questa posizione è prevista una RAL (retribuzione annua lorda) compresa tra 55.000€ e 65.000€.

La sede di lavoro è ROMA con possibilità, compatibilmente con l'attività svolta, di aderire all’accordo di smart working secondo quanto previsto dalla nostra policy aziendale. E’ comunque richiesta la disponibilità a compiere trasferte sul territorio nazionale e internazionale.

Scopri Sopra Steria! Visita il nostro sito e rimani aggiornato attraverso il blog e le pagine social https://linktr.ee/SopraSteria

Tutte le regole relative ai tuoi dati raccolti in questo modo sono dettagliate nell'Informativa sulla Protezione dei Dati dei Candidati (https://www.soprasteria.it/footer/protezione_dati_candidati).

In conformità con la legislazione / i regolamenti vigenti in materia di tecnologia dell'informazione, documenti e libertà civili, hai diritti di accesso, rettifica, cancellazione, portabilità, limitazione, opposizione e definizione di istruzioni riguardanti la sorte dei tuoi Dati personali dopo la tua morte. Questi diritti saranno esercitati inviando un'e-mail al responsabile della protezione dei dati (DPO) all'indirizzo DPO.Italia@soprasteria.com o per posta a questo indirizzo: Sopra Steria Group S.p.A. - Ufficio legale - Strada 4 Palazzo A7 - 20090 Assago (MI).

Hai anche il diritto di presentare un reclamo Garante per la Protezione dei Dati Personali (Piazza di Monte Citorio n. 121 00186 Roma), se il titolare del trattamento non rispetta gli obblighi previsti dalla legislazione in vigore.

Title: Business Data Analyst
Description:
All’interno del team Chief Strategy, Business Development and Wholebuy Office – Competence Development Center, ricerchiamo una persona da inserire nel ruolo di Business Data Analyst motivata e con un forte approccio analitico, da inserire presso la nostra sede di Roma.

Attività previste dal ruolo:

La persona individuata si occuperà di analizzare e interpretare dati provenienti da diverse fonti aziendali, sviluppando soluzioni di analisi e monitoraggio a supporto delle decisioni di business e contribuendo all’automazione e all’industrializzazione dei processi di elaborazione dei dati.

In particolare, la risorsa sarà coinvolta in:


Definizione degli scope progettuali e traduzione delle esigenze di business in requisiti analitici e tecnici.
Analisi di fenomeni complessi attraverso dati provenienti da fonti eterogenee.
Individuazione di KPI e metriche rilevanti per il monitoraggio delle performance aziendali.
Sviluppo e automazione di processi di elaborazione, controllo e analisi dei dati.
Verifica della qualità, della coerenza e dell’affidabilità delle informazioni prima della loro condivisione con gli stakeholder.
Individuazione di anomalie nei dati e supporto alle attività di troubleshooting e riconciliazione tra fonti differenti.
Interpretazione dei risultati delle analisi, distinguendo evidenze, ipotesi e possibili cause dei fenomeni osservati.
Sviluppo autonomo di analisi, KPI e strumenti di supporto alle decisioni.
Comunicazione chiara ed efficace degli insight e dei risultati analitici, anche a interlocutori non tecnici.
Gestione autonoma delle attività assegnate, in collaborazione con team tecnici e stakeholder di business.


Tali attività saranno svolte con riferimento al processo di integrazione delle competenze funzionali al percorso di trasformazione aziendale in atto.

Requisiti richiesti:


Laurea o percorso specialistico in discipline quantitative o tecnico-scientifiche, quali Data Science, Statistica, Matematica, Informatica, Ingegneria, Economia quantitativa o percorsi affini.
Conoscenza avanzata di SQL e capacità di lavorare con dataset complessi e di grandi dimensioni.
Buona conoscenza di Python, con particolare riferimento all’analisi e alla trasformazione dei dati.
Conoscenza delle principali librerie Python per la data analysis, quali Pandas, NumPy o equivalenti.
Capacità di sviluppare processi di data preparation, aggregazione, riconciliazione e controllo qualità.
Conoscenza dei principi di modellazione del dato e delle problematiche relative a granularità, duplicazioni, join e consistenza tra fonti.
Esperienza nell’utilizzo di database relazionali e/o data warehouse.
Familiarità con Google Cloud Platform e con strumenti quali BigQuery, Cloud Storage e Vertex AI, o con piattaforme cloud equivalenti.
Familiarità con strumenti di data visualization e dashboarding.
Familiarità con sistemi di versionamento del codice, in particolare Git.
Conoscenza dei principi di sviluppo software, con attenzione alla leggibilità, alla modularità e alla manutenibilità del codice.
Familiarità con processi di automazione, scheduling e industrializzazione delle elaborazioni dati.
Familiarità con tecniche di prompt engineering e con strumenti low-code/no-code per la realizzazione di agenti AI e workflow basati su modelli generativi.


Competenze trasversali:


Forte capacità analitica e attitudine all’interpretazione di fenomeni complessi.
Orientamento alla qualità, all’affidabilità e alla coerenza del dato.
Capacità di comprendere le esigenze degli stakeholder e tradurle in requisiti analitici e tecnici.
Autonomia nella gestione delle attività e orientamento al risultato.
Problem solving e capacità di individuare anomalie e possibili cause dei fenomeni osservati.
Comunicazione chiara ed efficace, anche verso interlocutori non tecnici.
Predisposizione alla collaborazione con team tecnici e stakeholder di business.


Titoli preferenziali:


Esperienza nello sviluppo di analisi dati a supporto delle decisioni di business.
Esperienza nella costruzione e nel monitoraggio di KPI e metriche di performance.
Esperienza nell’utilizzo di SQL in contesti progettuali o aziendali.
Esperienza nella gestione di dataset provenienti da fonti eterogenee e nelle attività di data quality e data reconciliation.
Esperienza nella realizzazione o manutenzione di dashboard e strumenti di reporting.
Familiarità con ambienti cloud, pipeline dati e processi CI/CD.


Cosa offriamo:


Contratto a tempo indeterminato.
RAL di partenza pari a 31.400€, stabilita utilizzando criteri oggettivi e neutrali rispetto al genere. L’offerta economica effettiva potrà ulteriormente incrementarsi, entro parametri prestabiliti, in considerazione dell’evidenza di alcuni criteri di riferimento, quali il percorso formativo effettuato, l’esperienza professionale maturata nel ruolo e complessivamente, le certificazioni conseguite e la particolare affinità dimostrata rispetto al profilo ricercato.
Pacchetto welfare e benefit aggiuntivi.
Formazione continua e percorsi di certificazione.
Possibilità di lavorare su progetti di analisi, automazione e industrializzazione dei dati, utilizzando tecnologie cloud, strumenti di data visualization e soluzioni basate sull’intelligenza artificiale.
Opportunità di crescita in un contesto dinamico, innovativo e orientato alla trasformazione digitale.

Title: Internal Research Fellow (PostDoc) in AI on board for Synthetic Aperture Radar Missions
Description:
Internal Research Fellow (PostDoc) in AI on board for Synthetic Aperture Radar Missions

Job Requisition ID: 20932

Date Posted: 7 October 2026

Closing Date: 4 November 2026 23:59 CET/CEST

Publication Method: External Only

Type of Appointment (learn more): Internal Research Fellow

Directorate: Earth Observation Programmes

Workplace:

Frascati, IT

Grade Band: F2 - F2

Location

ESRIN, Frascati, Italy

Our team and mission

Reporting to the Head of the Explore Office in the ESA Φ-lab, you will work in close cooperation with other staff in the Directorate of Earth Observation Programmes and colleagues from the Directorate of Technology, Engineering and Quality. There may also be collaboration with scientists and engineers in other divisions at ESA. You will be part of the ESA Φ-lab. Our mission is to accelerate the future of Earth observation via transformative innovation* and commercialisation actions strengthening ESA Member States’ world-leading competitiveness. .Our vision is to be the “EO innovation hub”, connecting EO with a growing ecosystem of disruptive and transformative innovation such as AI, ML, quantum computing, edge computing, metamaterials, photonics, etc. Many of the challenges posed by new technologies still need to be tackled at the scientific, application and capability level to deliver maximum value from satellite-derived EO assets for our climate, society, and economy. The Φ-lab will bring together early career and senior researchers from a variety of disciplines across EO and disruptive/transformative innovation to help develop innovative EO solutions.

We offer:


a stimulating multinational, interdisciplinary and open work environment;
access to high-performance computing infrastructure and unparalleled EO and technology expertise;
a unique opportunity to work on innovative solutions to address global challenges;
freedom and focus to conduct creative research while making an impact in relation to ESA’s strategy;
a wide network of relationships and collaboration with top academia, industry and research centres;
the opportunity to contribute to the Φ-lab strategy and activities.



You are encouraged to visit the ESA website: https://www.esa.int/

Field(s) of activity/research for the traineeship

Main objectives of the Research Fellowship

Cognitive cloud computing in space (3CS) is emerging as a key paradigm for future Earth observation systems, enabling coordinated, event-driven operations across heterogeneous space assets through onboard intelligence, distributed computing and inter-satellite communications. By supporting capabilities such as autonomous tip-and-cue, event-based mission replanning, adaptive multi-sensor tasking and distributed information fusion, 3CS aims to significantly improve the responsiveness and autonomy of future EO missions. In this context, synthetic aperture radar (SAR) represents a strategic sensing modality thanks to its all-weather, day-and-night imaging capabilities, providing reliable information to trigger and support coordinated observations in rapidly evolving scenarios such as disasters, maritime surveillance and security monitoring. Recent advances in cognitive SAR have demonstrated the potential of AI methods operating directly on raw or partially processed data for tasks such as learned focusing, adaptive compression and information extraction. However, significant challenges remain, including the computational complexity of SAR processing chains, the limited robustness of current AI approaches, and the difficulty of deploying intelligent processing under stringent onboard resource constraints. In addition, significant exploration is still required to explore novel cognitive SAR and novel mission concepts enabled by onboard SAR processing. This fellowship will address these challenges by developing AI-based methods for onboard SAR data processing operating close to the sensing level, enabling real-time information extraction, event detection, autonomous re-tasking, and cooperative multi-sensor operations for next-generation missions, including Copernicus Sentinel-1 Next Generation, thereby supporting the transition towards autonomous and coordinated EO systems.

Research topic of interests include:


advanced onboard SAR data processing architectures: target applications include but are not limited to onboard SAR data focusing, and extraction of insight from SAR unfocused data;
cognitive SAR: novel mission concepts, applications and in-orbit data processing for cognitive SAR systems;
onboard foundation models for SAR data processing: including multimodal foundation models;
onboard SAR for 3CS systems: onboard SAR for tip-and-cue systems, in-orbit data fusion, etc.



Within your application, please provide a research proposal (no more than five pages) related to onboard AI for SAR missions:


Describe the main research questions that you would like to address.
Propose a research plan with a clear description of the methodology that you would like to adopt to answer those questions with specific reference to your previous experience and your publications on the topic, the novel concept that you plan to research, and a possible schedule.



In particular, you will:


undertake advanced research activities, exploring and expanding the use of disruptive/transformative innovation (AI, ML, disruptive computing, etc.) to develop new prototypes for onboard SAR data processing, cognitive SAR, and onboard SAR for 3CS systems. The research may cover a wide range of innovative topics:
exploration of innovative methodologies and technologies;
the development of novel methods, of new technology implementations, (e.g. ML models), of high-level products;
contribution to the development and curation of open data sets and tools enabling the community to develop its own AI for applications and research;
support the definition and implementation of rapid prototyping activities, research sprints and open challenges of innovative EO solutions addressing upcoming lab activities and wider strategy;
engage with the innovation ecosystem to promote the uptake of new techniques and capture the latest developments in EO and disruptive/transformative innovation;
publish the research project outcomes in high-impact journals;
drive collaboration within the Φ-lab community and ESA internal teams to promote the uptake of these new techniques and solutions;
contribute to the Φ-lab strategy, activities and outreach on disruptive technologies for EO;
maintain a continuous dialogue with the scientific community, including major international programmes and initiatives in the field;
support the Φ-lab’s daily activities and research network of ESA Graduate Trainees, National Trainees, interns, visiting professors, experts and researchers, as applicable;
collaborate closely with ESA’s Φ-lab and avionics and EEE Division for the identification, testing and benchmarking of hardware components for edge computing and learning;
conduct research and implement prototypes of onboard AI for SAR;
support ESA’s Φ-lab staff with external R&D activities related to onboard AI for SAR.


Technical competencies

Knowledge relevant to the field of research

Research/publication record

Ability to conduct research autonomously

Breadth of exposure coming from past and/or current research/activities

Ability to gather and share relevant information

General interest in space and space research

Behavioural competencies

Result Orientation

Operational Efficiency

Fostering Cooperation

Relationship Management

Continuous Improvement

Forward Thinking

For more information, please refer to ESA Core Behavioural Competencies guidebook

Education

You should have recently completed (within the past five years), or be close to completion of a PhD in a relevant field such as data science, AI, computer science, remote sensing, machine learning, electronics, embedded systems, aerospace engineering, Earth system science, climate etc., with the subject of your thesis being relevant to the description of the tasks outlined above.

Additional Requirements

In addition to your CV and motivation letter, please prepare a research proposal of no more than five pages. When submitting your application, please upload the proposal under the “Research Outline” field in “My Documents.

You should have:


sound knowledge of themes of interest, such as EO, AI, ML, and technologies in general;
knowledge relevant to your research field in SAR signal processing and algorithms;
the ability to think outside the box and explore new avenues, with natural curiosity and a passion for new subjects and research areas;
experience with one or more general-purpose programming languages, for example Python and general-purpose deep learning frameworks, such as Tensorflow or PyTorch;
the interest and ability to share knowledge with other ESA organisational units.



The following elements are considered an asset:


Knowledge of onboard AI, edge computing for SAR systems
Experience with hardware for edge computing (e.g., FPGAs, TPUs, VPUs and GPUs)



You should also have good interpersonal and communication skills and should be able to work in a multi-cultural environment, both independently and as part of a team. Your motivation, overall professional perspective and career goals will also be explored during the later stages of the selection process.

The working languages of the Agency are English and French. A good knowledge of one of these is required. Knowledge of another Member State language would be an asset.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusiveness

ESA is an equal opportunity employer, committed to achieving diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. We therefore welcome applications from all qualified candidates irrespective of gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religious beliefs, age, disability or other characteristics.

At the Agency we value diversity, and we welcome people with disabilities. Whenever possible, we seek to accommodate individuals with disabilities by providing the necessary support at the workplace. The Human Resources Department can also provide assistance during the recruitment process. If you would like to discuss this further, please contact us via email at contact.human.resources@esa.int.

Important Information and Disclaimer

During the recruitment process, the Agency may request applicants to undergo selection tests. Additionally, successful candidates will need to undergo basic screening before appointment, which will be conducted by an external background screening service, in compliance with the European Space Agency's security procedures.

The information published on ESA’s careers website regarding working conditions is correct at the time of publication. It is not intended to be exhaustive and may not address all questions you would have.

Nationality and Languages

Please note that applications can only be considered from nationals of one of the following States: Austria, Belgium, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom. Nationals from Cyprus, Latvia, Lithuania and Slovakia, as Associate Member States, or Canada as a Cooperating State, can apply as well as those from Bulgaria, Croatia and Malta as European Cooperating States (ECS).

According to the ESA Convention, staff shall be recruited on the basis of their qualifications, taking into account an adequate distribution of posts among nationals of the Member States.

The working languages of the Agency are English and French. A good knowledge of one of these is required. Knowledge of another Member State language would be an asset.

Degree in Business, Economics, Life Sciences, or a quantitative discipline.
5–8 years in commercial operations, analytics, customer excellence, market intelligence or digital within pharma 
Proven track record of connecting data to commercial decisions — not just producing reports, but changing what teams do
Fluency in commercial metrics and omnichannel models; power-user comfort with CRM, BI tools (Power BI)
Working knowledge of AI and machine learning applications in a commercial context 
Strong cross-functional influencer: able to align Sales, Marketing, Medical, and IT stakeholders without direct authority
Executive communication skills: you simplify complexity, tell stories with data, and make senior stakeholders act.

As our Customer Excellence & Analytics Manager, you'll turn data, AI, and customer insight into smarter decisions and more meaningful connections with healthcare professionals. You'll shape how we listen, measure, and engage across every channel, transforming numbers into stories that inspire action and make a real difference for patients. If you're passionate about changing the way teams work, not just reporting on it, we'd love to meet you.

 

About the role

As our Customer Excellence & Analytics Manager, you will lead how we understand, measure, and improve our commercial engagement model — combining data, AI, and customer experience thinking to drive better decisions and better outcomes.

What you will own: 

  • Customer Intelligence
    • Build deep understanding of HCP segments — behaviours, channel preferences, content needs, and prescribing drivers — that goes beyond traditional targeting.
    • Use predictive analytics and AI models to anticipate HCP responsiveness, churn risk, and engagement opportunities before they surface in the field.
  • Omnichannel Performance & Measurement
    • Design the KPI architecture that tells us whether our commercial model is working with customer — reach, frequency, engagement quality, cross-channel synergy, and conversion.
    • Move beyond reporting: translate performance data into clear, narrative-driven recommendations that change how brand and field teams operate.
  • Commercial Analytics & AI
    • Lead the commercial analytics roadmap: sales performance, promotional response, market share, competitive intelligence
    • Champion a data-driven culture: enable commercial teams to self-serve on core insights; brief senior leadership with clarity, not complexity
    • Identify and pilot AI applications that create competitive advantage 
  • Data Governance & Commercial Data Strategy
    • Own the integrity of commercial data assets: KPI definitions, master data standards, source-of-truth alignment across CRM, BI, and marketing platforms.
    • Ensure all analytical outputs are consistent, documented, and decision-ready 

 

Requirements

  • Degree in Business, Economics, Life Sciences, or a quantitative discipline.
  • 5–8 years in commercial operations, analytics, customer excellence, market intelligence or digital within pharma 
  • Proven track record of connecting data to commercial decisions — not just producing reports, but changing what teams do
  • Fluency in commercial metrics and omnichannel models; power-user comfort with CRM, BI tools (Power BI)
  • Working knowledge of AI and machine learning applications in a commercial context 
  • Strong cross-functional influencer: able to align Sales, Marketing, Medical, and IT stakeholders without direct authority
  • Executive communication skills: you simplify complexity, tell stories with data, and make senior stakeholders act.

 

The salary for this role starts from 64000€ gross per year, depending on experience and location. The offer isdetermined based on gender-neutral criteria, including relevant skills, competencies, and experience.

Angelini Pharma is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
We believe that diversity is a huge value that contributes to individual and company success. We arecommitted to create and foster a diverse and inclusive environment.

Title: JR/MID AI ENGINEER
Description:
YOUR NEW COMPANY

Kirey is one of the leading European groups specializing in technology consulting and system integration, with a distinctive positioning in data-driven innovation.

Through a comprehensive portfolio of solutions—including Data & AI, Cloud, Software Development, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure & Automation, and Monitoring—Kirey transforms data complexity into intuitive and accessible solutions, enabling its clients to achieve their business objectives.

Headquartered in Italy, with a solid international presence and nearly 1,500 employees, Kirey has delivered more than 10,000 projects for leading clients across industries such as Insurance, Banking, Manufacturing, Retail, Public Administration, and Services & Energy.

At the core of all this are people, who at Kirey are empowered to fully express their talent and actively contribute to the company’s value chain. This is made possible through continuous investment in improvement processes and training, the promotion of innovative ideas and creativity through skills development, and a strong commitment—expressed through dedicated initiatives—to inclusion and diversity.

Kirey Group's AI & Innovation Business Unit designs and delivers AI-driven solutions for leading companies across industries such as pharma, manufacturing and financial services. We help our clients turn data into value through Generative AI, advanced analytics and modern data platforms like AWS, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric and Azure.







YOUR ROLE

Join our AI & Innovation Business Unit as a Jr/Mid AI Engineer. You will work on real client projects involving Generative AI, agentic solutions and data platforms — building intelligent agents on AWS Bedrock and/or Databricks Genie, while designing and implementing the data pipelines that power them. Locations: Milan, Florence, Rome — hybrid working model.




We are looking for a motivated AI Engineer with 1 to 3 years of experience to join our team. You will work hands-on with senior engineers on client projects, combining agentic AI development — using AWS Bedrock Agents and/or Databricks Genie — with solid data engineering fundamentals, from data modeling to the design and implementation of ingestion pipelines.

You will contribute to projects such as AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, automated data analysis and interactive dashboards, working in a collaborative, innovation-oriented environment




Responsibilities

Design and develop Generative AI solutions, including LLM-based agents and RAG pipelines, using AWS Bedrock Agents and/or Databricks Genie.
Design, write and iterate on prompts for LLM-based agents, optimizing for accuracy, reliability and cost across different models and use cases.
Model data and build data pipelines, developing and maintaining ingestion processes on AWS and/or Databricks.
Develop and maintain data models on platforms such as AWS , Databricks
Write clean, well-documented Python code and contribute to testing and quality assurance of AI components.
Help evaluate and monitor AI solutions, measuring accuracy, performance and reliability.
Build dashboards and data visualizations to present insights to business users.
Collaborate with senior engineers, consultants and client teams throughout the project lifecycle.
Stay up to date with the latest developments in AI and share new ideas with the team.




Requirements

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics or a related field.
1 to 3 years of experience in AI/data engineering roles.
Hands-on experience with AWS Bedrock Agents and/or Databricks Genie for building agentic AI solutions.
Practical experience in prompt engineering, including prompt design, iterative refinement and evaluation techniques for LLM-based applications.
Proven experience in data modeling and building data ingestion pipelines on AWS (e.g. Glue, Lambda, S3) and/or Databricks.
Good programming skills in Python and SQL.
Solid understanding of machine learning concepts and familiarity with Large Language Models.
Good knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS and/or DataBricks) and modern data tools.
Curiosity, willingness to learn and a proactive attitude.
Good communication skills and the ability to work in a team.
Good knowledge of English, both written and spoken; Italian is required.




Nice to have: experience with frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph, AWS or Databricks certifications, a GitHub portfolio, Microsoft Fabric and Azure.







WHAT WE OFFER

The proposed salary includes a gross annual salary (RAL) ranging between €29,000 and €40,000, depending on skills and experience.




ADDITIONAL BENEFITS

Challenging and innovative projects
Dynamic and merit-based environment
Agile team collaboration
Professional growth plan
Training courses and certifications
Welfare & Benefits system
Smart working or full remote options (genuinely available❗) with flexible hours




JOIN US

Location: Rome (Hybrid)- Milan (Hybrid) – Florence (Hybrid)

We adopt a hybrid working strategy designed to leverage the opportunities offered by remote work for both employees and the company. Our approach reflects the belief that an employee’s impact, contribution, and results matter more than their physical location.

Kirey promotes diversity in the workplace. All applications for open positions are welcome and will be assessed based on merit.

Your personal data will be processed for recruitment purposes (execution of pre-contractual measures) by Kirey S.r.l., headquartered at Viale Francesco Restelli 5, 20124 Milan, Italy, represented by its legal representative, and/or by other companies under its control. LLM Research Engineer




Il nostro cliente è una realtà tecnologica specializzata nello sviluppo di soluzioni avanzate basate sull’Intelligenza Artificiale.

Title: Intellera - BI & Data Visualization Consultant
Description:
Perché assistere al cambiamento, quando puoi guidarlo? In Accenture, potrai crescere in un ambiente inclusivo e rispettoso della tua unicità e valori, sviluppando le tue abilità con programmi di training continuativi ed esperienziali. Unisciti al motore che alimenta Accenture, crea valore a 360° per i nostri clienti e le comunità in cui lavoriamo grazie al tuo contributo come Reinventor e accompagna le aziende più importanti nel loro percorso di trasformazione digitale.

Il tuo ruolo e le tue prospettive

Entra a far parte del Reinvention Partner Industry & Enterprise in ambito Data&AI nel settore Health & Public Service. Lavorerai con tecnologie innovative su progetti entusiasmanti, collaborando con numerosi enti governativi centrali, locali e comunitari per garantire che le aspettative e le esigenze della comunità siano al centro dei servizi pubblici. Affiancherai anche le aziende sanitarie nel comprendere le attitudini ed esigenze dei pazienti, assistenti e operatori, nonché i sistemi più ampi in cui si inseriscono, al fine di generare impatto sociale e risultati positivi per tutti. Nello specifico, potrai:



Progettare e sviluppare modelli di reporting, dashboard e soluzioni di Data Visualization attraverso strumenti di Business Intelligence quali Power BI, Qlik, Tableau e tecnologie analoghe, trasformando i dati in insight a supporto dei processi decisionali.

Definire e sviluppare modelli dati e modelli semantici scalabili, garantendo qualità, affidabilità e performance delle soluzioni di analisi e reporting.

Analizzare, integrare e valorizzare dati provenienti da fonti eterogenee mediante SQL, Power Query e Python, contribuendo all'evoluzione delle architetture informative.

Interagire con stakeholder di business e team tecnici per raccogliere requisiti, definire KPI e tradurre le esigenze progettuali in soluzioni data-driven ad alto valore aggiunto.

Contribuire alle iniziative di Data Management e Data Governance, supportando la definizione di standard, processi e best practice per la gestione del patrimonio informativo.

Partecipare a progettualità innovative basate su piattaforme dati moderne e ambienti cloud (es. Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Cloudera), contribuendo all'evoluzione delle capacità analitiche dei clienti.



La retribuzione prevista in Accenture viene definita sulla base di molteplici elementi di valutazione, tra cui – ad esempio - il ruolo ricoperto, il livello di seniority, il grado di responsabilità, le competenze professionali e l’esperienza maturata. Per la presente posizione, è previsto un livello di inquadramento 1 nel CCNL Commercio.

La fascia di retribuzione annua lorda prevista è compresa tra 35.215,88 € e 46.700 €.

Se vuoi fare della tua passione una carriera e hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando:



Laurea magistrale conclusa in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica, Data Science, Statistica, Matematica o discipline affini.

Esperienza di 2-4 anni in ambito Data Analytics, Business Intelligence e Data Visualization.

Ottima conoscenza di strumenti di Business Intelligence, in particolare Power BI (dashboarding, data modeling, DAX e Power Query); costituisce un plus la conoscenza di Tableau, Qlik o strumenti analoghi.

Esperienza nell'analisi, modellazione e interrogazione dei dati tramite SQL e conoscenza di Python per attività di data analysis e data preparation.

Familiarità con piattaforme dati e ambienti cloud (es. Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Cloudera) e conoscenza dei principali concetti di Data Management e Data Governance.

Spiccate capacità analitiche e di problem solving, attitudine al lavoro in team e alla gestione della relazione con stakeholder tecnici e di business.



Scopri di più su di noi

Intellera Consulting è un’azienda di consulenza organizzativa, gestionale e tecnologica d’eccellenza, forte di circa 1.400 professionisti con consolidate conoscenze di molteplici settori industriali nel mercato nazionale e internazionale. Combinando un’esperienza unica e competenze specialistiche in ambito public, fornisce servizi di digital transformation.

Da maggio 2024 Intellera è entrata a far parte del Gruppo Accenture, rafforzandone il posizionamento nel mercato della Pubblica Amministrazione e dell'Healthcare.

Policy

Qualora il tuo percorso di selezione andasse a buon fine, avrai la possibilità di aderire all’Accordo di smart working, ove compatibile con l’attività svolta, e lavorare da remoto secondo quanto previsto dalle policy aziendali.

Applicando alle nostre posizioni, il candidato/la candidata si impegna sin da ora ad osservare il sistema di gestione anticorruzione Intellera, comprendente Policy e Codice Etico.

Title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Embedded AI
Description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)? Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy? Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision? Then Pennylane is the right place for you!

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones). We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while giving them access to the key financial information they need to make the best decisions for their business.

About Us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon in Europe!). In 5 years of existence, we've managed to:


💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants
💰 Raise a total of €400 million, including from Sequoia — the famous Silicon Valley fund that invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe and Paypal
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1,000 happy Pennylaners, and earn a place among the greatest companies to work for in France (and remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor
🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities and a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of employees already work from all parts of Europe
🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms, with outstanding ratings
🚀 Reach more than 1,000,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6,000 accounting firms using Pennylane in France


WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission

Pennylane is becoming the financial OS of European SMEs and accounting firms. A growing share of the work done inside our product will be automated or assisted by AI. Our strategy operates at three layers: verticalized AI embedded in the product, an agent interface that makes Pennylane readable and actionable by AIs, and the Pennylane orchestrator agent itself.

The Embedded AI team owns the first layer. We build the specialized machine learning systems behind Copilot and Autopilot: invoice parsing, document classification, accounting suggestions, matching, scoring, Bookkeeping Autopilot and Revision Autopilot.

Models are commoditizing fast. What makes the difference is our ability to frame the right problem, use Pennylane’s data and accounting knowledge, evaluate quality on real workflows, and operate reliable systems in production.

By joining us as a Machine Learning Engineer — Embedded AI, you will turn difficult accounting problems into trusted ML products used every day. You will combine strong ML engineering, product thinking and production ownership to improve both automation and user trust.

HOW you will contribute as a Machine Learning Engineer — Embedded AI

You will join the Embedded AI team within our ML & AI organization. The team works closely with product squads and accounting experts, from initial exploration to production, monitoring and continuous improvement.


You will design and ship ML systems for document understanding, extraction, classification, matching, ranking, scoring and recommendations.

Title: Senior Consultant - AI & Advanced Technology
Description:
Senior Consultant - AI & Advanced technology

Risk Consulting is looking for candidate to join our Risk Advanced Technology team as Senior Consultant based in Rome for a hybrid role.

Risk Consulting is a management consulting firm that provides risk management services as part of Marsh Risk, a leader in insurance brokerage and head of the international Marsh Group, a group of expertise in strategic and management consulting, reinsurance, human capital, and investments (Oliver Wyman, Guy Carpenter, Mercer).

The Risk Advanced Technology practice develops innovative risk management services using advanced technologies (Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Process Mining, and Business Intelligence) to support leading public and private organizations.

We count on you to:


Support clients in developing integrated risk management frameworks and in the digital transformation of risk management processes;
Analyze, map, and redesign business processes to identify inefficiencies, pain points, control gaps, and automation opportunities, with a particular focus on AI-enabled transformation initiatives;
Support clients in the assessment and reengineering of operational and control processes, leveraging AI, process mining, intelligent automation, and advanced analytics solutions. Gather and formalize business and functional requirements, translating client needs into actionable process improvement roadmaps and technology-enabled solutions;
Contribute to the design and implementation of AI use cases aimed at improving process efficiency, strengthening controls, reducing manual activities, and enhancing decision-making;
Work closely with business, risk, compliance, audit, and technology stakeholders to ensure that process transformation initiatives are aligned with governance, regulatory, and internal control requirements;
Support the execution of diagnostic assessments, gap analyses, and target operating model designs in the context of business transformation and innovation programs;
Contribute to project delivery across the full lifecycle, from current-state analysis and solution design to implementation support, testing, go-live, and change management;
Mentor junior team members and contribute to the development of internal methodologies, assets, and thought leadership on AI-driven process transformation;
Build Business Intelligence and Advanced Analytics solutions for dynamic reporting, risk monitoring dashboards, and early warning systems;
Interact with clients and all stakeholders involved in the projects, presenting results and strategic recommendations clearly and effectively.


What you need to have: 


Master’s degree or higher in Management or Industrial Engineering, with excellent academic results;
Proven experience in consulting projects with proven expertise in the following areas:

Good understanding of AI-enabled business transformation, including the application of Artificial Intelligence, intelligent automation, process mining, or analytics to improve business processes
Consulting projects focused on business process analysis, process reengineering, operating model review, or transformation initiative
Solid experience in gathering business and functional requirements, process mapping, drafting functional specifications, and supporting the implementation of technology-driven solutions
Experience in interacting with multiple stakeholders, facilitating workshops, and presenting complex topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
Strong project management attitude, attention to detail, and ability to manage workstreams autonomously in a client-facing environment
Excellent knowledge of PowerPoint and Excel; familiarity with process mapping and workflow documentation tools is a plus
Fluent Italian and English, both written and spoken


What makes you stand out:


Experience in AI transformation projects with a specific focus on process optimization, redesign, governance, and adoption
Knowledge of LLM models: prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), orchestration of AI agents and copilots, evaluation of model performance, and application of guardrails and governance mechanisms to ensure reliability, explainability, and compliance in business processes
Experience in internal controls, internal audit, compliance, or assurance-related projects, as well as familiarity with the most widely used risk management frameworks (e.g., ISO 31000, COSO Framework), with the ability to connect process reengineering initiatives to control frameworks and verification needs
Knowledge of process mining tools and methodologies for identifying bottlenecks, deviations, and improvement opportunities
Familiarity with risk and control frameworks, governance models, and operating models in regulated or complex environments
Experience in projects involving the review of end-to-end processes within finance, operations, procurement, compliance, or risk functions
Knowledge of low-code / no-code and workflow automation platforms (e.g., Power Platform, Power Automate) and their use in process transformation initiatives
Relevant certifications in process improvement, project management, audit, or risk management
Knowledge of advanced Data Visualization tools (Power BI, DAX, Qlik) and Data Management tools (e.g., Azure, SQL, SAS)


Why join our team:


An international, cross-business network with leaders in Strategy, Risk, and People professional services
The opportunity to design and apply innovative risk solutions in practice for use by the Italian Public Administration (e.g., central government bodies and public-owned companies) and the private sector


What we offer:


The position is offered on a permanent basis.
We propose a gross annual salary starting from € 32.000 for a full-time position. Depending on experience, skills and qualifications, we are willing to consider compensation above the starting salary. Variable remuneration may be granted in accordance with company policy. Further details will be shared during the selection process or directly in the employment contract.
The National Collective Bargaining Agreement (NCBA) applied is "Terziario, Distribuzione e Servizi”. The contractual level, together with the applicable terms and conditions, will be determined in line with the experience and professional profile of the candidate selected through the recruitment process.
Attractive benefits offered, including insurance coverages, supplementary pension plan, facultative health assistance, meal vouchers, flexible benefits, optional stock purchase plan, smart working policy, learning programs and well-being initiatives. Further details will be shared during the selection process or directly in the employment contract


Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

Title: Junior Data Engineer
HTML:
We let the future guide us. Join our next generation

Vuoi fare un lavoro che sia davvero significativo e di impatto? In KPMG avrai l’opportunità di aiutare i clienti, la società, le colleghe e i colleghi ad affrontare e risolvere le sfide più attuali e complesse. KPMG Advisory offre servizi di consulenza alle imprese per affiancarle nella trasformazione del business model, nel miglioramento e nella digitalizzazione dei processi, nell'analisi e nella gestione dei rischi, nonché supporto nelle operazioni di finanza straordinaria.

Nel particolare, entrerai a far parte del Team di Lighthouse di Roma.

La Lighthouse è il centro di eccellenza di KPMG Advisory che offre soluzioni di Data & Analytics sul mercato.

Unendoti al team, svilupperai soluzioni innovative attingendo dalle nostre competenze globali. Combinerai informatica, matematica, statistica e business per creare analisi predittive, presentandole e comunicandole con professionalità e competenza. Opererai in un ambiente orientato all'innovazione tecnologica, occupandoti dell'ingegneria dei dati, con un forte focus sulla progettazione delle informazioni e visualizzazione dei dati. Abbiamo ricevuto riconoscimenti internazionali per quanto riguarda la nostra capacità di interpretare e gestire i dati.

Nello specifico, ti occuperai di:

  • Analisi di modelli analitici a supporto dei processi di business;
  • Analisi, progettazione e implementazione di fonti di dati;
  • Data Visualization, Advanced Analytics, Big Data;
  • Progettare KPI e i framework di calcolo più efficienti;
  • Analizzare, progettare e implementare modelli di reporting e dashboard di monitoraggio;
  • Analizzare processi aziendali e progettare modelli di supporto analitico;
  • Implementare soluzioni analitiche, supportare il go-live e gestire la manutenzione delle applicazioni.

Come As You Are - Le tue competenze e caratteristiche

Questa opportunità è perfetta per te se:

  • Possiedi una Laurea in economia, matematica, ingegneria matematica, statistica, ingegneria informatica, ingegneria gestionale o informatica;
  • Hai sviluppato conoscenza in ambito dati e database (modelli dati entità/relazioni, DBMS)
  • Hai sviluppato la capacità di combinare competenze aziendali con competenze IT, inclusa la modellazione dei dati;
  • Hai sviluppato interesse per la Data Visualization e Business Intelligence
  • Hai sviluppato Interesse per i tool ed i processi ETL (Informatica, Talend, Datastage);
  • Hai una buona padronanza della lingua inglese, preferibilmente con esperienze di studio e/o lavoro all'estero;
  • Possiedi conoscenza di almeno uno dei seguenti database (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL) e hai sviluppato competenze in SQL; la conoscenza di linguaggi di programmazione rappresenta un vantaggio.

Your Future With Us - Cosa troverai in KPMG

  • Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, equo e che rispetta, incoraggia e valorizza le diversità;
  • Un contesto stimolante e dinamico che incentiva la creatività e il lavoro di squadra;
  • Modalità di lavoro ibrida, per promuovere un sano equilibrio tra vita lavorativa e personale;
  • Programmi di formazione e sviluppo avanzati per rimanere sempre aggiornati;
  • Mindset internazionale e progettualità innovative;
  • Iniziative incentrate sul benessere psicofisico.

L’opportunità prevede un inserimento con indennità mensile di 800€ per stage curriculare o 1.000€ per stage extracurriculare o in assunzione con inquadramento ai sensi del CCNL Commercio e RAL di ingresso: € 30.000, determinata sulla base di criteri oggettivi quali il titolo di studio e la valutazione del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione.

In ottemperanza alla normativa vigente, non raccogliamo né utilizziamo informazioni sulle retribuzioni percepite in rapporti di lavoro attuali o precedenti. Le nostre procedure di selezione sono, inoltre, improntate a criteri oggettivi e neutrali rispetto al genere.

Together for Better – I nostri valori e il nostro impegno

Leadership, lavoro in team, rispetto di ogni individualità, approfondimento continuo, trasparenza, impegno verso la comunità, integrità: questi sono i Valori di KPMG che danno vita a un ambiente aperto allo scambio di idee e di conoscenza, che permette ai nostri professionisti di esprimere tutto il loro potenziale.

GGrazie all’impegno nel favorire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, il nostro Network risulta conforme agli standard dei requisiti ISO 30415, sul Sistema di Gestione per la Diversità e l’Inclusione, e UNI PdR 125, relativa alla parità di genere. All’interno del nostro Impact Plan - Our Impact Plan (kpmg.com) - trovi riassunte tutte le azioni che stiamo portando avanti su tematiche ambientali, sociali e di governance (ESG).

Unisciti a noi!

I tuoi dati saranno trattati nel pieno rispetto delle disposizioni del Regolamento (UE) n. 679/2016 (General Data Protection Regulation - "GDPR") e successive modifiche. Per ulteriori informazioni, consultare l'informativa sulla privacy di KPMG.

KPMG Advisory S.p.A. garantisce le pari opportunità

At KPMG - no secrets with big data

We let the future guide us. Join our next generation

Do you want to pursue a profession that is truly meaningful and impactful? At KPMG, you will have the opportunity to help clients, the company and colleagues address and solve the most current and complex challenges. KPMG Advisory offers consulting services to companies to assist them in business model transformation, process improvement and digitisation, risk analysis and management, and support in extraordinary finance transactions.

Specifically, you will join our Lighthouse team.

Lighthouse is the KPMG Advisory centre of excellence delivering an array of data & analytics solutions.

Alongside the team, you will develop innovative solutions by drawing on our global expertise,with access to shared knowledge from our centres of excellence Your experience in IT, mathematics and statistics along with your corporate expertise will allow you to design and implement predictive analytical solutions, integrating different factors and presenting them in a professional manner. In a business- and technological innovation-orientated environment, your work will embrace data science, data engineering and information visualisation.

Specifically, you will be tasked with:

  • designing databases for analytical purposes;
  • analysing and integrating data sources;
  • data visualization, advanced analytics, Big Data;
  • designing more efficient KPIs and computing frameworks;
  • analysing, designing and implementing reporting models and dashboards;
  • analysing corporate processes and designing analytical support models;
  • implementing analytical solutions, supporting the launch and overseeing the maintenance of software.

Skills

 Come As You Are - Your skills and characteristics

This is the perfect opportunity for you if:

  • you have a degree in economics, mathematics, mathematical engineering, statistics, computer engineering, management and production engineering or computer science;
  • you have developed the capacity to combine corporate and IT expertise, as well as data modelling;
  • you have developed aninterest in Data Visualization/Business Intelligence;
  • you are proficient in English, preferably with study/work experience abroad
  • you have knowledge of at least one of the following databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and have developed skills in SQL; knowledge of programming languages is considered an advantage.

Your Future With Us - What you’ll find at KPMG

  • An inclusive and equitable work environment that respects, encourages and values diversity.
  • A challenging and dynamic environment that encourages creativity and teamwork.
  • Hybrid work arrangements to promote a healthy work-life balance.
  • Advanced training and development programmes to stay current.
  • International mindset and innovative projects.
  • Initiatives focused on mental and physical well-being.

This opportunity is offered as either a paid internship offering a monthly allowance of €800 for curricular internships and €1,000 for extracurricular internships or a standard employment contract under the collective labour agreement for the commerce sector, with a starting gross annual salary of €30,000. The salary is determined on the basis of objective criteria, including educational qualifications and an assessment of the candidate’s profile against the requirements of the role.

In accordance with applicable legislation, we do not collect or use information relating to remuneration received in current or previous employment. Our selection procedures are based on objective and gender-neutral criteria.

Together for Better – Our values and commitment

Leadership, teamwork, respect every individual, continuous learning, transparency, commitment to the community and integrity. These are the KPMG values that create an environment that encourages the sharing of ideas and knowledge, so our professionals can achieve their full potential.

As a result of our commitment to fostering an inclusive work environment, our Network complies with the standards of the ISO 30415 requirements, on the Diversity and Inclusion Management System, and UNI PdR 125, relating to gender equality. Within our Impact Plan - Our Impact Plan (kpmg.com) - you will find summarised all the actions we are taking on environmental, social and governance (ESG) issues.

Join us!

Your data will be processed in full compliance with the provisions of Regulation (EU) no. 679/2016 (General Data Protection Regulation - “GDPR”), as amended. For more information, please see KPMG’s privacy policy.

KPMG Advisory S.p.A. is an equal opportunity employer.

Title: AI & Data Science Engineer
Description:
Laser Romae è una PMI Innovativa che opera nel settore dell'Information and Communication Technology e dell'Ingegneria. Progettiamo e realizziamo soluzioni tecnologiche all'avanguardia per supportare la trasformazione digitale dei nostri clienti.

Il tuo ruolo nel team

Siamo alla ricerca di un/a AI & Data Science Engineer (Machine Learning / AI Engineer) da inserire all'interno di un importante progetto di migrazione e modernizzazione di soluzioni di Machine Learning. Ti occuperai di effettuare il porting di modelli e pipeline dati da Dataiku verso Google Vertex AI, contribuendo alla loro ingegnerizzazione e ottimizzazione.

Responsabilità Principali


Analizzare i workflow e i modelli ML esistenti sviluppati su piattaforma Dataiku.
Effettuare il porting e la migrazione delle pipeline dati e dei modelli verso l'ecosistema Google Vertex AI.
Ottimizzare le soluzioni reingegnerizzando e rifattorizzando i componenti custom in Python.
Supportare le attività di test, rilascio, monitoraggio e messa in esercizio delle soluzioni in ambiente cloud.
Collaborare con i team aziendali per l'industrializzazione e la scalabilità dei modelli.


Requisiti Richiesti


Seniority indicativa Middle (almeno 3 anni di esperienza nel ruolo).
Ottima conoscenza di Python per lo sviluppo di pipeline dati e modelli di Machine Learning.
Esperienza comprovata nello sviluppo, training, tuning e validazione di modelli ML.
Solida conoscenza dei principali algoritmi di classificazione, regressione e forecasting.
Esperienza su piattaforme Cloud dedicate all'AI/ML, con preferenza specifica per Google Vertex AI.
Ottima conoscenza di SQL per data preparation, analisi dati e interrogazione di basi dati.
Forte autonomia operativa e capacità di inserimento rapido in contesti complessi.


Nice To Have


Esperienza pratica con Dataiku DSS.
Conoscenza approfondita dell'ecosistema Google Cloud (BigQuery, Vertex AI).
Familiarità con pratiche MLOps e pipeline di CI/CD applicate al ciclo di vita dei modelli.
Conoscenza di Docker e la gestione di ambienti containerizzati.


Sede di lavoro: Milano (ibrido)

Inquadramento: 35K - 40K

Prossimi step: colloquio conoscitivo, colloquio tecnico e proposta economico-contrattuale.

Si raccomanda di allegare al CV l'autorizzazione al trattamento dei dati personali come da D. Lgs N 196 del 30/06/2003 e del GDPR n. 679/2016.

Title: Generative AI Engineer
Description:
Cosa aspettarti

Deda Next è parte del Gruppo Deda, specializzata nella trasformazione digitale di PA e aziende di pubblico servizio attraverso la progettazione e realizzazione di servizi di nuova generazione. Attraverso il cloud che abilita la gestione efficace di dati e piattaforme, Deda Next partecipa allo sviluppo di una società in cui le persone sono al centro di tutto.

Lavorerai nell'Area Data &AI alla progettazione, implementazione e valutazione di soluzioni AI, integrando modelli linguistici, basi documentali, API e tool esterni.

Il ruolo è fortemente hands-on: è importante saper trasformare un’idea o un requisito in un prototipo funzionante e successivamente portarlo verso una soluzione robusta e manutenibile.

Cosa farai


Progetterai e svilupperai soluzioni di Generative AI basate su LLM, AI Agent e architetture RAG.
Gestirai l'intero ciclo delle pipeline AI, dall'ingestion dei dati al retrieval, fino alla valutazione e all'ottimizzazione delle performance.
Integrerai LLM, vector database, API e sistemi aziendali per realizzare applicazioni intelligenti e scalabili.
Svilupperai componenti backend in Python e semplici interfacce web per prototipi e soluzioni AI.
Contribuirai all'evoluzione delle architetture AI, adottando standard e tecnologie innovative dell'ecosistema GenAI.


Cosa ci aspettiamo da te


Esperienza di almeno 3 anni con LLM e Generative AI, inclusi prompt engineering, structured output, AI Agent, function/tool calling, context management e integrazione di modelli tramite API, con attenzione a costi, latenza e performance.
Esperienza nella progettazione e sviluppo di soluzioni RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), includendo document ingestion, preprocessing, chunking, embeddings, semantic e hybrid search, vector database, retrieval, reranking e valutazione della qualità delle risposte.
Esperienza nella valutazione e ottimizzazione di sistemi LLM/RAG, attraverso definizione di test e benchmark, analisi della qualità del retrieval e delle risposte (groundedness, relevance, faithfulness) e identificazione delle principali criticità dei sistemi generativi.
Esperienza nello sviluppo di applicazioni Python e API REST, utilizzando framework come FastAPI e adottando principi di software engineering, con capacità di realizzare prototipi e interfacce AI tramite HTML/CSS/JavaScript, React, Streamlit o Gradio.
Nice to have: esperienza con framework e tecnologie dell'ecosistema GenAI e AI Agents (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex), vector database e motori di ricerca semantica (pgvector, Qdrant, Weaviate, Pinecone, OpenSearch), oltre a competenze in Docker, servizi Cloud AI, CI/CD, observability, LLM tracing e gestione di modelli open source.


Cosa ti offriamo


Work life balance grazie a un modello di lavoro agile personalizzato e flessibile
Coinvolgimento in progetti strategici e innovativi nella Pubblica Amministrazione
Valori da condividere; possibilità di crescita, formazione e certificazione supportati dall’azienda – scopri la vita in Deda
