Title: Statistician
Description:
Organizational Setting

The Statistics Division (ESS) develops and advocates for the implementation of methodologies and standards for data collection, validation, processing and analysis, in the food and agriculture statistics domains. In these statistical domains, it also plays a key role in the compilation, processing and dissemination of internationally comparable data, and provides essential capacity building in support of member countries. The Division also disseminates publications, working papers and statistical yearbooks, that cover agriculture and food security statistics, including prices, investments, production, trade and agri-environmental statistical data. Finally, as the ESS Director also plays the role of FAO Chief Statistician, the Division supports the various functions of the Chief Statistician, that is to ensure stronger governance of FAO's data and statistical system, foster consistency of FAO's Data and Statistical programme within the Strategic Framework, ensure statistical excellence through the implementation of statistical standards and quality assurance mechanisms, and position FAO's presence in data and statistical discussions at global level.

The incumbent will work in the Food Security and Nutrition Statistics team within the Statistics Division and will contribute to the production and dissemination of all statistics reported in the Food Security and Nutrition, Food and Diet, and Cost and Affordability of Healthy Diets data domains of FAOSTAT.

The position is located in the Statistics Division (ESS) at FAO headquarters in Rome, Italy.

Reporting Lines

The Statistician reports to the Senior Statistician and team leader of the Food Security and Nutrition Statistics Team, under the overall guidance of the Director of ESS.

Technical Focus

The S tatistician will provide statistical expertise in the improvement of existing methods and development of new methods for the generation of food security and nutrition statistics, and in the compilation, processing, validation, analysis, storage and dissemination of data, microdata and metadata, with a special emphasis on data from experience-based food security scales. The role includes: ensuring the correct application of methods to estimate the Prevalence of food insecurity based on Food Insecurity Experience Scale (FIES), the Prevalence of Undernourishment (PoU), and the Prevalence of Unaffordability of a healthy diet (PUA); the production of high quality documents and statistical tools, including software packages, scripts, datasets and reports on the analysis of food security and nutrition data; collaborating with external stakeholders and partners, including national statistical offices and other international organizations or research institutions, involved in the collection, analysis, dissemination and reporting of food security and nutrition statistics based on FAO endorsed statistical methods and definitions.

Key Results

Research and analysis of information, data and statistics, statistical methods, statistical and econometric modelling. Development and maintenance of specialized tools, methodologies, systems and/or databases and the technical assistance services to support the implementation/delivery and monitoring of the programme of work and related products, projects, publications and services.

Key Functions


Collects, reviews, processes and/or analyses key social/economic/environmental/indicators, based on both traditional statistical methods/sources or on unstructured sources and data science methods, to support the delivery of economic and social development programmes of work, which can be focused on products, projects, publications or services.
Develops improved/updated technical, statistical and/or analytical tools, systems, databases.
Conducts research, data collection, validation, analysis and/or reporting in support of the development of technical standards, international instruments, innovative tools and methodologies to be used within the Organization or by external stakeholders.
Produces a variety of technical reports and provides input in technical documents, divisional publications and/or web pages.
Provides response to requests and provides technical and/or policy advice, assistance and solutions to Regional, Subregional and Country Offices, including technical backstopping to field projects.
Participates in multidisciplinary teams, collaborates with other Divisions/Offices/Centres on work groups and committees and promotes best practices.
Provides capacity development services, including the planning and organization of training workshops and seminars and preparation of related information, materials, on-line tools and information kits.
Participates in divisional teams, Organization-wide committees, project teams and working groups and provides specialized expertise on international technical networks and or technical policy and standard setting bodies.
Supports the organization, conduct and follow-up of meetings, consultations and conferences, the development/production of required materials and the provision of information and assistance to partners.
Participates in resource mobilization activities in accordance with the Strategic Framework and divisional plans.
Promotes international cooperation and collaboration, advocates best practices, knowledge sharing, increased policy dialogue and provides technical expertise at international meetings and conferences.


Specific Functions

Maintains and refines the methodology and the statistical tools to compute the Prevalence of Food Insecurity based on FIES and other food security and nutrition indicators produced by the FSN statistics Team.

Description:
All’interno del team Chief Strategy, Business Development and Wholebuy Office – Competence Development Center, ricerchiamo una persona da inserire nel ruolo di Business Data Analyst motivata e con un forte approccio analitico, da inserire presso la nostra sede di Roma.

Attività previste dal ruolo:

La persona individuata si occuperà di analizzare e interpretare dati provenienti da diverse fonti aziendali, sviluppando soluzioni di analisi e monitoraggio a supporto delle decisioni di business e contribuendo all’automazione e all’industrializzazione dei processi di elaborazione dei dati.

In particolare, la risorsa sarà coinvolta in:


Definizione degli scope progettuali e traduzione delle esigenze di business in requisiti analitici e tecnici.
Analisi di fenomeni complessi attraverso dati provenienti da fonti eterogenee.
Individuazione di KPI e metriche rilevanti per il monitoraggio delle performance aziendali.
Sviluppo e automazione di processi di elaborazione, controllo e analisi dei dati.
Verifica della qualità, della coerenza e dell’affidabilità delle informazioni prima della loro condivisione con gli stakeholder.
Individuazione di anomalie nei dati e supporto alle attività di troubleshooting e riconciliazione tra fonti differenti.
Interpretazione dei risultati delle analisi, distinguendo evidenze, ipotesi e possibili cause dei fenomeni osservati.
Sviluppo autonomo di analisi, KPI e strumenti di supporto alle decisioni.
Comunicazione chiara ed efficace degli insight e dei risultati analitici, anche a interlocutori non tecnici.
Gestione autonoma delle attività assegnate, in collaborazione con team tecnici e stakeholder di business.


Tali attività saranno svolte con riferimento al processo di integrazione delle competenze funzionali al percorso di trasformazione aziendale in atto.

Requisiti richiesti:


Laurea o percorso specialistico in discipline quantitative o tecnico-scientifiche, quali Data Science, Statistica, Matematica, Informatica, Ingegneria, Economia quantitativa o percorsi affini.
Conoscenza avanzata di SQL e capacità di lavorare con dataset complessi e di grandi dimensioni.
Buona conoscenza di Python, con particolare riferimento all’analisi e alla trasformazione dei dati.
Conoscenza delle principali librerie Python per la data analysis, quali Pandas, NumPy o equivalenti.
Capacità di sviluppare processi di data preparation, aggregazione, riconciliazione e controllo qualità.
Conoscenza dei principi di modellazione del dato e delle problematiche relative a granularità, duplicazioni, join e consistenza tra fonti.
Esperienza nell’utilizzo di database relazionali e/o data warehouse.
Familiarità con Google Cloud Platform e con strumenti quali BigQuery, Cloud Storage e Vertex AI, o con piattaforme cloud equivalenti.
Familiarità con strumenti di data visualization e dashboarding.
Familiarità con sistemi di versionamento del codice, in particolare Git.
Conoscenza dei principi di sviluppo software, con attenzione alla leggibilità, alla modularità e alla manutenibilità del codice.
Familiarità con processi di automazione, scheduling e industrializzazione delle elaborazioni dati.
Familiarità con tecniche di prompt engineering e con strumenti low-code/no-code per la realizzazione di agenti AI e workflow basati su modelli generativi.


Competenze trasversali:


Forte capacità analitica e attitudine all’interpretazione di fenomeni complessi.
Orientamento alla qualità, all’affidabilità e alla coerenza del dato.
Capacità di comprendere le esigenze degli stakeholder e tradurle in requisiti analitici e tecnici.
Autonomia nella gestione delle attività e orientamento al risultato.
Problem solving e capacità di individuare anomalie e possibili cause dei fenomeni osservati.
Comunicazione chiara ed efficace, anche verso interlocutori non tecnici.
Predisposizione alla collaborazione con team tecnici e stakeholder di business.


Titoli preferenziali:


Esperienza nello sviluppo di analisi dati a supporto delle decisioni di business.
Esperienza nella costruzione e nel monitoraggio di KPI e metriche di performance.
Esperienza nell’utilizzo di SQL in contesti progettuali o aziendali.
Esperienza nella gestione di dataset provenienti da fonti eterogenee e nelle attività di data quality e data reconciliation.
Esperienza nella realizzazione o manutenzione di dashboard e strumenti di reporting.
Familiarità con ambienti cloud, pipeline dati e processi CI/CD.


Cosa offriamo:


Contratto a tempo indeterminato.
RAL di partenza pari a 31.400€, stabilita utilizzando criteri oggettivi e neutrali rispetto al genere. L’offerta economica effettiva potrà ulteriormente incrementarsi, entro parametri prestabiliti, in considerazione dell’evidenza di alcuni criteri di riferimento, quali il percorso formativo effettuato, l’esperienza professionale maturata nel ruolo e complessivamente, le certificazioni conseguite e la particolare affinità dimostrata rispetto al profilo ricercato.
Pacchetto welfare e benefit aggiuntivi.
Formazione continua e percorsi di certificazione.
Possibilità di lavorare su progetti di analisi, automazione e industrializzazione dei dati, utilizzando tecnologie cloud, strumenti di data visualization e soluzioni basate sull’intelligenza artificiale.
Opportunità di crescita in un contesto dinamico, innovativo e orientato alla trasformazione digitale.

Title: Artificial Intelligence Space Engineer
Description:
A Joint Venture between Thales (67%) and Leonardo (33%), Thales Alenia Space is a global space manufacturer delivering, for more than 40 years, high-tech solutions for telecommunications, navigation, Earth Observation, environmental management, exploration, science and orbital infrastructures. Thanks to our diversity of skills, talents and cultures, our customers (governments, institutions, space agencies, telecommunications operators), therefore have Space to Connect, Secure & Defend, Observe & Protect, Explore, Travel & Navigate.

We are looking for an Artificial Intelligence Engineering

CANDIDATES THAT WOULD IMPRESS US:

You graduated from an Engineering School with a master’s degree – a PhD is a plus

Your level of experience ranges from junior to advance: you are a student OR/AND you have already occupied one or more positions among the following: Algorithm or Software Engineer, Artificial Intelligence Engineer

You are curious and willing to stay abreast of the latest trends (technical, philosophical, ethical by design)

You enjoy thinking "outside the box" and use your creativity to address complex challenges

You are recognised as a team player and promote collaborative work

You are user centric and want to design components accordingly

COMPETENCIES:

You have in-depth knowledge in mathematics, algorithms, experiment plan, continuous iterations and Agility

You are proficient in one of the following Artificial Intelligence Approches:

Data driven AI, Symbolic AI, Hybrid AI on the Solution

Symbolic Artificial Intelligence and reasoning

Human/machine dialog

Systems Analysis

You understand the norms, laws and standards

You have knowledge of cybersecurity

You can confidently discuss with people from different jobs and background

You master foundational concepts in mathematics/ statistics science and their application to deploy them on Solution studies: statistical modelling, linear algebra, optimisation, machine learning Mathematics and Statistics

NICE TO HAVE:


Working heritage on major satellite Earth Observation and Navigation systems
Simulation by tool such as Matlab & Simulink
adopting modern Agile and DevOps processes
Knowledge of Data analysis and big data technologies
Knowledge of Cloud technologies and architectures
Knowledge of Edgetechnologies
Knowledge of object programming in particular Python (Pyorch) , Java, C ++ and relevant Data Science packages (such as numpy, scipy, scikit-learn, pandas...);
Good knowledge of operating systems;



As an Artificial Intelligence Engineering Role within Thales, you will:

Design and develop trustworthy artificial intelligence components for various domains

Identify the right cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence technologies (machine learning, symbolic AI, dialogue) and develop the Artificial Intelligence component accordingly

Work on Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Understanding (NLU), and also to design multimodal approaches for Human-Machin Dialog including intention understanding, reasoning and hybrid AI

Work on Machine Learning, causality vs. correlation, and/or other Data driven AI technics such as Random Forest, Evolutionary Algorithms, …

Work on Symbolic AI, Ontology, Semantic Web, Knowledge based Reasoning, Meta-heuristics, Problem Solving, Operations Research, Decision Making and reasoning

Propose and design approach alternatives

Integrate scientific method into engineering system methodology

Ensure data knowledge and traceability

Ensure continuous technowatch and be aware of the latest trends (technical, philosophical, ethical by design)

Define the system capabilities thanks to a functional, logical and value analysis, describing functions to be performed to meet the real needs of the user in the various scenarii and maximising product value for Customer

YOUR CAREER AT THALES

Future opportunities will allow you to discover other domains or sites. You will be able to evolve and grow your competences in different areas:

Room and attention to personal development

Build your talents in another domain of Thales Group, discovering new products, new customers, new country or go to a more complex Solution

Choose between a technical expertise or a leadership path

Build an international career within a leading Engineering Group

Permanent

Experience: 1-7 Years

CCNL Met/Ind – B2 Category

€ 35.884,96 - € 43.126,00

Performance Bonus (PDR): up to € 4.025

At Thales Alenia Space we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales Alenia Space employing around 8,900 employees in 10 countries with 17 sites in Europe and a plant in the US, our mobility policy enables employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad. Thales Alenia Space sees space as a new horizon, helping to build a better, more sustainable life on Earth #SpaceForLife. Great journeys start here, apply now!

Title: Attuario Pricing – Non Motor
Description:
Siamo alla ricerca di una persona con solide competenze attuariali in ambito pricing, da inserire in un team nuovo e dinamico all’interno dell’Attuariato Danni Non Auto. La figura contribuirà in modo attivo alla definizione delle tariffe, allo sviluppo di modelli statistici avanzati e al monitoraggio tecnico dei portafogli Non Motor.




La risorsa si occuperà di:

Preparare e strutturare le basi dati necessarie alle analisi tariffarie e al monitoraggio tecnico, anche attraverso l’organizzazione dei dati storici aziendali e l’integrazione con fonti esterne
Condurre analisi univariate dei principali fattori di rischio e predisporre reportistica con KPI rilevanti
Sviluppare modelli predittivi (GLM e tecniche di machine learning) per i principali perils, con focus su rischi climatici e analisi territoriale
Calcolare il technical price, puntuale e aggregato, valutando componenti attuariali e di costo secondo le linee guida di Gruppo
Realizzare analisi di impatto tariffario (AS IS / AS IF analysis) tramite simulazioni sulle strutture tariffarie per supportare la calibrazione finale del pricing
Contribuire alla definizione della reportistica tecnica (es. Leakage), secondo le linee guida di capogruppo, predisponendo analisi di approfondimento ad hoc.




Requirements

Laurea in Scienze Attuariali, Statistica, Matematica o discipline affini (preferibile indirizzo data science)
Familiarità con strumenti di data analysis e machine learning (Python/R) e ottima padronanza del pacchetto Microsoft Office (Excel)
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, scritta e parlata.




Competenze trasversali

Capacità di gestire richieste complesse e strutturate, coinvolgendo più interlocutori
Motivazione, impegno, flessibilità e orientamento al risultato
Ottime capacità relazionali e attitudine al lavoro in team.




Nice to have

Esperienza anche minima in ambito area tecnica Danni
Familiarità con le tecniche di analisi multivariata e con i software di modellizzazione (Emblem/Radar)
Conoscenza delle componenti del fabbisogno tariffario dei prodotti Danni e dei prodotti multirischio
Conoscenza base dei requisiti normativi (es. VfM in ambito PoG) e dei relativi processi di monitoraggio.




Soft Skills

Spiccate capacità di analisi quantitativa e approccio metodico al problem solving
Curiosità, visione innovativa e apertura al cambiamento
Attitudine alla formazione continua
Capacità di gestione del tempo e dello stress
Proattività e determinazione nel proporre soluzioni con autonomia decisionale.




What we offer

È offerto inserimento nel 4° Livello di inquadramento e retributivo, con applicazione del CCNL ANIA per il personale dipendente non dirigente e del Contratto Integrativo Aziendale del Gruppo Generali.




Retribuzione annua lorda iniziale compresa tra 36K€ e 38K€. L’offerta finale sarà formulata in coerenza con l’esperienza professionale, le competenze tecniche e trasversali possedute dalla risorsa funzionali per il ruolo e potrà prevedere una componente variabile individuale.




Offriamo inoltre:




Smart working e flessibilità oraria
Sistema di welfare aziendale
Buoni pasto
Copertura sanitaria integrativa e assicurazioni a condizioni agevolate
Iniziative di wellbeing
Formazione e sviluppo
Percorsi strutturati di formazione continua, tecnica e manageriale
Programmi di sviluppo professionale all’interno del Gruppo
Accesso a learning platform e opportunità di mobilità interna, anche internazionale.




Why work with us

Entrare in Generali significa far parte di un Gruppo internazionale, con una storia solida e una visione orientata al futuro, che pone le persone al centro della propria strategia di crescita sostenibile.

In Generali promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro responsabile, inclusivo e orientato all’innovazione, in cui ciascuno può contribuire in modo concreto alla creazione di valore per i clienti, la società e le comunità in cui operiamo.

Offriamo percorsi di sviluppo professionale, opportunità di apprendimento continuo e mobilità interna, valorizzando il talento e il merito. Crediamo nella flessibilità come leva per il benessere delle persone e per un equilibrio sostenibile tra vita professionale e personale.

Lavorare in Generali significa condividere valori forti, affrontare sfide complesse per costruire ogni giorno, insieme, un futuro più sicuro e sostenibile.

In Generali promuoviamo una cultura aziendale fondata su diversità, equità e inclusione, nella convinzione che la valorizzazione delle differenze rappresenti un fattore chiave per la crescita sostenibile del Gruppo.

In qualità di Datore di Lavoro che garantisce le Pari Opportunità, Generali valuta tutte le candidature esclusivamente sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutri rispetto al genere, in funzione delle competenze, dell’esperienza e del potenziale, assicurando equità e trasparenza in ogni fase del processo di selezione.




Company Profile

Il nostro purpose: “Empowering Lives and Dreams – Diamo forza alla vita e ai sogni delle persone”.

Essere Partner di Vita è ciò che in Generali facciamo ogni giorno, con la volontà di essere al fianco delle persone nei momenti rilevanti della loro vita. Non è solo ciò che facciamo, è ciò che siamo. Per questo per noi è Più di un Lavoro.




Siamo parte di un importante Gruppo internazionale con oltre 82 mila persone in tutto il mondo e più di 70 milioni di clienti
Siamo tra i principali player globali del settore assicurativo: l’innovazione e la sostenibilità sono nel nostro DNA
Generali Italia è l’assicuratore più conosciuto in Italia con circa Є31 miliardi di premi totali, 14 mila dipendenti e una rete capillare di 40 mila distributori, oltre ai canali online e di bancassurance. A Generali Italia fanno capo Alleanza Assicurazioni, Das, Genertel, Generali Welion, Generali Jeniot e Leone Alato, oltre alle attività marchio commerciale Cattolica.




Il Gruppo Generali offre delle interessanti opportunità di arricchimento professionale in un contesto lavorativo caratterizzato da:




Cultura aziendale solida e aperta, modi di lavorare innovativi, formazione e affiancamento a supporto di un inserimento efficace
Ambiente di lavoro inclusivo in cui ci si sente accolti, liberi di esprimere al meglio la propria identità, le proprie idee e le proprie capacità: perché siamo Più che diverse, Persone Uniche.

Title: Statistician (Statistics)
Description:
The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) contributes to the achievement of the 2030 Agenda through the FAO Strategic Framework by supporting the transformation to MORE efficient, inclusive, resilient and sustainable agrifood systems, for better production , better nutrition , a better environment , and a better life , leaving no one behind.

FAO's commitment to environmental sustainability is integral to our strategic objectives and operations.

Organizational Setting

The Statistics Division (ESS) develops and advocates for the implementation of methodologies and standards for data collection, validation, processing and analysis of food and agriculture statistics. In these statistical domains, it also plays a vital role in the compilation, processing and dissemination of internationally comparable data and provides essential capacity building support to Member Nations. In addition, the Division disseminates many publications, working papers and statistical yearbooks that cover agricultural and food security relevant statistics (including prices, investments, production, trade and agri-environmental statistical data).

The incumbent will work for the Agricultural Census Team, that is responsible for developing the methodological guidelines for the FAO World Programme for the Census of Agriculture (WCA), as well as conducting agricultural surveys to document country practices. The team is also responsible for assisting countries in strengthening their national agricultural statistical systems by providing technical assistance to carry out national agricultural census at least once every decade and to run a continuous programme of agricultural surveys, using standard international concepts, definitions and methodologies.

The position is located in the Statistics Division ( ESS ) at FAO headquarters in Rome, Italy.

Reporting Lines

The Statistician (Statistics) reports to the Senior Statistician/Leader of the Agricultural Censuses Team under the overall guidance of the Director, ESS.

Technical Focus

Agricultural Censuses and surveys.

Key Results

Comprehensive technical, statistical, analytical and/or policy analysis services and the development of specialized tools, methodologies, systems and/or databases to support the planning, implementation/delivery and monitoring of the programme of work and related products, projects, publications and services.

Key Functions


Plans and leads components of multidisciplinary teams and short-term work groups, leads and/or participates in Divisional teams, participates in Organization-wide committees, project teams and working groups and provides specialized expertise on international technical networks and or technical policy and standard setting bodies.
Coordinates the collection, review, processing and/or analysis of key social/economic/environmental indicators, based on either traditional statistical methods/sources or on unstructured sources and data science methods to support the delivery of economic and social development programmes of work whether focused on products, projects, publications or services.
Designs and develops improved/updated technical, statistical and/or analytical tools, systems and databases.
Designs and conducts research, data collection, validation, analysis and/or reporting in support of the development of technical standards, international instruments, innovative tools and methodologies to be used within the Organization or by external stakeholders.
Coordinates the production of a variety of technical reports and provides input in flagship publications, technical documents, Divisional publications and/or web pages.
Coordinates and provides responses to requests and provides technical and/or policy advice, assistance and solutions to Regional, Subregional and Country Offices including technical backstopping of field projects.
Coordinates and provides capacity development services, including the planning and organization of training workshops and seminars and the preparation of related information, materials, on-line tools and information kits.
Coordinates the organization, conduct and follow-up of meetings, consultations and conferences, the development/production of required materials and the provision of information and assistance to partners.
Participates in resource mobilization activities in accordance with Strategic Framework and Divisional plans.
Promotes international cooperation and collaboration, advocates best practices, knowledge sharing, increased policy dialogue, and provides technical expertise at international meetings and conferences.


Specific Functions


Identifies and formulates food and agricultural statistics development projects and assists with their implementation, monitoring and evaluation.
Contributes to support the World Programme for the Census of Agriculture (WCA) and FAO's Agricultural Survey programme.
Develops and updates conceptual, methodological and operational guidelines to collect statistical information on the agricultural sector at national level through agriculture censuses and agricultural surveys.
Coordinates and implements technical support to FAO units and member countries in the design, planning, and implementation of agricultural censuses and surveys, including formulation of country projects, the design of questionnaires and manuals, the implementation of cognitive and pilot testing, sample design, training of field staff, the use of advanced data collection technologies, and the dissemination of census and survey data and microdata.
Coordinates the preparation and delivery of training and dissemination materials on agricultural censuses and surveys to country officials and field staff.
Provides hands-on support to national institutions in applying statistical methods to large farm datasets, including editing, validation and analysis of the data with statistical software.
Coordinates and supports the monitoring and documentation of countries' censuses, prepares metadata reviews and main census results.
Coordinates and implements the processing and dissemination of census data from WCA rounds to the FAOSTAT (FAO database) domain.
Coordinates and supports the preparation of technical articles, working papers, books and training materials and documents best practices in agricultural censuses and surveys.
Supports the mobilization of extra-budgetary resources in support of the implementation of agricultural censuses and surveys.
Performs other duties as required.


______________________________________________________________________________________________________

CANDIDATES WILL BE ASSESSED AGAINST THE FOLLOWING

Minimum Requirements


Advanced university degree (Master’s degree or equivalent) in statistics, mathematics, economics, or a related field.
Seven years of relevant experience in the compilation and analysis of food and agricultural statistics in national or international organizations and in the coordination of high-level statistical publications and management of statistical dissemination platform.
Working knowledge (proficiency - level C) of English and intermediate knowledge (intermediate proficiency - level B) of another FAO official language (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian or Spanish).


Competencies


Results Focus
Teamwork
Communication
Building Effective Relationships
Knowledge Sharing and Continuous Improvement


Technical/Functional Skills


Work experience in more than one location or area of work, particularly in field positions.
Strong command of statistical methods including: data presentation, analysis and descriptive statistics; main continuous and discrete random variables (binomial, normal, standard normal, log-normal) and their properties; probability distributions; conditional probability, probabilities of intersections of events, Bayes' theorem; correlation and rank correlation; sampling and sample size: simple, stratified, and multistage random sampling; Inference, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing and significance; linear regression (single and multiple) comparison of population means and variances, ANOVA; Chi-square and goodness of fit tests; nonlinear models: maximum likelihood estimation; elements of survey and questionnaire design.
Extent and relevance of knowledge and experience in collecting, compiling and disseminating agricultural statistics .
Extent and relevance of experience in the formulation of technical assistance projects as well as the planning and the provision of capacity development programmes and technical support at the country level for agricultural censuses and surveys.
Extent of knowledge and experience in agricultural survey methodology, including survey design, sampling, questionnaire design, data collection and validation methods.
Exten t of proficiency and experience in CAPI survey tools and in using software tools for validating, processing and analysing microdata from large-scale agricultural surveys.
Extent of experience in microdata dissemination and knowledge of statistical disclosure control methods and tools.
Relevant practical experience i n the design and implementation of agricultural census es and surveys methodology, including data validation and dissemination.

Sedi: Roma, Milano, Bologna




In Avanade siamo alla ricerca di Machine Learning & AI Engineer appassionati di Intelligenza Artificiale e innovazione, con almeno 5/6 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di soluzioni di Intelligenza Artificiale in contesti aziendali strutturati; competenze di people management.




Entrerai a far parte del team Advanced Analytics, all’interno dell’area Data & AI, e contribuirai alla progettazione e allo sviluppo di progetti di Data Science, tra cui modelli predittivi, soluzioni basate su Large Language Models (LLM), agenti intelligenti e sistemi di Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).




Together we do what matters.

Collaborerai con altri ML & AI Engineers, sviluppatori full stack AI, data engineers e solution architects per integrare modelli ML/AI in architetture cloud moderne.
Scriverai codice Python/PySpark di alta qualità e SQL per l’analisi e la trasformazione dei dati.
Lavorerai con modelli tradizionali di Machine Learning e Deep Learning.
Svilupperai soluzioni basate su Large Language Models, con conoscenza di tecnologie come RAG e agenti intelligenti.
Progetterai e svilupperai pipeline di ML e soluzioni AI, dalla fase di prototipazione alla messa in produzione
Utilizzerai strumenti di MLOps e DevOps per la gestione, versionamento e deployment dei modelli.
Contribuirai al confronto con i clienti, traducendo esigenze di business in soluzioni AI efficaci.

.

Solida conoscenza di Python per il Machine Learning e la Data Science.
Solida conoscenza di SQL e modellazione dei dati.
Esperienza con librerie di Machine Learning (es. Scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, Prophet).
Esperienza con i framework di Deep Learning (es. PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras).

Esperienza con Large Language Models, tecniche di prompting e sistemi di Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

competenze di people management

Esperienza con Hugging Face Transformers.
Esperienza con servizi come AI Foundry.
Esperienza in deployment di modelli AI su infrastrutture containerizzate (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Microsoft: AZ-900, AI-900, AI-102, AI-100, DP-100, DP-600

Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica, Data Science o discipline affini.
Analitico, curioso, agile, paziente e orientato alla qualità
Capacità di lavorare in team cross-funzionali e di comunicare efficacemente con stakeholder tecnici e non.
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, sia scritta che parlata.

In Avanade troverai un'azienda meritocratica che investe sulla crescita delle persone attraverso percorsi di studio mirati e che prevedono una continua formazione - grazie alle partnership privilegiate con Microsoft e con alcuni dei più importanti player del settore - e il conseguimento di numerose certificazioni.

Il nostro ambiente di lavoro è aperto e inclusivo, potrai quindi esprimere le tue idee e lavorare a progetti innovativi attraverso l’ultima tecnologia disponibile sul mercato, confrontarti con migliaia di consulenti in Italia e nel mondo. Title: Customer Excellence & Analytics Senior Manager
Description:
Job description:



At Angelini Pharma, we believe that great healthcare starts with truly understanding the people we serve. As our Customer Excellence & Analytics Manager, you'll turn data, AI, and customer insight into smarter decisions and more meaningful connections with healthcare professionals. You'll shape how we listen, measure, and engage across every channel, transforming numbers into stories that inspire action and make a real difference for patients. If you're passionate about changing the way teams work, not just reporting on it, we'd love to meet you.

 

About the role

As our Customer Excellence & Analytics Manager, you will lead how we understand, measure, and improve our commercial engagement model — combining data, AI, and customer experience thinking to drive better decisions and better outcomes.

What you will own: 

Customer Intelligence
Build deep understanding of HCP segments — behaviours, channel preferences, content needs, and prescribing drivers — that goes beyond traditional targeting.
Use predictive analytics and AI models to anticipate HCP responsiveness, churn risk, and engagement opportunities before they surface in the field.
Omnichannel Performance & Measurement
Design the KPI architecture that tells us whether our commercial model is working with customer — reach, frequency, engagement quality, cross-channel synergy, and conversion.
Move beyond reporting: translate performance data into clear, narrative-driven recommendations that change how brand and field teams operate.
Commercial Analytics & AI
Lead the commercial analytics roadmap: sales performance, promotional response, market share, competitive intelligence
Champion a data-driven culture: enable commercial teams to self-serve on core insights; brief senior leadership with clarity, not complexity
Identify and pilot AI applications that create competitive advantage 
Data Governance & Commercial Data Strategy
Own the integrity of commercial data assets: KPI definitions, master data standards, source-of-truth alignment across CRM, BI, and marketing platforms.
Ensure all analytical outputs are consistent, documented, and decision-ready 

 

Requirements

Degree in Business, Economics, Life Sciences, or a quantitative discipline.
5–8 years in commercial operations, analytics, customer excellence, market intelligence or digital within pharma 
Proven track record of connecting data to commercial decisions — not just producing reports, but changing what teams do
Fluency in commercial metrics and omnichannel models; power-user comfort with CRM, BI tools (Power BI)
Working knowledge of AI and machine learning applications in a commercial context 
Strong cross-functional influencer: able to align Sales, Marketing, Medical, and IT stakeholders without direct authority
Executive communication skills: you simplify complexity, tell stories with data, and make senior stakeholders act.

 

The salary for this role starts from 64000€ gross per year, depending on experience and location. The offer isdetermined based on gender-neutral criteria, including relevant skills, competencies, and experience.

Angelini Pharma is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
We believe that diversity is a huge value that contributes to individual and company success. We arecommitted to create and foster a diverse and inclusive environment.

Your Perspectives

  • Operare in un contesto organizzato, dove gli aspetti metodologici e di relazione assumono una rilevanza strategica con respiro internazionale e multiculturale;

  • Fornire supporto applicativo a soluzioni basate su moduli di Intelligenza Artificiale, Large Language Models e Computer Vision, sia esistenti che di nuova realizzazione.

 

Your unique strengths

  • Possiedi una laurea in discipline STEM;

  • Hai esperienza nello sviluppo e addestramento di modelli utilizzando tecniche di Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing e Computer Vision, sia a partire dai framework più utilizzati (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, Spark ML, Spark GraphX) che da servizi SaaS (Google Vertex AI, Azure Cognitive Services, OpenAI);

  • Hai esperienza nell'utilizzo di Python per lo sviluppo di soluzioni basate su AI e sei interessato a lavorare con Large Language Models come OpenAI e tecniche di Computer Vision come OCR, YoLo, etc.;

  • Hai basi di Semantic Web e conosci l’architettura dei motori di ricerca evoluti (Elastic Search, Solr, Lucene);

  • Hai utilizzato strutture dati NoSQL (MongoDB o componenti dell'ecosistema Hadoop);

  • Conosci approfonditamente linguaggi di programmazione object oriented come Java/Scala, C++ o Python;

  • Sei capace di mettere in pratica tecniche di "Continuous Learning" al fine di cogliere opportunità da nuove tecnologie senza abbandonarti alla sola attività di ricerca;

  • Possiedi tecniche di ascolto attivo, capacità di sintesi e di problem solving;

  • Ti contraddistingui per intraprendenza e curiosità, spiccato senso di responsabilità professionale;

  • Possiedi una conoscenza avanzata della lingua inglese (parlata e scritta).

Set your expectation higher

PwC ti sorprenderà con un’opportunità di carriera che ti farà sentire al centro della società, dell’innovazione e del cambiamento. Il tuo talento e la tua curiosità avranno tutto lo spazio che meritano e, attraverso l’identificazione delle migliori risorse, contribuirai a garantire la qualità dei servizi che offriamo ai nostri clienti. In questo percorso di crescita sarai accompagnato da colleghi esperti e da una formazione continua e su misura grazie alla quale potrai mettere le tue competenze a disposizione dei clienti interni.

 

Feel at home

Ci prendiamo cura delle nostre persone, abbracciando le diversità e creando valore per i clienti, le persone e la comunità, nel rispetto dell'ambiente.

GIVE YOUR LIFE A DIFFERENT PERSPECTIVE

Title: Junior Data Engineer
HTML:
We let the future guide us. Join our next generation

Vuoi fare un lavoro che sia davvero significativo e di impatto? In KPMG avrai l’opportunità di aiutare i clienti, la società, le colleghe e i colleghi ad affrontare e risolvere le sfide più attuali e complesse. KPMG Advisory offre servizi di consulenza alle imprese per affiancarle nella trasformazione del business model, nel miglioramento e nella digitalizzazione dei processi, nell'analisi e nella gestione dei rischi, nonché supporto nelle operazioni di finanza straordinaria.

Nel particolare, entrerai a far parte del Team di Lighthouse di Roma.

La Lighthouse è il centro di eccellenza di KPMG Advisory che offre soluzioni di Data & Analytics sul mercato.

Unendoti al team, svilupperai soluzioni innovative attingendo dalle nostre competenze globali. Combinerai informatica, matematica, statistica e business per creare analisi predittive, presentandole e comunicandole con professionalità e competenza. Opererai in un ambiente orientato all'innovazione tecnologica, occupandoti dell'ingegneria dei dati, con un forte focus sulla progettazione delle informazioni e visualizzazione dei dati. Abbiamo ricevuto riconoscimenti internazionali per quanto riguarda la nostra capacità di interpretare e gestire i dati.

Nello specifico, ti occuperai di:

  • Analisi di modelli analitici a supporto dei processi di business;
  • Analisi, progettazione e implementazione di fonti di dati;
  • Data Visualization, Advanced Analytics, Big Data;
  • Progettare KPI e i framework di calcolo più efficienti;
  • Analizzare, progettare e implementare modelli di reporting e dashboard di monitoraggio;
  • Analizzare processi aziendali e progettare modelli di supporto analitico;
  • Implementare soluzioni analitiche, supportare il go-live e gestire la manutenzione delle applicazioni.

Come As You Are - Le tue competenze e caratteristiche

Questa opportunità è perfetta per te se:

  • Possiedi una Laurea in economia, matematica, ingegneria matematica, statistica, ingegneria informatica, ingegneria gestionale o informatica;
  • Hai sviluppato conoscenza in ambito dati e database (modelli dati entità/relazioni, DBMS)
  • Hai sviluppato la capacità di combinare competenze aziendali con competenze IT, inclusa la modellazione dei dati;
  • Hai sviluppato interesse per la Data Visualization e Business Intelligence
  • Hai sviluppato Interesse per i tool ed i processi ETL (Informatica, Talend, Datastage);
  • Hai una buona padronanza della lingua inglese, preferibilmente con esperienze di studio e/o lavoro all'estero;
  • Possiedi conoscenza di almeno uno dei seguenti database (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL) e hai sviluppato competenze in SQL; la conoscenza di linguaggi di programmazione rappresenta un vantaggio.

Your Future With Us - Cosa troverai in KPMG

  • Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, equo e che rispetta, incoraggia e valorizza le diversità;
  • Un contesto stimolante e dinamico che incentiva la creatività e il lavoro di squadra;
  • Modalità di lavoro ibrida, per promuovere un sano equilibrio tra vita lavorativa e personale;
  • Programmi di formazione e sviluppo avanzati per rimanere sempre aggiornati;
  • Mindset internazionale e progettualità innovative;
  • Iniziative incentrate sul benessere psicofisico.

L’opportunità prevede un inserimento con indennità mensile di 800€ per stage curriculare o 1.000€ per stage extracurriculare o in assunzione con inquadramento ai sensi del CCNL Commercio e RAL di ingresso: € 30.000, determinata sulla base di criteri oggettivi quali il titolo di studio e la valutazione del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione.

In ottemperanza alla normativa vigente, non raccogliamo né utilizziamo informazioni sulle retribuzioni percepite in rapporti di lavoro attuali o precedenti. Le nostre procedure di selezione sono, inoltre, improntate a criteri oggettivi e neutrali rispetto al genere.

Together for Better – I nostri valori e il nostro impegno

Leadership, lavoro in team, rispetto di ogni individualità, approfondimento continuo, trasparenza, impegno verso la comunità, integrità: questi sono i Valori di KPMG che danno vita a un ambiente aperto allo scambio di idee e di conoscenza, che permette ai nostri professionisti di esprimere tutto il loro potenziale.

GGrazie all’impegno nel favorire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, il nostro Network risulta conforme agli standard dei requisiti ISO 30415, sul Sistema di Gestione per la Diversità e l’Inclusione, e UNI PdR 125, relativa alla parità di genere. All’interno del nostro Impact Plan - Our Impact Plan (kpmg.com) - trovi riassunte tutte le azioni che stiamo portando avanti su tematiche ambientali, sociali e di governance (ESG).

Unisciti a noi!

I tuoi dati saranno trattati nel pieno rispetto delle disposizioni del Regolamento (UE) n. 679/2016 (General Data Protection Regulation - "GDPR") e successive modifiche. Per ulteriori informazioni, consultare l'informativa sulla privacy di KPMG.

KPMG Advisory S.p.A. garantisce le pari opportunità

At KPMG - no secrets with big data

We let the future guide us. Join our next generation

Do you want to pursue a profession that is truly meaningful and impactful? At KPMG, you will have the opportunity to help clients, the company and colleagues address and solve the most current and complex challenges. KPMG Advisory offers consulting services to companies to assist them in business model transformation, process improvement and digitisation, risk analysis and management, and support in extraordinary finance transactions.

Specifically, you will join our Lighthouse team.

Lighthouse is the KPMG Advisory centre of excellence delivering an array of data & analytics solutions.

Alongside the team, you will develop innovative solutions by drawing on our global expertise,with access to shared knowledge from our centres of excellence Your experience in IT, mathematics and statistics along with your corporate expertise will allow you to design and implement predictive analytical solutions, integrating different factors and presenting them in a professional manner. In a business- and technological innovation-orientated environment, your work will embrace data science, data engineering and information visualisation.

Specifically, you will be tasked with:

  • designing databases for analytical purposes;
  • analysing and integrating data sources;
  • data visualization, advanced analytics, Big Data;
  • designing more efficient KPIs and computing frameworks;
  • analysing, designing and implementing reporting models and dashboards;
  • analysing corporate processes and designing analytical support models;
  • implementing analytical solutions, supporting the launch and overseeing the maintenance of software.

Skills

 Come As You Are - Your skills and characteristics

This is the perfect opportunity for you if:

  • you have a degree in economics, mathematics, mathematical engineering, statistics, computer engineering, management and production engineering or computer science;
  • you have developed the capacity to combine corporate and IT expertise, as well as data modelling;
  • you have developed aninterest in Data Visualization/Business Intelligence;
  • you are proficient in English, preferably with study/work experience abroad
  • you have knowledge of at least one of the following databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and have developed skills in SQL; knowledge of programming languages is considered an advantage.

Your Future With Us - What you’ll find at KPMG

  • An inclusive and equitable work environment that respects, encourages and values diversity.
  • A challenging and dynamic environment that encourages creativity and teamwork.
  • Hybrid work arrangements to promote a healthy work-life balance.
  • Advanced training and development programmes to stay current.
  • International mindset and innovative projects.
  • Initiatives focused on mental and physical well-being.

This opportunity is offered as either a paid internship offering a monthly allowance of €800 for curricular internships and €1,000 for extracurricular internships or a standard employment contract under the collective labour agreement for the commerce sector, with a starting gross annual salary of €30,000. The salary is determined on the basis of objective criteria, including educational qualifications and an assessment of the candidate’s profile against the requirements of the role.

In accordance with applicable legislation, we do not collect or use information relating to remuneration received in current or previous employment. Our selection procedures are based on objective and gender-neutral criteria.

Together for Better – Our values and commitment

Leadership, teamwork, respect every individual, continuous learning, transparency, commitment to the community and integrity. These are the KPMG values that create an environment that encourages the sharing of ideas and knowledge, so our professionals can achieve their full potential.

As a result of our commitment to fostering an inclusive work environment, our Network complies with the standards of the ISO 30415 requirements, on the Diversity and Inclusion Management System, and UNI PdR 125, relating to gender equality. Within our Impact Plan - Our Impact Plan (kpmg.com) - you will find summarised all the actions we are taking on environmental, social and governance (ESG) issues.

Join us!

Your data will be processed in full compliance with the provisions of Regulation (EU) no. 679/2016 (General Data Protection Regulation - “GDPR”), as amended. For more information, please see KPMG’s privacy policy.

KPMG Advisory S.p.A. is an equal opportunity employer.

Title: Generative AI Engineer
Description:
Cosa aspettarti

Deda Next è parte del Gruppo Deda, specializzata nella trasformazione digitale di PA e aziende di pubblico servizio attraverso la progettazione e realizzazione di servizi di nuova generazione. Attraverso il cloud che abilita la gestione efficace di dati e piattaforme, Deda Next partecipa allo sviluppo di una società in cui le persone sono al centro di tutto.

Lavorerai nell'Area Data &AI alla progettazione, implementazione e valutazione di soluzioni AI, integrando modelli linguistici, basi documentali, API e tool esterni.

Il ruolo è fortemente hands-on: è importante saper trasformare un’idea o un requisito in un prototipo funzionante e successivamente portarlo verso una soluzione robusta e manutenibile.

Cosa farai


Progetterai e svilupperai soluzioni di Generative AI basate su LLM, AI Agent e architetture RAG.
Gestirai l'intero ciclo delle pipeline AI, dall'ingestion dei dati al retrieval, fino alla valutazione e all'ottimizzazione delle performance.
Integrerai LLM, vector database, API e sistemi aziendali per realizzare applicazioni intelligenti e scalabili.
Svilupperai componenti backend in Python e semplici interfacce web per prototipi e soluzioni AI.
Contribuirai all'evoluzione delle architetture AI, adottando standard e tecnologie innovative dell'ecosistema GenAI.


Cosa ci aspettiamo da te


Esperienza di almeno 3 anni con LLM e Generative AI, inclusi prompt engineering, structured output, AI Agent, function/tool calling, context management e integrazione di modelli tramite API, con attenzione a costi, latenza e performance.
Esperienza nella progettazione e sviluppo di soluzioni RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), includendo document ingestion, preprocessing, chunking, embeddings, semantic e hybrid search, vector database, retrieval, reranking e valutazione della qualità delle risposte.
Esperienza nella valutazione e ottimizzazione di sistemi LLM/RAG, attraverso definizione di test e benchmark, analisi della qualità del retrieval e delle risposte (groundedness, relevance, faithfulness) e identificazione delle principali criticità dei sistemi generativi.
Esperienza nello sviluppo di applicazioni Python e API REST, utilizzando framework come FastAPI e adottando principi di software engineering, con capacità di realizzare prototipi e interfacce AI tramite HTML/CSS/JavaScript, React, Streamlit o Gradio.
Nice to have: esperienza con framework e tecnologie dell'ecosistema GenAI e AI Agents (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex), vector database e motori di ricerca semantica (pgvector, Qdrant, Weaviate, Pinecone, OpenSearch), oltre a competenze in Docker, servizi Cloud AI, CI/CD, observability, LLM tracing e gestione di modelli open source.


Cosa ti offriamo


Work life balance grazie a un modello di lavoro agile personalizzato e flessibile
Coinvolgimento in progetti strategici e innovativi nella Pubblica Amministrazione
Valori da condividere; possibilità di crescita, formazione e certificazione supportati dall’azienda – scopri la vita in Deda


Se ritieni di possedere le competenze richieste, anche con un livello di seniority non pienamente allineato a quello indicato, ti invitiamo comunque a candidarti: durante la selezione valuteremo attentamente il tuo grado di esperienza professionale.

Il range retributivo indicato nell'annuncio si riferisce al livello di seniority esplicitato; un’eventuale diversa valutazione durante l'iter selettivo potrà determinare un adeguamento al range salariale corrispondente.

Siamo uno dei principali gruppi tecnologici a capitale interamente italiano, interlocutore naturale di Aziende, Istituzioni Finanziarie e Servizi Pubblici nell’evoluzione delle loro strategie IT e digitali.

Nel corso degli anni, abbiamo costruito un ecosistema di aziende che condividono valori e strategie di business e una visione comune: sfruttare la forza della dedizione per aiutare i clienti a cogliere i benefici dell'evoluzione digitale, potenziando così l'impatto positivo della tecnologia sull'economia e sulla società.

Title: AI Research Engineer
Description:
About Pi School

Pi School is on a mission to empower businesses and professionals to leverage AI's transformative capabilities. We believe technology should be an enabler, not a barrier, and it should empower individuals and businesses to grow, innovate, and stay connected. We strive for a world where AI and human potential coexist harmoniously, reshaping the way we work, learn, and prosper. Born in 2017 from the expertise of Translated, an industry pioneer with over two decades of leadership in AI + human translation, Pi School has helped over 100 companies integrate AI solutions to improve their operations, enhance decision-making, and achieve sustainable growth.

Pi School remains at the forefront of the ever-evolving AI landscape and collaborates with prominent research centres and organisations worldwide, such as the European Space Agency (ESA) and the European Commission, to harness AI for both cutting-edge research and practical solutions, driving progress in science and beyond. Our approach is founded on purposeful, impactful work, leveraging technology as a force for good.

We are looking for an EO AI Engineer (Agents & Integrations) to work in our office in Rome.

Pi School's AI research team is building EVE (Earth Virtual Expert), an open-source AI platform for Earth Observation, developed for the European Space Agency. We are looking for an engineer at the intersection of EO data engineering and AI-powered agents to help design, build, and integrate EVE's connections to the ESA ecosystem: satellite data catalogues, processing platforms (APEx, EarthCODE), Copernicus services, and geospatial tooling.

Project specifics
EVE (Earth Virtual Expert) is being developed by Pi School, with support from Mistral AI and Imperative Space, for ESA Phi-lab.
EVE is evolving from a text-based EO assistant into a multimodal, agentic platform under ESA Phi-lab, serving as Europe's main knowledge nexus between Earth AI models, data, tools, and resources.
The project is fully open source, with the aim of publishing code, models, and documentation across several public venues (for example GitHub, the Hugging Face Hub, and ESA Phi-lab).
Core workstreams:
Agentic framework: tool calling, planning, multi-agent orchestration.
Multimodal expansion: satellite imagery understanding.
Community ecosystem: open tool registry for EO.
ESA platform integrations: APEx, EarthCODE, CDSE.
Discover more at eve.philab.esa.int.
Responsibilities

You will be part of Pi School's AI Research team full-time, building the agentic layer at the heart of EVE. In this role, you will:

Design and implement EVE's agent orchestration with LangGraph: planning, tool calling, state and memory management, and multi-agent workflows.
Build and maintain MCP servers and clients so EVE can use EO tools and services (data catalogues, processing platforms, community tools) through a common interface.
Implement agent-to-agent communication with A2A, so EVE can delegate to specialised sub-agents and interoperate with agents from other ESA projects and partners.
Design specialised sub-agents (for example a data-retrieval agent over CDSE) and the routing logic between them.
Evaluate and improve agent behaviour: tool-use accuracy, task success, robustness, and latency.
Follow the state of the art in agentic systems and turn promising ideas into working prototypes, open releases, and publications.
Help the community ecosystem: short tutorials, notebooks, and docs so others can plug tools and agents into EVE.
Requirements

Hands-on experience with:

LangGraph: building stateful, multi-step or multi-agent applications beyond simple chains.
Model Context Protocol (MCP): writing MCP servers and/or integrating MCP tools into agents.
Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol: agent cards, task delegation, and communication between independent agents.
LLM-based agents and tool-using systems more broadly (function calling, structured outputs, multi-step orchestration).
Solid Python engineering.
Excellent proficiency in English.
Bonus pointsif you have experience with:
Backend development and API design.
FastAPI.
Qdrant or other vector databases.
Cloud compute or HPC environments.
Our office

Pi School is hosted at Pi Campus, a working environment immersed in nature. Six luxury villas in Rome (Italy) have been converted into functional offices to foster talent growth. Pi Campus is also a venture firm created by Translated to reinvest part of its profits into promising AI startups.

Our offer

Based on a standard level of experience, the offered salary typically ranges between €35.000,00 and €55.000,00. The actual package depends on factors such as location, scope of responsibilities, and performance. Compensation generally grows quickly as experience leads to greater contributions. Exceptionally strong candidates may be offered salaries above this range to acknowledge their higher potential impact.

Starting date: as soon as possible

Appplication deadline: 31 December 2026

Benefits and Perks

Our working environment is both relaxed and intense. We are passionate about our mission, and our work is highly regarded in our industry.

Fresh fruit and snacks
Access to the pool and Turkish bath
Sports activities: gym and pilates
Free time in between your tasks to work on your personal projects
Access to the Pi Campus parties and gatherings

Learn more about our company: https://picampus-school.com/.

Diversity

At Pi School, we proudly embrace and celebrate each individual's unique qualities in our team, regardless of race, sexual orientation, gender identity, or other differences. We recognise that these diverse perspectives empower us to overcome challenges, foster innovation, and drive excellence. As an inclusive and equal opportunity employer, we are committed to cultivating an environment where everyone feels welcome, valued, and supported to achieve their full potential.

Project specifics
  • EVE (Earth Virtual Expert) is being developed by Pi School, with support from Mistral AI and Imperative Space, for ESA Phi-lab.
  • EVE is evolving from a text-based EO assistant into a multimodal, agentic platform under ESA Phi-lab, serving as Europe's main knowledge nexus between Earth AI models, data, tools, and resources.
  • The project is fully open source, with the aim of publishing code, models, and documentation across several public venues (for example GitHub, the Hugging Face Hub, and ESA Phi-lab).
  • Core workstreams:
    • Agentic framework: tool calling, planning, multi-agent orchestration.
    • Multimodal expansion: satellite imagery understanding.
    • Community ecosystem: open tool registry for EO.
    • ESA platform integrations: APEx, EarthCODE, CDSE.
  • Discover more at eve.philab.esa.int.
Responsibilities

You will be part of Pi School's AI Research team full-time, building the agentic layer at the heart of EVE. In this role, you will:

  • Design and implement EVE's agent orchestration with LangGraph: planning, tool calling, state and memory management, and multi-agent workflows.
  • Build and maintain MCP servers and clients so EVE can use EO tools and services (data catalogues, processing platforms, community tools) through a common interface.
  • Implement agent-to-agent communication with A2A, so EVE can delegate to specialised sub-agents and interoperate with agents from other ESA projects and partners.
  • Design specialised sub-agents (for example a data-retrieval agent over CDSE) and the routing logic between them.
  • Evaluate and improve agent behaviour: tool-use accuracy, task success, robustness, and latency.
  • Follow the state of the art in agentic systems and turn promising ideas into working prototypes, open releases, and publications.
  • Help the community ecosystem: short tutorials, notebooks, and docs so others can plug tools and agents into EVE.
Requirements

Hands-on experience with:

  • LangGraph: building stateful, multi-step or multi-agent applications beyond simple chains.
  • Model Context Protocol (MCP): writing MCP servers and/or integrating MCP tools into agents.
  • Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol: agent cards, task delegation, and communication between independent agents.
  • LLM-based agents and tool-using systems more broadly (function calling, structured outputs, multi-step orchestration).
  • Solid Python engineering.
  • Excellent proficiency in English.
Bonus pointsif you have experience with:
  • Backend development and API design.
  • FastAPI.
  • Qdrant or other vector databases.
  • Cloud compute or HPC environments.
Our office

Pi School is hosted at Pi Campus, a working environment immersed in nature. Six luxury villas in Rome (Italy) have been converted into functional offices to foster talent growth. Pi Campus is also a venture firm created by Translated to reinvest part of its profits into promising AI startups.

Our offer

Based on a standard level of experience, the offered salary typically ranges between €35.000,00 and €55.000,00. The actual package depends on factors such as location, scope of responsibilities, and performance. Compensation generally grows quickly as experience leads to greater contributions. Exceptionally strong candidates may be offered salaries above this range to acknowledge their higher potential impact.

Starting date: as soon as possible

Appplication deadline: 31 December 2026

Benefits and Perks

Our working environment is both relaxed and intense. We are passionate about our mission, and our work is highly regarded in our industry.

  • Fresh fruit and snacks
  • Access to the pool and Turkish bath
  • Sports activities: gym and pilates
  • Free time in between your tasks to work on your personal projects
  • Access to the Pi Campus parties and gatherings

Learn more about our company: https://picampus-school.com/.

Diversity

At Pi School, we proudly embrace and celebrate each individual's unique qualities in our team, regardless of race, sexual orientation, gender identity, or other differences. We recognise that these diverse perspectives empower us to overcome challenges, foster innovation, and drive excellence. As an inclusive and equal opportunity employer, we are committed to cultivating an environment where everyone feels welcome, valued, and supported to achieve their full potential.

Title: Net Revenue Management Specialist
Description:
Life tastes better with ice cream

With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.

We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.

What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.

We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.

We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.

The role

At The Magnum Ice Cream Company, Revenue Growth Management is a critical capability that helps us drive profitable growth through data-driven pricing, promotion, assortment and trade investment decisions.

The Revenue Growth Management Specialist will play a key role in translating market, customer and performance data into actionable recommendations that improve net revenue, profitability and sustainable growth. Working closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance and Category teams, you will help shape commercial strategies and deliver insights that influence key business decisions across the Italian Ice Cream business.

What You'll Be Responsible For


Support the development and execution of Revenue Growth Management strategies across pricing, promotions, assortment and mix.
Analyze sales, market and customer data to identify growth opportunities and profitability improvements.
Monitor promotional effectiveness and recommend actions to maximize return on trade investments.
Develop business cases and financial analyses to support pricing and portfolio decisions.
Partner with Sales, Marketing and Finance teams to embed RGM principles into commercial planning.
Build dashboards, reports and performance tracking tools to monitor key RGM KPIs.
Support annual planning cycles, forecast reviews and customer business planning processes.
Generate actionable insights from internal and external data sources to support strategic decision-making.
Provide fact-based recommendations and challenge commercial assumptions to improve revenue and profit delivery.


We're Looking For Someone Who


Has 3+ years of experience in Revenue Growth Management, Commercial Finance, Category Management or Business Analytics within FMCG or Consumer Goods.
Brings strong skills in data analysis, financial modelling, pricing analytics and stakeholder management.
Has advanced knowledge of Excel and Power BI; experience with Nielsen Circana or similar market data sources is an advantage.
Demonstrates strong analytical thinking and the ability to translate complex data into clear recommendations.
Can translate data into compelling business stories and influence stakeholders across functions.
Thinks end-to-end and takes ownership for results.
Is comfortable working in a fast-moving, evolving organisation.
Values collaboration, clarity and low-ego ways of working.


What You'll Get

Alongside meaningful work and strong development, we offer a reward package that typically includes


Market-competitive pay (Range € 43200, 00 - € 54000,00) depending on
experience and qualifications, plus performance-related rewards
Flexible ways of working
Support for health, wellbeing and life outside of work
Time off to rest and recharge
Ongoing learning and development opportunities
Meal vouchers


Why join us?

This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!

You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.


Roles with real accountability and visible impact
Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
Continuous learning and development as the business grows
Reward linked to performance and contribution.


Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.

Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?

If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.

If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.

Additional Information

The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

Title: Junior Pricing Actuary
HTML:
Siamo alla ricerca di un profilo junior da inserire all'interno del team Pricing, nella struttura Attuariato Danni. La persona prescelta contribuirà:

  • alla definizione, alla revisione e al monitoraggio delle tariffe, sulla base di analisi statistiche, attuariali e di profittabilità;
  • allo sviluppo e all'aggiornamento di modelli tariffari per la stima del rischio, con particolare riferimento a frequenza sinistri, costo medio e premio tecnico;
  • all'analisi del fabbisogno tariffario e dei principali indicatori tecnici e di redditività del portafoglio;
  • alla realizzazione di analisi di scenario e simulazioni per valutare gli effetti delle modifiche tariffarie sulle performance e sulla composizione del portafoglio;
  • alla predisposizione, al controllo e alla validazione delle basi dati utilizzate per le analisi e la modellizzazione tariffaria;
  • alla produzione della documentazione tecnica e al monitoraggio periodico della qualità e della stabilità dei modelli;
  • alla collaborazione con le funzioni Underwriting, Commerciale, Sinistri, IT e le altre strutture coinvolte nei processi tariffari.

REQUISITI

  • Laurea magistrale in Scienze Statistiche e Attuariali, Statistica, Matematica o discipline quantitative affini;
  • conoscenza delle principali tecniche statistiche e attuariali applicate al pricing dei Rami Danni, con particolare riferimento ai Modelli Lineari Generalizzati (GLM);
  • capacità di interpretare i principali indicatori tecnici assicurativi e di valutarne l'impatto sulla profittabilità del portafoglio;
  • accuratezza nella gestione, nel controllo e nell'analisi di basi dati complesse;
  • capacità di rappresentare e comunicare con chiarezza i risultati delle analisi a interlocutori tecnici e di business;
  • buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, scritta e parlata.

COSTITUISCONO TITOLO PREFERENZIALE

  • aver maturato almeno 2 anni di esperienza in attività attuariali, pricing, analisi di portafoglio o ambiti quantitativi correlati, presso compagnie assicurative, società di consulenza o contesti analoghi;
  • conoscenza del settore assicurativo e dei principali processi di pricing e underwriting nei Rami Danni;
  • esperienza, anche accademica o progettuale, nello sviluppo di modelli tariffari, di rischio o di profittabilità;
  • conoscenza o utilizzo di software statistico-attuariali dedicati al pricing, quali Emblem e Radar;
  • conoscenza di SAS, R o altri strumenti per l'analisi statistica e la gestione dei dati;
  • familiarità con le attività di rate requirement, analisi di scenario e monitoraggio dei principali KPI tecnici;
  • conoscenza delle pratiche di documentazione, validazione e monitoraggio dei modelli tariffari.

Soft Skills

  • approccio analitico, rigore metodologico e attenzione alla qualità del dato;
  • curiosità intellettuale, proattività e interesse per l'evoluzione delle metodologie di pricing;
  • capacità di apprendimento rapido e orientamento all'aggiornamento continuo;
  • buone capacità comunicative e relazionali, anche verso interlocutori non tecnici;
  • attitudine al lavoro in team e alla collaborazione interdisciplinare;
  • capacità organizzative, autonomia e orientamento al raggiungimento degli obiettivi;
  • condivisione della mission e dei principi della Compagnia.

COSA OFFRIAMO

Inserimento con CCNL ANIA - Imprese di Assicurazione:

Retribuzione Annua Lorda a partire da € 30.000,00 oltre al Premio di Risultato;

Settimana lavorativa corta (il venerdì si lavora solo al mattino)

Orario di lavoro flessibile;

Smart working (2 giorni la settimana);

Buoni pasto da 11,50€ erogati anche durante le giornate di smart working;

Contributo previdenza complementare;

Pc e smartphone aziendali.

Nel rispetto dei temi della Diversity ed Inclusion, HDI Assicurazioni garantisce pari opportunità di accesso alla selezione, senza alcuna discriminazione basata su genere, orientamento sessuale, etnia, disabilità, religione, opinioni politiche o stato civile.
